name: Magna Polonia S.A.
summary: Magna Polonia S.A., previously known as NFI Magna Polonia S.A., is a Warsaw, Poland-based private equity and venture capital firm. The company specializes in providing capital throughout a business's lifecycle, encompassing seed funding, start-up investments, growth capital, expansion financing, restructuring support, and bridge loans. Its strategic focus is on the telecommunications, broadcasting, and information technology sectors. Geographically, Magna Polonia S.A. prioritizes opportunities within Central and Eastern Europe, with a strong emphasis on Poland. The firm typically commits between €0.5 million ($0.65 million) and €10 million ($13.05 million) to its portfolio companies.

name: NFI Octava S.A.
summary: NFI OCTAVA S.A. is a fund specializing in investments in real estate projects. The fund prefers to invest in development of commercial, residential, and office space sectors. It primarily invests in projects based in Poland, but can consider opportunities in Eastern and Central European countries. The fund also provides debt financing.

name: 11 bit studios S.A.
summary: 11 bit studios S.A. develops and sells cross-platform video games worldwide. The company sells its video games through specialized Internet platforms. 11 bit studios S.A. was founded in 2009 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Atal S.A.
summary: Atal S.A. develops and sells residential building complexes in Poland. The company develops housing estates, and single and multi-family houses. It operates in Gliwice, Katowice, Cracow, Lodz, Wroclaw, Warsaw, Tricity, and Poznan. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Cieszyn, Poland. Atal S.A. is a subsidiary of Juroszek Investments Sp. z o.o.

name: 3R Games S.A.
summary: Operating within Poland, 3R Games S.A. and its subsidiaries are dedicated to publishing virtual reality (VR) games and applications for various VR devices and platforms. The company, originally founded in 2006, was known as HubStyle S.A. until it officially adopted the name 3R Games S.A. in December 2020. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Alta S.A.
summary: Operating through its various subsidiary entities, Alta S.A. is deeply involved in the real estate sector across Poland. The company's diverse operations include leasing commercial, logistical, and office properties, as well as acquiring, preparing, and divesting land plots for development. Furthermore, it undertakes the construction and sale of residential properties, such as houses and apartments, and offers comprehensive real estate administration services. The Warsaw, Poland-based firm was previously known as TUP Spólka Akcyjna, officially changing its name to Alta S.A. in September 2013. Alta S.A. functions as a subsidiary of Hlamata Holdings Limited.

name: Ab S.a.
summary: Established in 1990 and headquartered in Magnice, Poland, AB S.A. is a prominent player in the IT distribution sector, primarily serving markets across Poland, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia. Beyond its core IT product distribution, AB S.A. boasts a diverse operational portfolio, including the assembly, wholesale, retail, import, export, and repair of a wide range of electronic equipment, encompassing computers, telecommunications devices, multimedia products, and other electronics. Further diversifying its offerings, the company engages in software development and trading, as well as the installation of IT networks and the implementation of comprehensive computer systems. AB S.A. also provides premises rental services and operates bonded warehouses, supporting its logistical framework. Its extensive service array covers internet provisioning, maintenance, IT consulting, and logistics solutions such as forwarding and transportation. Additionally, the company offers educational initiatives through training and publication services, alongside printing, promotion, advertising, and marketing support.

name: Asseco Business Solutions S.A.
summary: Asseco Business Solutions S.A. designs and develops enterprise software solutions in Poland and internationally. The company offers ERP systems to manage the key areas of the business; HRM applications to manage the human resources and payroll; SFA/FFA retail execution solutions to enable and facilitate mobile workforce management; commercial data exchange platform to swap data between manufacturers and their business partners; Factoring systems to manage the factoring transaction process; and Software for SMEs to manage small- and medium-sized business. Its solutions include Softlab ERP by Asseco and Macrologic ERP by Asseco; Omnichannel for FMCG, Mobile Touch by Asseco, and Connector by Asseco; and Faktor by Asseco. The company also provides IT outsourcing services, as well as sells and deploys central data processing systems. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Lublin, Poland.

name: AC Spólka Akcyjna
summary: AC Spólka Akcyjna, founded in 1986 and based in Bialystok, Poland, is a leading manufacturer and distributor of automotive systems and components. The company's primary focus is on developing and selling advanced LPG and CNG autogas conversion kits, marketed under its reputable STAG brand. These sophisticated systems are engineered to allow both petrol and diesel engines to operate on alternative fuels, with offerings tailored for various applications including direct petrol injection and diesel conversions. The extensive STAG product lineup features a broad range of specialized parts, such as intuitive mobile applications for system management, various LPG/CNG controllers (including Q-GENERATION, direct injection, and diesel models), fuel injection rails, durable LPG and CNG reducers, and emulator products for fuel injectors, levels, and pressure. Essential supporting components like switches, fuel level indicators, timing advance processors, pressure sensors, interfaces, filters, and valves are also part of their portfolio. Beyond its core autogas technology, AC S.A. supplies a comprehensive array of general automotive parts. This includes a wide selection of electrical components (fuses, fuse holders, terminals, connectors, plugs, sockets), wiring accessories (hose clamps, cable ties), warning devices (rotating beacons, horns), and trailer equipment (cables, adapters, spiral coils). The company also offers car electronics, electrotechnical products, and tachograph accessories. Furthermore, under its Tytangas brand, it provides leak detection tools and antifreeze solutions. AC Spólka Akcyjna maintains an international presence, actively exporting its products in addition to serving the Polish market.

name: Asseco Poland S.A.
summary: Asseco Poland S.A., an information technology (IT) company, develops and sells software products primarily in Poland and internationally. It operates through three segments: Asseco Poland, Formula Systems, and Asseco International. The company offers software and IT solutions for banking, payment, insurance, public institutions, healthcare, defense and uniformed services, energy and gas, telecommunications and media, cloud services, and security sectors. It also provides enterprise resource planning software for micro, small, medium, and large enterprises; and business intelligence solutions. The company was formerly known as Softbank S.A. and changed its name to Asseco Poland S.A. in January 2007. Asseco Poland S.A. was founded in 1989 and is based in Rzeszów, Poland.

name: Action S.A.
summary: Action S.A., together with its associated entities, specializes in the comprehensive distribution and sale of a wide array of products. This includes IT solutions, consumer electronics, home appliances, and various general consumer goods. Beyond these core offerings, the company engages in the retail sector for pet supplies and the wholesale trade of computer components. It also acts as a distributor for toys, garden items, and products for home enhancement. Furthermore, Action S.A. provides essential consumables like printing inks and toners, an assortment of lighting products such as LED bulbs and decorative lamps, and uninterruptible power sources. Its own brands include Activejet and Actis for computer accessories like keyboards and mice, while PCs and servers are offered under the Actina name. The company utilizes a multifaceted approach to reach customers, including partnerships with resellers, international export channels, online platforms, direct corporate engagements, commercial network collaborations, and telecom providers. Established in 1991, Action S.A. maintains its headquarters in Piaseczno, Poland.

name: Adiuvo Investments S.A.
summary: Adiuvo Investments S.A. operates as a venture capital firm, deploying capital across the entire spectrum of business development, from initial incubation and seed funding to supporting early-stage, startup, and growth-phase companies. Its primary investment focus lies in the medical devices, digital health, and nutraceuticals sectors, specifically targeting opportunities within Poland. The firm typically commits up to €3 million (approximately $3.35 million) per venture, with an intended holding period of three to five years. All investments are made directly from Adiuvo's own balance sheet. Established in 2013, the company maintains its headquarters in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Agora S.A.
summary: Agora S.A., a Polish company, primarily focuses on publishing a range of print media, including magazines, periodicals, and books. Its diverse operations are structured across five distinct segments: Movies and Books, Press, Outdoor, Internet, and Radio. The Movies and Books segment manages cinematic activities, encompassing film distribution, production, and providing gastronomic services. Within the Press division, Agora S.A. publishes both daily and special editions of Gazeta Wyborcza, alongside other periodicals, and engages in printing services. Its Outdoor segment provides advertising solutions utilizing various outdoor panels. The Internet division delivers online and multimedia products and services, primarily through its dedicated department and other related companies. Finally, the Radio segment operates a substantial network of local radio stations, including the super-regional news channel TOK FM, 24 Golden Hits stations, 4 Rock Radio stations, and 8 Radio Pogoda stations, broadcasting across 23 metropolitan regions. Beyond its core media functions, Agora S.A. also runs restaurants. Established in 1989, the company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, and operates as a part of the broader Agora S.A. Group.

name: Agroton Public Ltd
summary: Agroton Public Limited engages in the production, processing, storage, and sale of crops in Eastern Ukraine. The company offers various grains and oilseeds, including wheat, sunflower, corn, and rapeseed, as well as barley, rye, sorghum, triticale, oats, peas, buckwheat, vetch, millet, coriander, soybeans, flax, and livestock crops. It also operates storage facilities; and produces and sells livestock. The company was formerly known as PE Agricultural Production Firm and changed its name to Agroton Public Limited in September 2009. Agroton Public Limited was founded in 1992 and is based in Kyiv, Ukraine.

name: Allegro.eu S.A.
summary: Allegro.eu S.A. operates an online marketplace in Poland. The company connects buyers and sellers, offering a wide range of products, including electronics, fashion, and home goods. Allegro.eu is headquartered in Luxembourg.

name: All in! Games S.A.
summary: ALL IN! GAMES SA is a Polish video game publisher and developer, focusing on publishing and supporting independent video game projects across PC and console platforms. They work with various developers to bring their games to market. The company is based in Krakow, Poland.

name: Altus S.A.
summary: ALTUS Towarzystwo Funduszy Inwestycyjnych S.A. is a publicly owned investment manager. ALTUS Towarzystwo Funduszy Inwestycyjnych S.A. was founded in 2007 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Ailleron S.A.
summary: Headquartered in Krakow, Poland, Ailleron S.A. is an international technology provider delivering innovative solutions across the telecommunication, financial, banking, and hospitality sectors. For the hospitality industry, Ailleron features iLumio, an interactive system enhancing guest services in hotels. Within banking and finance, their portfolio includes LiveBank, a cutting-edge virtual branch platform, alongside tools for marketing automation, lead generation, commission oversight, and credit management. They also offer internet and mobile banking solutions, wealth management services, and specialized platforms for leasing companies, such as a front-office sales system and eBOK, a web portal for client access to product information, invoices, and payments. Additionally, LiveBranch enables the creation of virtual transactional branches, complemented by various mobile and onboarding functionalities. In telecommunications, Ailleron provides the Ringback Tone platform, empowering mobile operators to replace standard waiting tones with music, advertisements, or other audio content. Their robust value-added services platform encompasses video and visual voicemail, inbound/outbound IVR (with video options), missed call notifications, and "notify on return" or "notify after busy" features. Further telecom offerings include migration, provisioning, and consulting for NGN and IMS platforms, as well as class 4 and 5 soft switches, telephony application servers, and bespoke solutions. Beyond these industry-specific tools, the company utilizes Big Data analytics to optimize customer experience and communication. They also furnish comprehensive IT solutions and services, including integration platforms, business intelligence tools, and operations support systems. Furthermore, Ailleron offers IT outsourcing for the development, deployment, and management of diverse applications. The company, initially known as Wind Mobile S.A., officially adopted the name Ailleron S.A. in October 2015.

name: Alior Bank S.A.
summary: Alior Bank SA is a Polish bank providing retail and corporate banking services. The bank offers a range of products including current accounts, loans, mortgages, and investment products. Alior Bank is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Allianz SE
summary: Allianz SE, together with its subsidiaries, provides property-casualty insurance, life/health insurance, and asset management products and services worldwide. The company's Property-Casualty segment offers various insurance products, including motor liability and own damage, accident, general liability, fire and property, legal expense, credit, and travel to private and corporate customers. Its Life/Health segment provides a range of life and health insurance products on an individual and a group basis, such as annuities, endowment and term insurance, and unit-linked and investment-oriented products, as well as private and supplemental health, and long-term care insurance products. The company's Asset Management segment offers institutional and retail asset management products and services to third-party investors comprising equity and fixed income funds, and multi-assets; and alternative investment products comprising infrastructure debt/equity, real assets, liquid alternatives, and solutions. Its Corporate and Other segment provides banking services for retail clients, as well as digital investment management services. Allianz SE was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.

name: Ambra S.A.
summary: Ambra S.A. manufactures and sells alcoholic and soft beverages. It provides sparkling wines, still wines, aperitifs and liquors, spirits, and others. The company offers its products under the CIN&CIN, DORATO, EL SOL, FRESCO, PLISKA, PICCOLO, and CYDR LUBELSKI brand names. It supplies its products to retail stores, wholesalers, and retail chains, as well as offers products through its online store Winezja.pl. In addition, the company imports and distributes wines. Further, it provides business and management advisory services; and engages in the rental of intellectual property, and trade and sales of food products. Additionally, the company operates in the property investment business in Romania. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Ambra S.A. is a subsidiary of Schloss Wachenheim AG.

name: Amica S.A.
summary: Amica S.A. manufactures and distributes household appliances in Poland and internationally. It operates through Free-Standing Heating Appliances, Built-In Heating Appliances, Other Heating Appliances, Goods, and Other segments. The company provides cookers, ovens, wine coolers, heating drawers, hobs, refrigerators, washing machines, washer dryers, dishwashers, microwave ovens, and hoods. It also offers small kitchen appliances, including kettles, toasters, coffee makers, juicers, blenders and mixers, sandwich makers, and steamers, as well as vacuum cleaners; and imports equipment for the purpose of resale, such as refrigerators, washing machines, microwave ovens, dishwashers, and small appliances. In addition, the company provides spare parts and repair services; space rental and maintenance services; consulting and IT services; marketing, promotional, and commercial services; hospitality and catering services; and real estate management services. Amica S.A. sells its products under the Amica, Gram, Hansa, Sideme, CDA, and Fagor brands. The company was formerly known as Amica Wronki S.A. and changed its name to Amica S.A. in August 2016. Amica S.A. was founded in 1945 and is based in Wronki, Poland.

name: Answear.com S.A.
summary: Answear.com S.A. operates as an e-commerce fashion retailer, established in 2011 and based in Kraków, Poland. The company specializes in selling apparel, footwear, and various accessories to customers across multiple countries, including Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria, and Ukraine.

name: APS Energia S.A.
summary: Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, APS Energia S.A. is a global provider of uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems. The company excels in the design, production, and worldwide sales of these critical power solutions, catering to a wide array of sectors including manufacturing, heating, industry, telecommunications, and medicine. Its comprehensive product line features emergency power systems, AC and DC receivers, rectifiers, inverters, frequency converters, active filters, fuel cells, and sophisticated power system surveillance technologies. Additionally, APS Energia offers specialized components such as DC/DC EPI converters, power systems for asynchronous motors, BRI discharging rheostats, and auxiliary and general-purpose power supply units. The firm also provides end-to-end services, encompassing design, assembly, installation, commissioning, along with full warranty and post-warranty support for its power equipment.

name: LC Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Ampli S.A. is a Polish company primarily involved in the distribution of electrical products, serving both wholesale and retail markets. Their offerings encompass a range of lighting solutions, including diverse light sources, modern induction and LED luminaires, and comprehensive control systems. These products are utilized across various sectors, such as industrial production and warehouse facilities, street lighting, and general building applications. The company was founded in Tarnów, Poland, in 1990, where its main office remains located.

name: Aplisens S.A.
summary: Aplisens S.A. operates internationally and within Poland, specializing in the production and distribution of industrial process control equipment. Their core expertise lies in electronic technologies for measuring pressure and differential pressure. The company's diverse product portfolio includes pressure transmitters, pressure gauges, and HART communication devices; hydrostatic probes, transmitters, and switches for level measurement; temperature transmitters, sensors, and associated displays; electromagnetic and nozzle flow meters; and electro-pneumatic positioners along with APIS mounting kits. Additionally, they offer various diaphragm seals, such as flanged, chemical flanged, threaded, and sanitary types; a range of digital, linear, and multi-channel indicators, displays, and data loggers; valve manifolds and essential fitting accessories; and electronic components like power supplies, signal isolators/converters, and overvoltage protection circuits. For the automotive sector, Aplisens also develops specialized items including fuel level probes, fuel filler security products, fuel and pulse converters, RFID rotation detectors, electronic seals, and RFID tank door sensors for fuel filler flaps. Established in 1992, Aplisens S.A. maintains its headquarters in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Auto Partner S.A.
summary: AUTO PART.SA S.A-G ZY-,10 is a company that sells and distributes automotive parts and accessories. They offer a wide range of products for various types of vehicles. The company operates primarily in Poland.

name: Apator S.A.
summary: Apator S.A. manufactures and sells metering and switchgear equipment in Poland and internationally. Its products include electricity meters, such as smart, electronic, prepayment, and induction meters, as well as smart grid systems comprising remote data read out and prepayment systems, and analysis of metering data; and water meters, volume parts for heat meters, heat meters, heating cost allocators, remote reading systems, installation fittings, test and measurement products, archives, and other products. The company also offers residential, commercial, and smart gas meters; radio telemetry modules; switchgear systems, such as switch disconnectors, fuse rails, surge arresters, accessories, and 4G cam switches, as well as APASYS 60, a modular designed current distribution system; and mining equipment. In addition, it provides IT solutions in the areas of grid assets, utilization of power grid assets, grid assets development, customer service, analyses and reports, process and document management, customer portals, and connectors; and IT services, such as grid passporting, integration, outsourcing, implementation, training, and consulting. Further, the company offers power and distribution engineering equipment, drives and control engineering equipment, AC and DC drives, softstarts, and motors and gears, as well as MRO and customer training services. Additionally, it provides research and development services in technical sciences; manufacture instruments and appliances for measuring, checking, navigating and other uses; thermometers and thermostats; and IT system applications. Furthermore, the company engages in the publishing, printing, and reproduction of recorded media; sale of prepayment electricity and gas meters; and distribution of water and heat meters. It also offers controlgears, electricity, electrical equipment, lifting equipment, pumps, and compressors; and manufactures reading and transmitting data devices. Apator S.A. is based in Torun, Poland.

name: Archicom S.A.
summary: Archicom S.A. operates as a Polish real estate firm with diverse activities. Its business encompasses the development, construction, leasing, and sale of both commercial and residential properties. Additionally, the company is involved in acquiring and divesting real estate assets, managing building development initiatives, leasing intellectual property, and providing financial services. Established in 1986, Archicom S.A. is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland, and functions as a subsidiary of Echo Investment S.A.

name: Arlen S.A.
summary: Arlen S.A., established in Warsaw, Poland, in 1995, is a company dedicated to the design, production, and distribution of a broad range of protective and business apparel. Its extensive product line includes uniforms for various uniformed services such as the police, armed forces, city guards, and border guards, alongside specialized clothing meeting stringent Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) requirements. The company also supplies corporate attire for businesses and medical garments for hospitals. Beyond clothing, Arlen S.A. provides woven and technical fabrics and offers textile rental services specifically for hospitals and health centers. The company serves a wide and varied clientele, which includes fire brigades, courier and postal services, transport firms, various industrial sectors (petrochemical plants, heavy-industry facilities, food production plants, pharmaceutical plants, petrol stations), hypermarket chains, health services, catering establishments, hotels, rental companies, and organizations involved in the management and control of road, air, and rail transport. Arlen S.A. extends its operations beyond Poland, maintaining a presence in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

name: Artifex Mundi S.A.
summary: Artifex Mundi S.A. develops and publishes video games worldwide. It provides approximately 40 game titles for various platforms, including PC, Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android, Windows, Xbox One, and PlayStation. The company is headquartered in Zabrze, Poland. Artifex Mundi S.A. was formerly a subsidiary of ZSK Progres s.c.

name: ASBISc Enterprises Plc
summary: ASBISc Enterprises Plc, operating alongside its various subsidiaries, is engaged in the wholesale distribution and sale of a wide array of computer hardware and software products. The company offers an extensive range of technological solutions, including infrastructure for data centers, collaboration platforms, mobile computing, point-of-sale systems, Internet of Things (IoT) applications, tools for remote work, video surveillance, cloud services, and storage management. Additionally, ASBISc provides expertise in software-defined infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) compliance, and digital signage technologies. Its product catalog features vital components such as servers, data storage units, networking equipment, security systems, client devices, storage upgrades, and other computing accessories. ASBISc serves a broad spectrum of industries, including telecommunications, education, government, manufacturing, sports, transportation, agriculture, automotive, betting, construction, data management facilities, financial services, healthcare, hospitality, wholesale and retail trade, IT services, legal and social sectors, and public utilities. Founded in 1990, the company is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.

name: Asseco South Eastern Europe S.A.
summary: Asseco South Eastern Europe S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides software implementation, integration, and outsourcing services. The company operates through Banking Solutions, Payment Solutions, and Dedicated Solutions segments. It offers omnichannel solutions for distributing banking services, and online services and consultancy in mobile and electronic banking, along with digital transformation. The company also provides telecommunication services, such as AI, billing solutions, customer communication management, data lakes, digital signatures, content services platforms, ERP, security, service desks, asset and construction management, and business process management. In addition, it offers public and utility services, such as notary, postal, content services platform, multifactor authentication, mobile app security, digital board meetings, customer communication management, and mobile app development services. Further, the company provides payment services, such as 3D Secure technology, versatile card processing solutions, and integrated end-to-end payment systems. It operates in Central Europe, Southeastern Europe, the Iberian Peninsula, Turkey, Colombia, Peru, and the Dominican Republic, as well as in India and the United Arab Emirates. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Rzeszów, Poland. Asseco South Eastern Europe S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Asseco International a.s.

name: ASM Group S.A.
summary: Operating through its subsidiaries, ASM Group S.A. provides sales support and a variety of outsourcing solutions across five European nations: Poland, Italy, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The company's comprehensive service portfolio also includes field marketing, market research, accounting and controlling functions, merchandising, external sales team management, temporary staffing, public relations, and consultancy for sales and promotional strategies. Additionally, ASM Group is involved in orchestrating digital campaigns. Established in Warsaw, Poland, in 2010, it maintains its primary operational base there.

name: ASML Holding N.V.
summary: ASML Holding N.V. develops, produces, markets, sells, and services advanced semiconductor equipment systems consisting of lithography, metrology, and inspection related systems for memory and logic chipmakers. The company provides extreme ultraviolet lithography systems; and deep ultraviolet lithography systems comprising immersion and dry lithography solutions to manufacture various range of semiconductor nodes and technologies. It also offers metrology and inspection systems, including YieldStar optical metrology solutions to measure the quality of patterns on the wafers; and HMI e-beam solutions to locate and analyze individual chip defects. In addition, the company provides computational lithography and software solutions to create applications that enhance the setup of the lithography system; and mature products and services that refurbish used lithography equipment and offers associated services. It operates in Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, China, the Netherlands, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the United States, and rest of Asia. The company was formerly known as ASM Lithography Holding N.V. and changed its name to ASML Holding N.V. in 2001. ASML Holding N.V. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.

name: Astarta Holding PLC
summary: Astarta is a vertically integrated agro-industrial holding company with primary operations in Ukraine. The company's main activities include crop production of sugar beet, soybeans, wheat, and corn, alongside sugar production, cattle farming for milk, and soybean processing. It manages approximately 213,000 hectares of agricultural land and its products are sold in both domestic Ukrainian and global markets. The company also has a bioenergy segment that produces biogas.

name: Arctic Paper S.A.
summary: Arctic Paper S.A. is a European paper manufacturer specializing in high-quality graphic papers. The company produces coated and uncoated fine papers used for printing applications such as books, magazines, and advertising materials. Arctic Paper S.A. is headquartered in Kostrzyn nad Odrą, Poland.

name: Atende S.A.
summary: Atende S.A., a technology company established in 1991 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, specializes in integrating information technology systems and developing comprehensive information and communication technology (ICT) infrastructures across the country. The firm delivers a broad spectrum of ICT integration solutions, including the construction of computer networks and data centers, as well as the implementation of digital workplace environments. Additionally, it offers tailored IT security solutions for critical sectors like defense, telecommunications, energy, and finance. Atende's service portfolio extends to data center infrastructure management and diverse IT solutions. The company also provides cloud services, facilitating access to public clouds and supplying essential computing and storage resources. Furthermore, its expertise encompasses software and application development, alongside advanced services in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and the Internet of Things. While serving a wide range of industries, the power engineering sector represents a significant area of focus. The company operated under the name ATM Systemy Informatyczne S.A. until its rebranding to Atende S.A. in April 2013.

name: ATM Grupa S.A.
summary: ATM Grupa S.A. functions as an independent television and film production company, extending its operations across Poland, Europe, North America, and South America. The company's content portfolio spans a diverse range of programming, including music, current affairs, game, comedy, reality, crime, and political fiction series, in addition to producing or co-producing feature films. Beyond its screen productions, ATM Grupa develops and markets games for personal computers and mobile devices, and orchestrates various events. It also manages the Bielany Stage, a venue for performances by Polish theatre companies, and participates in building development. Furthermore, the company delivers comprehensive post-production solutions, encompassing media storage, film and sound editing, voice-over recording, color correction, and media export. Its rental offerings feature film studios, outside broadcast (OB) vans, and an extensive selection of production equipment such as cameras, lenses, lighting, grip, and sound gear, complemented by logistical and creative support. ATM Grupa S.A., founded in 1992 and headquartered in Bielany Wroclawskie, Poland, caters to both broadcasters and the viewing public.

name: Atlanta Poland S.A.
summary: Atlanta Poland S.A. trades in and retails nuts and dried fruits for the confectionery and bakery industries in Poland. The company offers various nuts, such as peanuts, hazelnuts, almonds, walnuts, cashews, coconut flakes, pecans, Brazil nuts, pine nuts, and pistachios; and dried fruits, including raisins, apricots, plums, banana chips, figs, apples, peaches, pears, papaya, pineapples, mango, dates, cranberries, flavored dried fruits, dried cantaloupe, candied cherries, and dried acerola. It also provides grains and seeds comprising natural and peeled sesame, sunflower seeds, soybeans, peeled pumpkin, poppy seeds, popcorn, and chia seeds; and other products, including agar-agar, flax seeds, sugar, ginger, goji berries, raisin paste, dried physalis, fried broad beans, orange peel, chickpeas, and psyllium. In addition, the company processes roasted nuts, peanut paste, arachis paste, hazelnut pulp, sesame pulp, peanut pulp, pistachio pulp, cashew pulp, almond pulp, other chocolate-coated products, smoked almonds, and peanut flour, as well as Marzipan, a paste of sweet almonds grated with sugar. It markets its sweets and dried fruits under the BAKAL brand. Atlanta Poland S.A. was founded in 1990 and is based in Gdansk, Poland. Atlanta Poland S.A. is a subsidiary of Rockfield Holding AG.

name: Atrem S.A.
summary: Atrem S.A. operates as a prominent general contractor for various investment projects and a crucial subcontractor for leading construction firms across Poland. The company specializes in delivering comprehensive solutions for the gas and liquid fuels sector, encompassing automation, visualization, and sophisticated control systems for exploitation, transmission, and distribution processes. Its offerings extend to implementing low-power installations, advanced measurement and control equipment, and broader automation initiatives. Atrem also designs and deploys IT systems, including proprietary solutions like the Telexus telemetry system and the Ewista passporting system, alongside developing process visualization and management platforms. Beyond these, the company provides a wide array of technological services such as electronic protection systems, building management systems (BMS), telecommunication infrastructure, ICT solutions, integrated visualization applications, and specialized custom developments. A significant area of expertise lies in cathodic protection, where Atrem offers monitoring services, polarization equipment, installation and maintenance, corrosion risk assessment and analysis, dedicated software products, and operational training for monitoring systems. Furthermore, Atrem is active in the aviation industry, handling the delivery, installation, implementation, and ongoing operation of IT, electronic, and automation systems specific to this sector. They also supply specialized industrial devices, including cathodic protection feeders, telemetric modems, boiler control units for gas pressure reduction stations, industrial port multiplexers, and TelCorr devices. Their capabilities also span renewable energy projects, involving the design, construction, consulting, and execution of wind farms, photovoltaic (solar) systems, and cogeneration facilities. Established in 1999 and headquartered in Suchy Las, Poland, Atrem S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A.

name: Atlantis SE
summary: Founded in 2018, Atlantis SE is an Estonian company based in Tallinn that extends financial credit to businesses operating in Poland. It functions as a subsidiary of Patro Invest OU.

name: Grupa Azoty S.A.
summary: Grupa Azoty S.A. is a Polish chemical company that produces fertilizers, plastics, and other chemical products. The company operates through a number of subsidiaries, serving the agriculture, construction, and automotive industries. Grupa Azoty S.A. is headquartered in Tarnów, Poland.

name: Airway Medix S.A.
summary: Airway Medix S.A. specializes in the research, development, and market introduction of disposable medical devices. These products are specifically designed for patients on mechanical ventilation in intensive care units and for individuals in critical, life-threatening conditions within anesthesiology departments. Their portfolio includes a Closed Suction System for clearing endotracheal tubes in mechanically ventilated patients, an Oral Care system to maintain oral hygiene for intubated and immobilized individuals, and a Cuff Pressure Regulator for continuous monitoring and consistent pressure management of intubation tube cuffs. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Bayer AG
summary: Bayer Aktiengesellschaft operates as a life science company worldwide. It operates through Pharmaceuticals, Consumer Health, and Crop Science segments. The Pharmaceuticals segment offers prescription products primarily for cardiology and women's health care; specialty therapeutics in the areas of oncology, hematology, and ophthalmology; and diagnostic imaging equipment and contrast agents, as well as cell and gene therapy. The Consumer Health segment markets nonprescription over-the-counter medicines, medical products, medicated skincare products, nutritional supplements, and self-care solutions in dermatology, nutritional supplements, pain and cardiovascular risk prevention, digestive health, allergy, and cold and cough. The Crop Science segment offers chemical and biological crop protection products, improved plant traits, seeds, digital solution, and pest and weed control products, as well as customer service for agriculture. This segment also provides breeding, propagation, and production/processing of seeds, including seed dressing. Bayer Aktiengesellschaft has a collaboration agreement with MD Anderson Cancer Center to develop oncology drugs; research and license agreement with Dewpoint Therapeutics, Inc. for the development of new treatments for cardiovascular and gynecological diseases; collaboration agreement with Exscientia Ltd, Foundation Medicine Inc., and Evotec AG; research collaboration with Arvinas Inc. and Forschungszentrum Jülich GmbH; strategic research partnership with University of Oxford to develop novel gynecological therapies; and research collaboration agreements with Haplogen GmbH and Kyoto University to identify new drugs candidates for the treatment of pulmonary diseases. The company distributes its products through wholesalers, pharmacies and pharmacy chains, supermarkets, online and other retailers, and hospitals, as well as directly to farmers. Bayer Aktiengesellschaft was founded in 1863 and is headquartered in Leverkusen, Germany.

name: BBI Development S.A.
summary: BBI Development S.A. is an investment firm specializing in the real estate sector. It strategically allocates capital to companies primarily based in Warsaw, alongside key regional urban centers such as Kraków, the Tri-City, Wrocław, and Poznań. The company's individual investments generally range from €5 million to €15 million ($6.67 million to $20.01 million) per portfolio company. While typically aiming for an exit within two to three years, this timeline is extended for ventures that yield ongoing returns from property ownership, rental, or estate management. The entity previously operated as BBI Nieruchomości and maintains its principal office in Warsaw, Poland, with an additional branch in Poznań.

name: BoomBit S.A.
summary: Engaged in the development and publication of computer games, BoomBit S.A. conducts its operations on a global scale, with its reach spanning across North and South America, Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia, and Oceania. The company, which was established in 2010, is headquartered in Gdansk, Poland, and was previously identified as AIDEM MEDIA SPÓLKA Z OGRANICZONA ODPOWIEDZIALNOSCIA.

name: Betacom S.A.
summary: Betacom S.A. offers cloud services and IT solutions to enterprises in Poland. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Big Cheese Studio Spolka Akcyjna
summary: Headquartered in Lódz, Poland, Big Cheese Studio Spolka Akcyjna specializes in crafting sophisticated and immersive video game experiences. The studio commenced its operations in 2018.

name: Bioceltix S.a.
summary: Bioceltix S.A. engages in the development of stem cell-based biopharmaceuticals for veterinary use. The company’s products include BCX-CM-J, a stem-cell based biological drug for the treatment of osteoarthritis in dogs; BCX-CM-AD, a drug candidate based on allogeneic stem cells for the treatment of atopic dermatitis in dogs; and BCX-EM, a drug candidate based on allogeneic mesenchymal stem cells for the treatment of arthritis in horses. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Bumech Defense Partners S.A.
summary: Bumech Defense Partners S.A. provides strategic and transaction consulting services in Poland. The company also offers business and management consultancy, as well as financial services. The company primarily serves small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was formerly known as Capital Partners S.A. and changed its name to Bumech Defense Partners S.A. in August 2026. Bumech Defense Partners S.A. was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Budimex S.A.
summary: Budimex SA operates as an infrastructure and services company in Poland. The company is involved in the general contracting of public, commercial, industrial, and residential buildings, as well as sports facilities. It also engages in the construction of hydraulic engineering projects, including shoreline armouring; construction and reinforcement of embankments and wharfs; and construction and reconstruction of drains and water bodies, and flood defenses, as well as road, railway, and airport infrastructure projects construction. In addition, the company is involved in the construction, modernization, and extension of wastewater treatment plants, water and sewer networks, and water treatment plants, as well as waste treatment, storage, and drying plants; and undertaking energy and industrial projects. Further, it provides earth works, mixtures distribution, routing the pavement, piling and lifting works, and professional flatbed transport; and laboratory, technological, and test services as well as offers bituminous mixtures. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Budimex SA is a subsidiary of Ferrovial, S.A.

name: ECB Spolka Akcyjna
summary: ECB SA is a financial holding company, which engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and trading of electricity. It operates through Financial and Energy segments. The Energy segment includes generation of electricity and heat from conventional sources. The Financial segment comprises of financial and service activities in the scope of leasing, holding, or otherwise sharing tangible assets. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Bedzin, Poland.

name: Benefit Systems
summary: Benefit Systems S.A. specializes in delivering non-cash employee remuneration packages across Poland and internationally. The company's portfolio includes solutions for physical activity and leisure, such as multisport cards, fitprofit programs, and fitness network access. They also cater to cultural and entertainment interests with offerings like cinema programs, MultiBilet, MultiTeatr, and multi-museum passes. Additionally, Benefit Systems provides further non-wage incentives through its cafeteria platforms, including MyBenefit and BenefitLunch. Founded in 2000, the organization is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Bank Handlowy w Warszawie S.A.
summary: BK HANDLOWY W WARS. ZY 4 is a Polish commercial bank offering a wide range of financial services to individual and corporate clients. The bank provides services including retail banking, corporate banking, investment banking and asset management. Bank Handlowy w Warszawie is a part of Citigroup and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Bioton S.a.
summary: Bioton S.A. is a Polish pharmaceutical company specializing in the production of human insulin. The company manufactures and markets insulin products for the treatment of diabetes. The company's headquarters are located in Macierzysz, Poland.

name: Bio Planet S.A.
summary: Bio Planet S.A. is engaged in the manufacturing, packaging, and supply of organic food items, serving both the Polish domestic market and international clientele. The company offers a vast array of roughly 4,000 products, sold under its proprietary Bio Planet brand, as well as through collaborations with other well-known labels including Alce Nero, Amylon Bio Planete, Organic Food, and Vivani. Its extensive product catalog encompasses a wide range of organic provisions, from essential pantry staples like grains, flours, pasta, and meat products, to specialized ingredients such as algae, mushrooms, and diverse dairy and gourmet selections. The offerings also feature an array of beverages (including teas, coffees, juices, wines, ciders, and beers), various sweets, snacks, spices, dietary items, and even organic animal feed. These goods are conveniently accessible for purchase via the company's dedicated online retail platforms. Bio Planet S.A. maintains its headquarters in Leszno, Poland.

name: Bloober Team S.A.
summary: Based in Kraków, Poland, Bloober Team S.A. is an autonomous studio specializing in video game development. Since its establishment in 2008, the company has focused on crafting interactive entertainment for Sony's gaming platforms, notably the PlayStation Vita and PlayStation 4.

name: Bumech S.A.
summary: Bumech S.A., headquartered in Katowice, Poland, specializes in providing underground drilling services for the mining sector. The company also offers comprehensive support for mining machinery, including operational maintenance, servicing, and overhauls. Additionally, Bumech manufactures and supplies its own range of mining machines and equipment, specifically including drilling extensions and push-plate feeder conveyors compatible with various heading machines. Beyond mining-specific offerings, the company also produces and sells molded rubber and rubber-metal products.

name: Bayerische Motoren Werke AG
summary: Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW) is a German multinational corporation that produces luxury vehicles and motorcycles. The company's product portfolio includes automobiles under the BMW, MINI, and Rolls-Royce brands, as well as motorcycles under the BMW Motorrad brand. BMW is known for its innovation, engineering excellence, and focus on sustainable mobility.

name: BioMaxima S.A.
summary: BioMaxima S.A. produces and distributes microbiological media, reagents, and in vitro diagnostic equipment in Poland. It offers microbiology products, including ready to use media, such as plates, bottles, bags, and media in tubes; dehydrated media; agars and peptones; and supplements. The company also provides molecular biology and cell culture products which includes real time PCR, nucleic acid isolation, NA and PCR electrophoresis, protein electrophoresis, enzymes, antibiotics, agaroses and molecular biology media, media and buffers for in vitro cultures, phenotypic micromatrices, plastics and small equipment, basic substrate components, and form. In addition, it offers laboratory diagnostics solutions for various areas of clinical chemistry, haematology, coagulology, immunochemistry, POCT, rapid tests, and blood collection systems; and disposable materials comprising microbiology, dispensing equipment, tubes, plugs, tripods, capillaries, equipment, aspiration-vacuum system, containers, tank for analysers, urine analysis, microscope slides, reagent tubes, autoclave equipment, and pliers and scissors. BioMaxima S.A. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Lublin, Poland.

name: BNP Paribas Bank Polska S.A.
summary: BNP Paribas Bank Polska S.A. is a prominent financial institution delivering a comprehensive suite of banking and financial services throughout Poland. The bank organizes its operations across key segments: Retail and Business Banking, Small and Medium Enterprises, Corporate Banking, Corporate and Institutional Banking, and other operational activities. Its extensive product portfolio serves a diverse client base, encompassing retail customers, individual consumers, large and medium-sized enterprises, local government entities, and multinational capital groups. For individuals, offerings include various current and savings accounts, fixed-term and overnight deposits, and a range of lending products such as mortgage, cash, car, installment, and revolving loans, complemented by debit and credit cards, mortgage advances, and overdraft facilities. Business and institutional clients benefit from specialized services like investment and agro-business loans, international cash transfers, foreign exchange solutions, insurance, wealth and cash management, trade finance (including import/export letters of credit, bank guarantees, and documentary collections), supply chain and export financing, derivatives, leasing, factoring, real estate and structured finance, investment banking, and brokerage services. Founded in 1919 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, the company rebranded from Bank BGZ BNP Paribas S.A. to its current name in 2019. BNP Paribas Bank Polska S.A. operates as a subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA.

name: Bank Ochrony Srodowiska S.A.
summary: Bank Ochrony Srodowiska S.A. provides various banking products and services in Poland. The company operates through Institutional Customers, Retail Customers, Treasury and Investment Activity, and Other segments. It offers current accounts, including personal accounts, settlement, and savings accounts; promotional deposits; foreign currency term deposits; credit products, which includes pro-ecological loans, cash loans, mortgage, and stock exchange loans, as well as debit and credit cards. The company engages in leasing activity to finance ecological projects; provision of financial, advisory, brokerage, and consulting services; bancassurance products, such as life insurance for borrowers, unemployment insurance, and insurance packages for payment cards; cash settlements products; and operates wind farms. It acts as a broker and an agent of insurance companies, and offers electronic and mobile banking for individual customers. The company serves corporate and public finance customers, as well as retails, individuals, micro-enterprises, and housing communities. It operates through a network of 53 branches. Bank Ochrony Srodowiska S.A. was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Bowim S.A.
summary: Bowim S.A., established in 1995 and headquartered in Sosnowiec, Poland, operates as a key distributor of carbon steel products throughout the country. Its comprehensive product range encompasses various steel sheet items, including cold and hot rolled plates and sheets, as well as cold rolled and galvanized coils and sheets. The company also provides a selection of bars, such as reinforcement, round, square, and flat types, in addition to wire rods. Further offerings include welded and ribbed wires, alongside welded reinforcement meshes. For tubular applications, Bowim S.A. supplies hot rolled and cold drawn seamless tubes, suitable for conduit, structural, boiler, precision, and general-purpose uses. Their inventory extends to cold-bent and hot-rolled sections, comprising equal and unequal angles, channels, square and rectangular hollow sections, H-beams, and wide-flange beams. The company additionally offers black and insulated pipes and their corresponding fittings, specifically designed for pipeline systems. Beyond distribution, Bowim S.A. engages in the manufacturing of prefabricated reinforcing products and operates a dedicated rebar workshop, capable of fabricating rods in diverse shapes and diameters. These specialized steel materials primarily serve crucial sectors such as gas engineering, petroleum chemistry, water infrastructure, and power engineering.

name: Boryszew S.A.
summary: Boryszew S.A. is a Polish industrial group involved in the production and sale of automotive components, non-ferrous metals, and plastics. The company operates through its subsidiaries, serving various industries, including automotive, construction, and packaging. Boryszew S.A. is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: BEST S.a.
summary: BEST S.A. is a Polish company primarily engaged in the debt recovery sector. It delivers extensive debt collection solutions to a wide array of clients, including financial institutions such as banks and lending firms, as well as telecommunications and energy suppliers, and other large-scale service organizations. The company also oversees the securitized assets of various securitization funds and actively acquires portfolios of distressed debt through the issuance of investment certificates and bonds. Additionally, BEST S.A. offers specialized legal opinions, advisory services, and manages the investigation and enforcement of debt-related obligations. Founded in 1994, the firm is headquartered in Gdynia, Poland.

name: Inter Cars S.A.
summary: Inter Cars S.A. engages in the import and distribution of spare parts for passenger cars and commercial vehicles in Poland, Romania, and internationally. It is also involved in the manufacture of trailers and semi-trailers; real estate development and lease; remanufacture of automotive spare parts; sale of vans and trucks; advertising, marketing, and public opinion research activities; logistics and asset management activities; and sale of delivery vans and trucks, as well as provision of advisory services, and organization of trainings and seminars related to automotive services and the automotive market. In addition, the company offers spare parts for motorcycles, as well as runs repair garages and vehicle repairs services for motor-vehicle fleets. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Czosnów, Poland.

name: Cavatina Holding S.A.
summary: Cavatina Holding Spólka Akcyjna engages in the development of office spaces in Poland. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Kraków, Poland. Cavatina Holding Spólka Akcyjna operates as a subsidiary of Cavatina Group Spolka Akcyjna.

name: Cyber_Folks S.A.
summary: Cyber_Folks S.A. operates in Poland, offering services across three primary domains: hosting, omnichannel communication, and telecommunications. Its Hosting division provides a spectrum of solutions, including co-shared hosting, Virtual Private Servers (VPS), dedicated servers, the sale and maintenance of internet domains, and additional offerings like SSL certificates. The Omnichannel Communication segment delivers a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform engineered for managing the preparation, processing, and automated distribution of mobile and email messages. Within its Telecommunication segment, the company supplies internet access to households, telephone and television services under its Oxylion brand, and Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) functionalities such as call queuing and virtual conference rooms. Cyber_Folks caters to a broad customer base, encompassing individual consumers, small and medium enterprises, various organizations, and large corporations. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Poznan, Poland, the company was previously known as R22 S.A. before rebranding to Cyber_Folks S.A. in August 2023.

name: Clean&Carbon Energy S.A.
summary: Established in 2002, Clean&Carbon Energy S.A. is a company based in Stargard, Poland, primarily focused on the extraction of bituminous coal. Known as Karen SA until its renaming in September 2010, the entity now operates as a subsidiary of Komputronik S.A.

name: CDRL S.a.
summary: Based in Koscian, Poland, CDRL S.A. specializes in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of a diverse range of products for children. Their extensive inventory includes clothing, accessories, underwear, footwear, toys, baby food, hygiene and care items, stationery, and nursery equipment such as prams and cribs. The company distributes its merchandise through a network of retail stores situated in various international markets, including Poland, the Czech Republic, Romania, the Baltic States, Belarus, Hungary, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Russia, Kazakhstan, Saudi Arabia, Mongolia, and Oman. CDRL S.A. manages a portfolio of distinct brands, notably Coccodrillo, Lemon Explore, Petit Bijou, Broel, Buslik, and Enjoy Baby.

name: CD Projekt S.A.
summary: CD Projekt S.A., through its subsidiaries, engages in the development and digital distribution of videogames for personal computers and video game consoles worldwide. It operates through two segments, CD PROJEKT RED and GOG.com. The company's product portfolio comprises The Witcher; The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings; The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, Hearts of Stone games, and Blood and Wine; Thronebreaker: The Witcher Tales; Gwent: The Witcher Card game; and Cyberpunk 2077. It also distributes videogames through GOG.com distribution platform and the GOG GALAXY application; and its games for various hardware platforms using traditional distribution channels and digital distribution platforms. The company exports its products in Europe, North America, South America, Asia, Australia, and Africa. CD Projekt S.A. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: CEZ, a. s.
summary: CEZ, a. s., an electricity generation company, engages in the production, distribution, trade, and sale of electricity and heat in Western, Central, and Southeastern Europe. The company operates through six segments: Generation-Traditional Energy, Generation-New Energy, Distribution, Sales, Mining, and Support Services. It operates two nuclear plants, sixteen hydroelectric plants, one combined cycle gas turbine plant, and eight fossil fuel plants in the Czech Republic. The company, through its subsidiaries, also operates various fossil fuel, hydro, wind, solar, biogas, and biomass power plants in the Czech Republic; eleven wind power plants in Germany; two fossil fuel plants and two hydroelectric plants in Poland; one solar plant in Bulgaria; and a wind farm and a complex of hydroelectric plants in Romania. In addition, it is involved in the distribution of electricity; trade and sale of natural gas; mining of coal; quarrying and processing of construction aggregate and high-percentage limestones; and commodity trading. Further, the company engages in the planning, construction, and maintenance of energy facilities. CEZ, a. s. was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Prague, the Czech Republic.

name: CFI Holding S.A.
summary: CFI Holding S.A. is a Polish company primarily involved in the construction sector. Its diversified operations span several key areas: TBS, commercial real estate, hospitality (hotels and restaurants), health and wellness services, and the chemical industry. The company's business activities include leasing residential and commercial properties, along with construction equipment. Furthermore, it supplies various chemicals, such as fertilizers, crop protection agents, and dyes. Beyond this, CFI Holding manages hotels, restaurants, and catering services, as well as health and fitness facilities like swimming pools, saunas, spas, and gyms. It also offers transportation solutions. Its portfolio further extends to property management, financial leasing, and money brokerage. Established in 1988, CFI Holding S.A. maintains its headquarters in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: CI Games S.A.
summary: Based in Warsaw, Poland, CI Games S.A. commenced operations in 2002. This global entertainment software company is actively involved in the creation, release, and worldwide marketing of video games, catering to markets throughout Europe, the Americas, Asia, and Africa. Its portfolio largely comprises proprietary and licensed first-person shooter and role-playing game franchises, playable across major platforms like PlayStation, Xbox consoles, and personal computers. Distribution occurs via direct sales to retail chains as well as through various digital storefronts. The entity, originally known as City Interactive S.A., underwent a name change to CI Games S.A. in August 2013.

name: Columbus Energy
summary: Columbus Energy S.A. engages in the provision of solutions in the field of photovoltaics and modern energy products for households and businesses in Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Ukraine. It also offers heat pumps, energy storage, electric car charging stations, as well as photovoltaic installations and alternative net-billing. The company was formerly known as Columbus Capital S.A. and changed its name to Columbus Energy S.A. in March 2016. Columbus Energy S.A. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Kraków, Poland.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Cloud Technologies S.A.
summary: Cloud Technologies S.A. primarily focuses on big data marketing and the commercialization of data. The company's core product is OnAudience.com, a data management platform (DMP) responsible for aggregating and organizing internet user data from across the globe. Furthermore, it offers various marketing services that leverage this extensive data. Founded in 2011, Cloud Technologies S.A. is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Coal Energy S.A.
summary: Coal Energy S.A., through its various subsidiaries, undertakes the extraction, enrichment, and worldwide distribution of thermal and coking coal, with a significant presence in Ukraine. The company segments its operations into Mineral Resource and Processing Industry, Trade Activity, and Other Activity. It possesses licenses for ten subterranean coal mines situated within Ukraine's Donbas coal basin, specifically in the Donetsk region. A diverse range of coal grades are produced, including anthracite, lean, long-flame gas, coking, and gas coal. Furthermore, the firm engages in the processing of coal waste dumps and actively participates in coal trading. Founded in 1995, Coal Energy S.A. maintains its principal office in Luxembourg City, Luxembourg, and operates as a subsidiary of Lycaste Holdings Limited.

name: Celon Pharma S.A.
summary: Celon Pharma S.A., an integrated pharmaceutical company, researches, manufactures, and markets drugs to treat cancers, neurological diseases, diabetes, and other metabolic disorders. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Lomianki, Poland. Celon Pharma S.A. is a subsidiary of Glatton Sp. z o.o.

name: Comp S.A.
summary: Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, Comp S.A. is a technology company that delivers a comprehensive array of IT and network security services and solutions across the country. Its offerings span critical security domains such as classified information protection, public key infrastructure (PKI) solutions, and electronic monitoring systems. The company further provides services for securing access, data, mobile devices, infrastructure, and entire networks and systems. Beyond these specialized services, Comp S.A. also delivers corporate and network security, cybersecurity, and audit and advisory services. They offer building technologies and provide system solutions focused on General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) compliance, enhancing business efficiency, and managing information security. Additionally, they are involved in constructing both application and infrastructure systems. Comp S.A. also manufactures various products, including cash register systems, automatic identification systems, weighing equipment, point-of-sale (POS) systems, proprietary software, and electronic transaction solutions. Their service portfolio extends to general IT services, encompassing IT infrastructure and resource management, IT outsourcing, systems integration, and professional consulting. The company serves a broad spectrum of clients in the finance, energy and industrial, public, services, and IT and telecommunications sectors.

name: Cognor Holding S.A.
summary: Cognor Holding S.A. produces and distributes steel products. The company offers flat plates and bars, slabs, round and square bars, reinforcing bars, T-profiles, equal and unequal side angles, billets with rounded edger for forgings, metal sheets, carbon and medium-alloy steels, and high-alloy and special steels, as well as products from non-ferrous metals and non-ferrous metal scrap. It also engages in the purchasing, processing, treatment, and sale of steel scrap; and processing of steel scrap into billets, as well as billets into steel products. The company operates in Poland, Germany, Switzerland, Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia, Italy, the Great Britain, Austria, Lithuania, France, and internationally. It also exports its products primarily to Germany and other European countries. The company was formerly known as Cognor S A and changed its name to Cognor Holding S.A. in November 2016. Cognor Holding S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Poraj, Poland. Cognor Holding S.A. is a subsidiary of PS HoldCo Sp. z o.o.

name: CPD S.A.
summary: Operating through its subsidiaries, CPD S.A. is a real estate firm primarily engaged in developing and selling office, residential, and warehouse properties. Its business scope covers both Poland and international markets, also encompassing land acquisition and building construction. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, the company was formerly known as Celtic Property Developments S.A., changing to its current designation in September 2014.

name: Comperia.pl S.A.
summary: Comperia.pl S.A. operates digital platforms in Poland that specialize in comparing financial products. These online portals empower users to easily evaluate and select from a diverse array of financial services. Their comprehensive offerings include various bank deposit and savings accounts; a wide range of credit facilities such as personal, car, business, online, mortgage, investment, consolidation, and refinancing loans; alongside credit cards, leasing, and factoring; as well as numerous insurance options like liability, accident, home, and travel policies. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Compremum S.A.
summary: Compremum S.A., established in 1973 in Poznan, Poland, and formerly known as Pozbud T&R Spolka Akcyjna, is a diversified enterprise operating across various sectors in Europe. The company primarily manufactures and distributes a wide array of windows and doors, including wooden, wood-aluminum, and aluminum options, alongside patio, external, and terrace doors, and facade systems, all under its SLONAWY brand. Beyond its joinery production, Compremum offers extensive construction services. These include the development and installation of fiber-optic, water, and sewage networks; the construction of residential and commercial properties; and the refurbishment of railway infrastructure. The company also provides general contracting services and specialized installation for its door and window products. Furthermore, Compremum is actively involved in the railway industry, performing repairs and modernizations on passenger and freight cars, electric locomotives, and liquid fuel tanks. It also delivers technical consulting and maintenance for energy facilities. The company organizes its operations into distinct segments: Joinery, Construction Services, Development Services, Railway Industry, and Renewable Energy Sources.

name: Cyfrowy Polsat S.A.
summary: Cyfrowy Polsat S.A. provides digital satellite platform, digital terrestrial television (TV), and telecommunication services in Poland. The company operates in two segments, B2C and B2B Services, and Media. The B2C and B2B Services segment offers satellite and Internet television, mobile and fixed-line Internet access, video online, mobile and fixed-line telephony, and wholesale services for other telecommunications operators, as well as telecommunications equipment and set-top boxes, and photovoltaic installations. It also provides services to other telecommunication operators, such as network interconnection, texting and MMS traffic routing, international roaming, services to MVNOs, shared access to network assets, and lease of network infrastructure. It offers approximately 160 TV channels, including terrestrial, general interest, sports and e-sports, movie, news/information, education, entertainment, and music and children's channels; and over the top services, such as Cyfrowy Polsat GO, VOD/PPV, online video and music, catch-up TV, and multiroom HD services. The Media segment produces, acquires, and broadcasts information, sports, and entertainment programs, as well as TV series and feature films broadcasted on television channels; and operates thematic portals and on the online advertising market. It also sells TV channel advertising airtime and sponsoring, and channel broadcasting rights. The company is also involved in the gaseous fuels trading; technical; Web portal; and other financial supporting activities, as well as intellectual property rights rental business. The company was formerly known as Polsat Cyfrowy S.A. and changed its name to Cyfrowy Polsat S.A. in 2004. Cyfrowy Polsat S.A. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Creotech Instruments S.A.
summary: Creotech Instruments S.A., established in 2008 and based in Piaseczno, Poland, is a prominent company within the aerospace and space sector. The firm specializes in developing and equipping advanced clean rooms for spacecraft assembly, ensuring compliance with rigorous European Space Agency (ESA) benchmarks. Additionally, Creotech manufactures and provides high-precision measuring devices for research institutions, alongside offering services in contract manufacturing, electronics assembly, and maintenance. A significant product is its CreoDIAS platform, a versatile cloud-based portal providing seamless access to all Copernicus satellite data, imagery, and related service information. This platform also extends its functionality by granting users access to essential IT cloud resources, various processing tools, and optional external datasets.

name: Creepy Jar S.A.
summary: Creepy Jar S.A. is a Polish video game developer and publisher. They are best known for developing and publishing the survival game Green Hell, set in the Amazon rainforest. The company is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: PZ Cormay S.A.
summary: PZ Cormay S.A., a diagnostic company, provides IVD solutions in Poland and internationally. The company offers analyzers, reagents, cleaning liquids, calibrators, control materials, patterns, and agglutination tests. It also provides analyzers, test strips, inspections, and calibration strips. In addition, the company offers parasitology, such as Paragreen Mini-System, a specialized device for concentrating and preserving stool samples, as well as veterinary medicines. Further, it provides immunochemistry, including SNIBE, MINDRAY, DIESSE, and AliveDX, as well as molecular biology, such as RT-PCR systems, systems for isolating genetic material, workstations, RT-PCR reagent kits, and nucleic acid isolation reagent kits. Additionally, the company offers sampling comprising blood and urine samples and supporting materials, as well as Sentimag systems, Magtrace markers, Magseed Markers, and surgical instruments, as well as HPLC systems, point of care diagnostics, and integrated systems. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Lomianki, Poland.

name: Caspar Asset Management S.A.
summary: Caspar Asset Management S.A., founded in 2009 and based in Poznan, Poland, delivers comprehensive asset management solutions. The company serves both individual investors and institutional entities across key markets, including Western Europe, the United States, and Poland. Their service portfolio includes offering access to diverse financial instruments, facilitating the execution of buy and sell orders, and providing expert investment consulting. Furthermore, Caspar Asset Management S.A. is actively involved in the establishment and oversight of investment funds, as well as the distribution of their respective units.

name: City Service SE
summary: City Service SE, a subsidiary of UAB ICOR based in Vilnius, Lithuania, delivers a broad spectrum of facility management and integrated utility services throughout Lithuania, Poland, Spain, Latvia, and Russia. The company specializes in the administration and maintenance of diverse properties, including commercial and residential structures, private homes, and market spaces. Their offerings encompass the regular cleaning and upkeep of territories and premises, along with the repair and maintenance of engineering systems, machinery, and technical equipment, including specialized cleaning for pipelines, sewage, and various storage tanks. In addition to physical maintenance, City Service SE provides extensive property management services. These include overseeing real estate operations, managing rent, handling tenant payments, assessing property depreciation risks, and supervising tenant activities. The company is also involved in the energy sector, undertaking the management and refurbishment of energy resources, conducting technical and energy building audits, constructing and maintaining gas stations, and distributing electricity. Moreover, their comprehensive service portfolio spans asset management, real estate management, supply chain management, and various construction and engineering activities. Supplementary services include IT support, security solutions, accommodation provisions, debt recovery, insurance, energy efficiency programs, and full-scale elevator services, from installation to ongoing maintenance and technical support.

name: Captor Therapeutics Spolka Akcyjna
summary: Captor Therapeutics Spolka Akcyjna, a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the discovery and development of protein degradation drugs for cancer and autoimmune diseases. The company provides Targeted Protein Degradation technology that overcomes many existing drug limitations by removing proteins resistant to available therapeutics. Its products in various stages of development include CT-03, which has completed the Phase 1 clinical trials for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer, triple-negative breast cancer, as well as cancers of the blood, lymphatic system, and bone marrow; and CT-01, which also completed the Phase 1 clinical trials for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma, through degradation of oncofetal transcription factor. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Czerwona Torebka S.A.
summary: Czerwona Torebka Spólka Akcyjna engages in the real estate business in Poland. Its real estate portfolio includes commercial, and land investment projects. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Poznan, Poland.

name: Dadelo S.A.
summary: Dadelo S.A. operates as an online bicycle shop. The company offers its products under the categories of bicycles, bicycle parts, accessories, and clothing through dadelo.pl, an online store. It provides a selection of two-wheelers covering children's, city, cross, trekking, and specialized road and MTB; accessories for cheaper bicycles, and components; and wheels and shock absorbers. The company also offers various accessories consisting of helmets and pumps; and wireless meters, navigations, cameras, and power measurements. In addition, it provides cycling and tourist clothing, as well as footwear. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Bydgoszcz, Poland.

name: DataWalk S.A.
summary: DataWalk S.A. operates as a software company in Poland. The company offers DataWalk, a software platform for data blending, analysis, and investigations. Its solutions include anti-money laundering, bank fraud, insurance fraud, intelligence analysis software, law enforcement, procurement fraud, analytics sandbox, and rapid deployment data analysis platform. The company is based in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Tire Company Debica S.A.
summary: Firma Oponiarska Debica S.A. manufactures and sells passenger, commercial, and truck tires under the Debica, Goodyear, Dunlop, Fulda, and Sava brands in Poland. It also offers curing membranes that are used to make tires for planes, motorcycles, farming vehicles, passenger cars, and trucks. The company sells its products through tire distributors, a franchising network, and tire service stations, as well as online stores. It also exports tires to Luxembourg, Germany, Turkey, the United States, Canada, and France. The company was formerly known as Stomil Debica Spólka Akcyjna and changed its name to Firma Oponiarska Debica S.A. in November 1993. The company was founded in 1937 and is based in Debica, Poland. Firma Oponiarska Debica S.A. is a subsidiary of Goodyear S.A.

name: DB Energy S.A.
summary: DB Energy S.A. specializes in optimizing energy usage and promoting conservation. The company delivers in-depth energy efficiency assessments and audit services tailored for medium and large industrial sectors. Beyond consultations, DB Energy provides a diverse portfolio of energy solutions, including modern lighting systems, cogeneration technology, solar photovoltaic installations, industrial drives, various energy generation sources, and optimized compressed air systems. Established in 2009, its main office is located in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Decora S.A.
summary: Decora S.A. engages in the production, distribution, sale, and export of flooring products and accessories in Poland. The company offers vinyl flooring, underlays, skirting boards, and floor profiles. The company markets its products under the Arbiton, Afirmax, Vidella, and Ewifoam brands. Decora S.A. was founded in 1994 and is based in Sroda Wielkopolska, Poland.

name: Dekpol S.a.
summary: Dekpol S.A. primary engages in the general contracting and steel structures and equipment businesses in Poland.
