The company constructs industrial, public utility, sports and recreational facilities; environmental protection facilities; sanitary, road and hydrotechnical works; produces buckets and integrated accessories for machines; and engages in sells of housing estates, single-family housing estates, luxury apartment buildings, condo and aparthotels as well as commercial and service areas. It also manufactures steel structures and equipment for construction machines. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Zblewo, Poland.

name: Delko S.A.
summary: Delko S.A., a Polish enterprise, is primarily involved in the wholesale supply of various consumer products, encompassing household chemicals, cosmetics, and personal hygiene items. The company facilitates the distribution of its goods through an extensive network of independent distributors and other wholesale partners. Established in 1995, Delko S.A. is headquartered in Srem, Poland.

name: DGA Spólka Akcyjna
summary: DGA Spólka Akcyjna, a consulting and investment firm founded in 1990 and headquartered in Poznan, Poland, offers a broad spectrum of services. The company provides business advisory, including corporate restructuring, rehabilitation strategies, management of business bankruptcy processes, merger and acquisition facilitation, company succession planning, and preparing businesses for sale. Its project management division handles securing new projects, overseeing the complete execution of training programs, educational and advisory initiatives, career guidance, job placement, and psychological support. DGA also offers specialized consultancy in computer hardware, general business operations, and management strategies. Beyond its core consulting activities, the company engages in educational assistance, various financial intermediation services, the management of trusts, funds, and similar financial institutions, alternative education formats, data processing, internet portal operations, and database-related services.

name: DRAGO entertainment Spólka Akcyjna
summary: DRAGO entertainment Spólka Akcyjna is a Polish video game developer primarily focused on creating and developing computer games for the PC platform. Their diverse portfolio showcases titles such as Winter Survival, Gas Station Simulator, Food Truck Simulator, Treasure Hunter Simulator, Detector Simulator, Airport Contraband, and RedFrost. Founded in 1998, the company's main operations are based in Kraków, Poland.

name: Digital Network S.A.
summary: Digital Network SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in media and advertising business in Poland and internationally. The company provides digital outdoor advertising services; and consulting services. It also provides digital content created by naEkranie.pl website. In addition, the company engages in the distribution, support, and marketing of thematic TV channels, as well as marketing and promotional activities for customers. Digital Network SA was formerly known as 4fun Media S.A. and changed its name to Digital Network SA in April 2022. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Warsaw, Poland. Digital Network SA operates as a subsidiary of Epicom Ltd.

name: Dr. Miele Cosmed Group S.A.
summary: Dr. Miele Cosmed Group S.A., founded in 1990 and headquartered in Radom, Poland, is actively involved in the global production and distribution of a diverse array of chemical and cosmetic products. Their extensive portfolio includes personal hygiene items such as shower gels, liquid soaps, and sanitizing gels and sprays, alongside a dedicated range for children encompassing washing and care cosmetics, wet wipes, and laundry detergents. The company also manufactures household cleaning essentials, offering toilet cleaners, toilet blocks, drain openers (in granule and gel form), washing liquids, fabric softening concentrates, and specific agents for kitchen and bathroom cleaning, as well as hand and surface disinfectants. These offerings are prominently marketed under brands like Bobini, Apart, Biophen, Mole, Sofin, Izo, and Izozid. The company officially adopted its current name, Dr. Miele Cosmed Group S.A., in March 2024, having previously operated as Global Cosmed S.A.

name: Dino Polska S.A.
summary: Dino Polska S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates a chain of mid-sized grocery supermarkets under the Dino name in Poland. The company offers range of food products, including meat, poultry and cold cuts, fruit and vegetables, bakery, and dairy products, as well as other food, chemical, and cosmetic products; grocery products, such as children's food, breakfast products, ready to eat meals, beverages, candies, snacks, frozen goods, processed goods, oils, grain and bulk products, condiments, and alcohol and cigarettes; and non-grocery products, which include flowers, cleaning agents, sanitary articles, pet food and small household appliance products. It is also involved in producing, processing, and preserving of meat products; investments in properties, shares, and bonds; renting and operating of own or leased real estate; private purchase and sale of real estate; and manufacturing and processing of refined petroleum products and retail sale of automotive fuels, as well as provision of warehousing and storage, and financial services. As of March 31, 2021, the company operated 1,532 stores. Dino Polska S.A. was founded in 2007 and is based in Krotoszyn, Poland.

name: Dom Development S.A.
summary: Dom Development S.A. is a Polish residential developer focused on building and selling apartments and houses in Warsaw, Wrocław, Tricity and Kraków. The company is involved in all stages of the development process, from land acquisition to construction and sales. Dom Development is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Digitree Group S.A.
summary: Digitree Group S.A. provides advertising services in Poland. It operates through SARE, Digital Media, E-Commerce Software House, and Agency Digital segments. The company offers contact lead generation and verification, strategic consulting, digital marketing, databases, SEM and SEO, influence campaigns, mailing campaigns, display campaigns, databases and WWW monetization, creation and copy, mobile campaigns, and ecommerce implementations. The company was formerly known as SARE S.A. Digitree Group S.A. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Rybnik, Poland. Digitree Group S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Polinvest 7 S.a.r.l.

name: Develia S.A.
summary: Develia S.A., through its subsidiaries, buys, develops, rents, manages, and sells real estate properties in Poland. It undertakes the development of commercial and residential investment projects located in Warsaw, Wroclaw, Kraków, Katowice, Gdansk, and Lódz. The company was formerly known as LC Corp S.A. and changed its name to Develia S.A. in September 2019. Develia S.A. was founded in 2006 and is based in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: ESOTIQ & Henderson S.A.
summary: ESOTIQ & Henderson S.A. is a company specializing in the creation, production, and sale of clothing and cosmetic goods, serving both the Polish domestic market and international customers. Under its ESOTIQ, HENDERSON, and ESOTIQ FORMULA brands, the company offers a diverse range of products for men and women, including intimate apparel, undershirts, sleepwear, robes, swimwear, and accessories. The company distributes its merchandise through a network of 270 owned and franchised retail stores, as well as via independent distributors and franchisees. Founded in 1998, ESOTIQ & Henderson S.A. has its headquarters located in Gdansk, Poland.

name: AmRest Holdings SE
summary: AmRest Holdings SE, through its subsidiaries, operates and manages quick service and casual dining restaurants in Central and Eastern Europe, Western Europe, Russia, and China. It operates Kentucky Fried Chicken, Pizza Hut, Burger King, and Starbucks restaurants on the basis of franchise agreements. The company also operates its own restaurant under the La Tagliatella brand name, as well as Blue Frog and KABB brand names. In addition, it provides on-site catering services; take away services; drive-in services at special sales points; and deliveries for orders placed online or by telephone. As of December 31, 2020, it operated 2,337 restaurants. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Madrid, Spain. AmRest Holdings SE is a subsidiary of Fcapital Dutch B.V.

name: Erste Bank Polska S.A.
summary: Santander Bank Polska S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services for individuals, small or medium-sized enterprises, and corporate clients. It offers saving, escrow, foreign currency, company, agribusiness, and systematic accounts; cash, home, mortgage, investment, revolving, business vehicle, and technology loans, as well as agro investment, construction, bridging, production, disaster, and land loans; debit, credit, and business cards; and payment terminals, overdraft facility, and electronic and internet banking services. The company also provides term, structured, short term, and currency deposits; insurance products; and personal finances, investment advisory services, investment funds, brokerage, and global banking services. In addition, it offers foreign trade services, including bank guarantees, payments, documentary and financial collection, and foreign and own letter of credit; forfaiting and currency exchange; and leasing of machines and devices, passenger cars, auto, and truck. Further, the company provides transaction support and liquidity management services; arable land, ongoing, and investment financing; export, import, foreign trade guarantees, working capital financing, and debt capital and capital market services; and correspondence banking, trade financing, and fiduciary services, as well as global transaction services for bank. It operates through a network 665 outlets, as well as 1700 ATMs and cash deposit machines in Poland. The company was formerly known as Bank Zachodni WBK S.A. and changed its name to Santander Bank Polska S.A. in September 2018. The company was founded in 1857 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Santander Bank Polska S.A. is a subsidiary of Banco Santander S.A.

name: Echo Investment S.A.
summary: Echo Investment S.A. engages in the construction, lease, and sale of office, retail, and residential buildings in Poland. It sells residential and commercial spaces within residential projects; The company also trades in real estate properties; and rents apartments. In addition, it provides advisory, managerial, legal, and other services; organization and management of tenders for construction works, and supervision and coordination of construction works, as well as customer services; and brokerage, accounting, legal, consulting, IT, financial, marketing, and other services. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Kielce, Poland. Echo Investment S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Lisala Sp. z o.o.

name: ED Invest Spólka Akcyjna
summary: ED Invest Spólka Akcyjna is a Polish real estate developer focused on residential and commercial projects. Headquartered in Warsaw and established in 2003, the company specializes in constructing and selling a diverse range of properties, including apartments, multi-family residences, single-family homes, and service-oriented buildings.

name: Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A.
summary: Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A., established in 1989 and headquartered in Kraków, Poland, operates a diverse business model encompassing real estate and an array of commercial and industrial services. Primarily, the company specializes in leasing and renting various properties, including commercial units. Beyond its real estate focus, it delivers a broad spectrum of services such as business and management consulting, advertising, and other commercial endeavors. The company also demonstrates a commitment to environmental initiatives, offering design and advisory services for ecological protection and investing in pro-environmental projects. Financially, Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A. is active in the financial instruments market. Its commercial activities extend internationally, covering wholesale and retail trade in foreign markets, alongside the import and export of goods and services. It also functions as a commercial broker, facilitating commodity sales and stock exchange transactions. Furthermore, the company manages warehousing facilities and provides stock exchange management services. Its operational scope includes comprehensive transport, forwarding, reloading, and repair services. A key part of its enterprise involves organizing and managing production activities, with a particular emphasis on rural and agricultural sectors. The company also owns and operates hotels and a shopping complex. Initially known as Przedsiebiorstwo Transportu i Uslug 'efekt' S.A., the company officially adopted the name Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A. in 1992.

name: Eurohold Bulgaria AD
summary: Established in 1995 and headquartered in Sofia, Bulgaria, Eurohold Bulgaria AD manages a diversified business portfolio through its subsidiaries. The company maintains a substantial international presence, operating predominantly across Bulgaria, Romania, North Macedonia, Ukraine, Greece, Georgia, Italy, Spain, Belarus, Poland, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and Russia. Its operations are structured across four core segments: Insurance, Energy, Financial Services, and Car Sales. The Insurance division offers a comprehensive range of products, including life and health coverage, alongside various non-life policies such as liability, property, medical, transport, accident, and travel assistance. Within the Financial Services segment, Eurohold provides investment intermediation and asset management, encompassing brokerage, investment banking, and active asset management. This segment also facilitates currency trading, offers advisory services for mergers and acquisitions, and delivers other bespoke investment solutions for corporate and institutional clients. The Car Sales segment is involved in the retail of new motor vehicles, motorcycles, scooters, and used cars, complemented by sales of spare parts, lubricants, and accessories. It also provides car repair and rental services, in addition to offering financial and operating leasing options for vehicles. In the Energy sector, the company focuses on the generation, transmission, trading, and distribution of electricity to industrial and business consumers. Furthermore, Eurohold extends its services to include various information, communication, and technological offerings. Eurohold Bulgaria AD operates as a subsidiary of Starcom Holding AD.

name: Elkop SE
summary: Elkop SE is a Polish firm active in the property market. Its business involves developing single-family residential communities in Katowice, alongside the acquisition and rental of various commercial, office, and industrial premises. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Plock, Poland.

name: Elektrotim S.A.
summary: Elektrotim S.A., founded in Wroclaw, Poland, in 1998, is a specialist provider of installation, network, high-voltage, and project management services across Poland. The company offers a wide array of installation services, covering everything from electrical switchgears and power distribution wiring to crucial electrical measurements, grounding, and lightning protection systems. Their expertise also extends to various lighting solutions (internal and external), temporary power supply setups, building automation, and blower/compressor installations. In addition to initial installations, Elektrotim provides maintenance services for traffic engineering infrastructure, including traffic lights, illumination systems, and sanitary networks. A significant portion of their work focuses on high-voltage systems, encompassing the modernization, redevelopment, and construction of HV/MV substations, as well as the deployment of HV cables and overhead lines. They are also skilled in building and upgrading traction substations, rectifier stations, and sectional cabins vital for powering tram, trolleybus, railway, and underground train lines. Beyond electrical infrastructure, Elektrotim delivers sophisticated security and telecommunications solutions. This includes integrating computer systems (BMS and SMS), structured cabling, fire alarm systems, access control, closed-circuit television (CCTV), technical protection, working time registration, perimeter protection, EiB systems, and comprehensive telecommunication networks. Furthermore, the company specializes in airport systems, offering services for heliports, navigational and obstruction lighting, baggage transport, aircraft braking systems, radio navigation, antenna systems, weather monitoring, and general electrical/tele-technical installations. Their airport offerings also feature concrete products, edge lamp markers, wind direction indicators, and overall security system integration for these complex facilities.

name: Enea S.A.
summary: Enea S.A. is a Polish energy group that operates in the electricity generation, distribution, and sales sectors. The company's business model includes electricity production from conventional and renewable sources, as well as the distribution and sale of electricity to households and businesses. Enea S.A. is headquartered in Poznan, Poland.

name: Centrum Medyczne ENEL-MED S.A.
summary: Centrum Medyczne ENEL-MED S.A., a prominent healthcare provider established in 1993, operates from its Warsaw, Poland base, offering an extensive array of medical services nationwide. These provisions encompass specialized consultations, dentistry, orthopedics, infertility treatments, physical rehabilitation, psychological support, and comprehensive diagnostic capabilities. Additionally, they provide vaccinations, emergency care, and surgical interventions to their patients.

name: Energa S.A.
summary: ENERGA SA AA ZY 10,92: Energa SA is a Polish energy company involved in the generation, distribution, and sale of electricity. The company's operations include coal-fired power plants, renewable energy sources, and electricity distribution networks. Energa SA is headquartered in Gdańsk, Poland.

name: Energoinstal S.A.
summary: Energoinstal S.A. is a Polish enterprise with an international presence, primarily engaged in the fabrication, distribution, and commissioning of power generation boilers. Beyond industrial and energy-sector boilers, their extensive product portfolio encompasses a range of essential components, including oil and gas combustion systems, pressure regulation and metering units for gas and oil, specialized finned and cladded tubes, pressure vessels, and structural steel elements. They also provide heat pipeline parts, ventilation and dust extraction ductwork complete with flaps, and other specialized industrial equipment tailored to unique requirements. Energoinstal offers a comprehensive suite of services, from the assembly, upkeep, and repair of diverse boiler types – including those for energy, industrial steam, water, biofuels, waste treatment, oil/gas-fired, heat recovery steam generators, and coal-fired units – to their auxiliary components. Their expertise extends to broader infrastructure, covering boiler houses, support structures for boilers and industrial buildings, environmental protection systems, heat pipelines, and various utility networks such as central heating, water and sewage, process heat, chilled water, ventilation, air conditioning, and dedusting systems. Additionally, they provide stainless steel products and systems for the food, chemical, and construction industries, alongside thermal insulation solutions. The company further provides engineering and project management services, encompassing the design and oversight of steel structures, power generation apparatus, and technological installations. As a general contractor, they manage the construction of entire industrial facilities and combined heat and power (CHP) plants. Energoinstal is also active in research and development, particularly in material science, welding techniques, and the heat treatment of materials. They conduct comprehensive testing of metal properties and welded joints. Additionally, Energoinstal delivers diverse training programs for corporate clients, public institutions, educational facilities, and individuals, including specialized vocational training for welders. The firm distinguishes itself with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as hybrid welding for sheet pile panels, laser welding for finned tubes, and robotic systems for precision laser cutting. Energoinstal caters to clients within the energy and construction sectors, along with the electrical machinery markets. Established in 1949 and headquartered in Katowice, Poland, Energoinstal S.A. operates as a subsidiary of W.A.M. Sp. z o.o.

name: Energoaparatura S.A.
summary: Energoaparatura SA operates in construction and installation market in Poland. It offers central failure signaling products, transformer voltage controllers, automatic power switching systems, tap change position indicators, non-inductive resistors, switch redundancy automated systems, bus-bar differential protection systems, converters, relays, service cases, and programmable control systems. The company also provides mining equipment; and prefabrication, measurement, and commissioning services. It serves electricity, electrical power engineering, control and measurement instrument, automation, and mining sectors. The company is headquartered in Katowice, Poland.

name: Enter Air Sp. z o.o.
summary: Enter Air Sp. z o.o. operates as a charter airline company in Poland. The company offers passenger air transportation services to various holiday destinations, including Egypt, Greece, Turkey, Tunisia, and Spain. It operates a fleet of 19 Boeing 737-800 aircraft and 2 B737 MAX 8 aircraft. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Warsaw, Poland. Enter Air Sp. z o.o. is a subsidiary of Enter Air S.A.

name: Equnico SE
summary: Equnico SE, along with its various subsidiaries, operates within the construction sector across Estonia, Poland, Uzbekistan, and the broader Central and Eastern European region. The company's extensive construction activities encompass the development of civil engineering projects and the erection of reinforced concrete structures. It also specializes in producing mineral-asphalt mixtures for road foundations and manufacturing steel structures designed for power, industrial, and civil utility networks. Furthermore, Equnico SE undertakes the construction and modernization of power line installations and power stations, as well as supplying essential materials and equipment for infrastructure investments. Beyond its core building operations, the firm offers a range of auxiliary services, including office management, telecommunications, financial advice, consulting, courier delivery, and marketing support. Its diverse clientele includes businesses in construction, energy, transport, and waste storage and disposal, alongside both private individuals and corporate clients. Originally established in 1950 as Resbud SE, the company officially changed its name to Equnico SE in September 2024 and maintains its headquarters in Modlniczka, Poland.

name: Erbud S.A.
summary: Erbud S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction business in European Union countries. It operates through Residential/Commercial Buildings at Home, Residential/Commercial Buildings in Foreign Countries, Road Engineering, Industrial Construction at Home, Industrial Construction in Foreign Countries, and Other segments. The company's projects include offices, shopping centers, power industry, industrial buildings and facilities, residential buildings, public utilities, hotels, and hospitals. Erbud S.A. was founded in 1990 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: ERG Spólka Akcyjna
summary: ERG Spólka Akcyjna, a Polish manufacturing firm, specializes in the production of plastic films, injection-molded goods, and various types of adhesive tapes. Its extensive range of film products includes collective bags designed for packaging and preserving both food items and sanitary goods, alongside bags tailored for diverse uses such as holding coal, sawdust, industrial commodities, domestic appliances, electronic and paper goods, rubber materials, and apparel. Additionally, ERG supplies specialized bag inserts for large 'big-bag' containers; perforated films suitable for packaging bulk materials; integral tapes for pull-string closure bags; protective hoods for palletized merchandise; bags featuring convenient tear-off perforations; small-format breakfast bags; refuse and sanitary waste bags; liners for transport crates; and robust foils engineered for sealing paper, cement, and other granular construction materials. The company's portfolio of injection-molded items encompasses battery enclosures, durable transport containers, components for battery cell discharge, crates for bakery and dairy products, heavy-duty construction pails, refuse bins with hinged covers, and spools for winding various materials. Furthermore, ERG manufactures a selection of tapes, including paper-based masking tapes, self-adhesive printed polypropylene tapes, and general-purpose polypropylene packaging tapes. Its primary clientele spans sectors such as food processing, beverage production, automotive manufacturing, and printing. The company also engages in international export of its merchandise. Established in 1896, ERG Spólka Akcyjna operates from its headquarters in Dabrowa Górnicza, Poland.

name: ENEFI Vagyonkezelo Nyrt.
summary: ENEFI Vagyonkezelo Nyilvánosan Mukodo Részvénytársaság operates as an alternative energy company. The company provides heat supply services, district heating supply services, public lighting systems, and renewable technologies. The company was formerly known as ENEFI Energiahatékonysági Nyrt. ENEFI Vagyonkezelo Nyilvánosan Mukodo Részvénytársaság was founded in 2000 and is based in Budapest, Hungary.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Eurotel S.A.
summary: Eurotel S.A., established in 1996 and headquartered in Gdansk, Poland, is a prominent retail company operating across Poland. The firm specializes in managing sales outlets for telecommunications service providers and consumer electronics manufacturers. They serve as an authorized reseller for key brands such as Apple, T-Mobile, NC+, and Play. Eurotel's expansive network includes 11 iDream-branded Apple Premium Reseller stores, supported by 5 dedicated hardware repair centers. Additionally, the company manages 106 T-Mobile mobile phone showrooms, 37 retail locations for the NC+ satellite antenna service, and 94 showrooms for the Play mobile operator.

name: Europejskie Centrum Odszkodowan S.A.
summary: Europejskie Centrum Odszkodowan S.A. (EUC.WA) is dedicated to helping accident victims and their families claim financial settlements from insurance carriers. The company provides its services in Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, and Romania. Founded in 2004, its main office is situated in Legnica, Poland.

name: Eurocash S.A.
summary: Eurocash S.A. distributes fast moving consumer goods (FMCG) in Poland. The company operates through Wholesale, Retail, and Projects segments. Its FMCG products include food products, soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, tobacco products, and household chemicals and cosmetics. The company markets its products to traditional retail stores, including small supermarkets, grocery stores, and specialized grocery stores; and kiosks, retail outlets, and convenience stores at petrol stations, restaurants, hotels, cafeterias, and catering outlets. As of December 31, 2019, it operated a network of 180 Cash & Carry warehouses; 1,351 Delikatesy Centrum network supermarkets; 450 Inmedio press salons; 8,985 abc network grocery stores; and 5,133 franchise and partner stores of Eurocash distribution. Eurocash S.A. is headquartered in Komorniki, Poland.

name: Fabrity Holding S.A.
summary: Fabrity Holding S.A., a Warsaw-based Polish company established in 1997, specializes in delivering comprehensive technology and marketing solutions. Their expertise is rooted in leveraging artificial intelligence (AI), Big Data analytics, and advanced software development. Their marketing offerings are broad, encompassing precision marketing strategies like e-commerce optimization, programmatic advertising, SEO/SEM, sophisticated analytics, multiscreen performance management, and social media campaigns. They also provide business intelligence and marketing automation solutions. Beyond this, Fabrity excels in crafting integrated campaigns, managing digital communication, conducting strategic analyses, developing robust brand strategies, and designing compelling brand experiences, including ATL and social media engagement. A significant area of their technological prowess lies in chatbot services, facilitating customer service automation and leveraging conversational AI platforms such as Google Dialogflow, LiveChat, and Genesys PureCloud. Their digital and tech capabilities extend to consulting, UI/UX design, mobile and web application development, process optimization, custom software creation, and data science expertise. They also offer outsourcing and managed services. Other key activities include the design of digital products and services, the deployment of CMS platforms, creating measurable business value from data, offering premium managed hosting, conducting usability design and research, implementing e-commerce solutions, and strategies to enhance user engagement and conversion rates. The company previously operated as K2 Holding S.A., adopting the name Fabrity Holding S.A. in August 2023.

name: Feerum S.A.
summary: Feerum S.A. engages in the production, sale, and assembly of grain dryers, silos, and other equipment for agricultural production storage and drying complexes. The company offers general contracting, professional support, and consulting services; flat-bottomed, hopper-bottomed, hopper-bottomed with internal basket and open funnel, forwarding, square, non-standard, with assimmetric cone, with sided discharge, with flat metal sheet lining, and grain cooler silos; and continuous flow, SG, FTD, and batch flow dryers. It also provides air separators; cleaners, including control panel with inverter, aspiration of the sieve drum, cyclone, fan, and air channels; automatics; bucket elevators, straight chain conveyors, belt conveyors, screw conveyors, silo screw auger, supporting structure, as well as arched, diagonal, z-type chain conveyors; and sheds, and halls and warehouses. In addition, the company offers electric, pneumatic, and manual distributors; pipes, elbows, reductions, symmetrical, and asymmetrical three-way distribution valves and cross-pieces; swivel rings; vertical and angled brakes; electric, pneumatic, and manual bars; rotary valve separators; percentage selectors; and performance regulators. It offers its products for grain drying, vertical and horizontal transport, cooling systems, automatic control of the process of reception, and drying and storing grain. The company operates in Poland, Ukraine, Lithuania, Romania, Hungary, and internationally. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Chojnów, Poland. Feerum S.A. is a subsidiary of Danmag Sp. z o.o.

name: FoodHub Spolka Akcyjna
summary: FoodHub Spolka Akcyjna is a Polish company primarily engaged in the distribution of various food products across the country. Its diverse product portfolio includes convenient pre-prepared meals, preserved foods, an assortment of soups, and delectable pates. Established in 1993, the firm's headquarters are situated in Rusiec, Poland. While currently operating under the name Pamapol S.A., the organization is scheduled to officially transition to FoodHub Spolka Akcyjna in October 2025. Pamapol S.A. functions as a subsidiary of AMERYKANKA STRUKTURA Spolka z ograniczona odpowiedzialnoscia S.K.A.

name: Wise Energy S.A.
summary: Based in Warsaw, Poland, Wise Energy S.A. is a multifaceted company with its core business centered on the sale of electricity throughout Poland. Its operational scope, however, extends significantly beyond power, encompassing a broad range of sectors. The firm is actively involved in financial services, offering loan provision and monetary intermediation, alongside telecommunication services. Additionally, Wise Energy manages data processing, website operations, and real estate. Within the energy domain, its activities span the entire electricity value chain, from generation and transmission to distribution and trading. It also participates in the production, network-based distribution, and commercialization of gaseous fuels. Completing its diverse portfolio, the company provides rental and leasing options for passenger vehicles and vans. Notably, the entity rebranded as Wise Energy S.A. in October 2024, previously being known as ONE S.A.

name: FON SE
summary: Based in Tallinn, Estonia, FON SE is a financial services provider with both domestic and international operations. The company primarily extends cash loans to a varied customer base, including individual consumers, small enterprises, and micro and small businesses. Additionally, FON SE is active in capital investment ventures.

name: Ferro S.a.
summary: FERRO S.A. is a manufacturer and distributor of plumbing fittings and heating system elements, serving markets across Central and Eastern Europe. Its extensive product portfolio for sanitary installations encompasses a variety of items such as faucets, shower systems, sinks, and a wide range of bathroom accessories, including shower trays, bathtubs, and specialized sanitary ware designed for public facilities. In the heating sector, the company offers a comprehensive selection of solutions. This includes water valves, measurement and gas fittings, control and expansion vessels, solar and PEX systems, clamp couplings, brass fittings, pumps, heat controls, manifolds, radiator accessories, radiators, thermostatic valves, and service accessories. Additionally, it provides advanced components like exchanger-pumping sets, plate exchangers, and differential and mixing valves. FERRO S.A. markets its products under its proprietary brands: FERRO, Metalia, and Titania. The company's corporate headquarters are located in Skawina, Poland.

name: Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Górniczych Grupa Kapitalowa FASING S.A.
summary: Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Górniczych Grupa Kapitalowa FASING S.A. produces and sells chains for the mining, fishing, energy, sugar, cement, and wood industries worldwide. The company provides round mining link chains, flat mining link chains, chain routes, scrapers, cards, locks, and clamps, hoist chains, connector links, abrasion-resistant round chains, technical chains and accessories, fishing chains, and sling chains with short links. It also offers die forgings and forging tools, clutches, drills, anchors, hydraulic units, stands and others. The company exports its products to China, the United States, Australia, Russia, Germany, Sweden, Kazakhstan, Ukraine, and Belarus. Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Górniczych Grupa Kapitalowa FASING S.A. was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Katowice, Poland. Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Górniczych Grupa Kapitalowa FASING S.A. is a subsidiary of Karbon 2 Sp. z o.o.

name: Grupa Forte Spolka S.A.
summary: Fabryki Mebli FORTE S.A. designs, manufactures, and exports furniture worldwide. The company offers furniture for dining room, living room, youth room, office, hall, and bedroom. It markets its products through retail chains and furniture stores in Europe. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Ostrów Mazowiecka, Poland.

name: Gaming Factory S.A.
summary: Gaming Factory S.A. develops, publishes, and distributes computer games worldwide. It offers games for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch platforms. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A.
summary: Established in Bydgoszcz, Poland, in 1868, Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A. (which operated as MAKRUM S.A. until its renaming in 2014) is a diversified Polish conglomerate. The company's key operational areas across Poland include industrial machinery manufacturing, property development and construction, hotel management, real estate holdings, and retail trade. In the machine industry, the group specializes in producing crushing and grinding equipment crucial for various sectors, such as cement, paper, mining, food processing, energy production, and chemical manufacturing. Its construction and development segment undertakes the design and erection of a wide array of structures, including production halls, warehouses, industrial and commercial facilities, office buildings, shopping centers, supermarkets, and residential properties. This division also provides property development and construction consultancy services. Within the real estate sector, the company owns and manages properties specifically for commercial leasing. The hospitality arm operates a network of hotels situated in major Polish cities, such as Sopot, Poznan, Bydgoszcz, Lódz, Szczecin, Gdansk, Chorzow, and Inowroclaw. Furthermore, Grupa Kapitalowa IMMOBILE S.A. offers general contracting, specialized docking solutions, and advanced automatic parking systems.

name: Genomtec S.A.
summary: Genomtec S.A., established in 2016 and based in Wroclaw, Poland, is dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and global commercialization of advanced molecular diagnostic products. The company's expertise lies in optical systems and isothermal nucleic acid amplification methodologies. A core offering is Genomtec ID, a portable technological device designed for on-the-go genetic diagnostics. This system employs streamlined nucleic acid amplification technology (SNAAT) to detect viruses, bacteria, fungi, and genetic mutations through the analysis of patient biological materials like swabs, urine, saliva, blood, and other bodily fluids. Furthermore, Genomtec has developed Genomtec Tumor, a SNAAT-based solution for identifying neoplastic mutations and those with prognostic value in cancer diagnoses. The company also offers diagnostic kits for COVID-19, including the Genomtec SARS-CoV-2 EvaGreen and Direct-RT-LAMP CE-IVD Kit, which detects SARS-CoV-2 RNA in samples from individuals suspected of infection, and the Genomtec RT-LAMP CE-IVD Duo-Kit, capable of identifying all variants of the SARS-CoV-2 virus.

name: Gobarto S.A.
summary: Gobarto S.A. operates as a Polish entity with an international reach, focusing on the processing, manufacturing, and supply of various meats, including pork, beef, poultry, and game. In addition to its primary meat business, the company oversees a breeding facility for limousine cattle. Its operations also encompass the cultivation and commercialization of agricultural commodities like rapeseed, rye, wheat, and corn. Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, the firm was known as Polski Koncern Miesny DUDA S.A. until its rebranding to Gobarto S.A. in June 2016. It functions as a subsidiary of Cedrob S.A.

name: Games Operators S.A.
summary: Games Operators SA engages in the production and distribution of video games. It offers video games for mobile platforms and computer operating systems. The company's products include such video games as BE-A Walker, 112 Operator, Counter Terrorist Agency, Radio Commander, 911 Operator, and other games. The company was founded by Bartlomiej Kamil Gajewski on December 30, 2015 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Grupa Pracuj S.A.
summary: Operating within the digital job market, Grupa Pracuj S.A. serves clients in both Poland and Ukraine. The company manages a diverse portfolio of online platforms, such as Pracuj.pl and Robota.ua, which are general recruitment websites. It also provides Dryg.pl, tailored for manual workers; Theprotocol.it, dedicated to IT professionals; and eRecruiter, a robust system for optimizing recruitment workflows. This Warsaw, Poland-based company was established in the year 2000.

name: Gielda Papierów Wartosciowych w Warszawie S.A.
summary: Gielda Papierów Wartosciowych w Warszawie S.A., along with its affiliated entities, operates a stock exchange both in Poland and on an international scale. Its operations are divided across three key divisions: Financial, Commodity, and Other. The company facilitates transactions in a diverse range of financial instruments, including equities, equity-linked products, various cash market instruments such as structured products, investment certificates, and exchange-traded fund units. It also handles derivative financial tools, a broad spectrum of bonds (corporate, municipal, co-operative, treasury, and mortgage), and other debt instruments. Beyond traditional financial assets, GPW also manages trading for agricultural commodities, electricity, natural gas, property rights tied to electricity origin certificates, and CO2 emission allowances. The company provides essential services like listing and market information. Furthermore, it functions as a market operator and balancing service provider for electricity traders, producers, and industrial clients, and offers trade operator and balancing entity services. It is responsible for the calculation and distribution of WIBID and WIBOR benchmarks. Its offerings also include capital market education, promotional and informational services, and training, alongside the leasing of office premises. Additionally, GPW manages the Register of Certificates of Origin for electricity and the Register of Guarantees of Origin, and operates a settlement system for commodities traded on its exchanges. It oversees a variety of trading platforms, notably the GPW Main Market, NewConnect, Catalyst, and Treasury BondSpot Poland, as well as markets run by Towarowa Gielda Energii S.A. and InfoEngine S.A. Founded in 1991, Gielda Papierów Wartosciowych w Warszawie S.A. is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Grodno Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Grodno Spólka Akcyjna distributes electrotechnical and lighting articles under the Luno brand in Poland. The company's products are used in air conditioning, ventilations, and heating applications. It also provides specialized advice, energy, and lighting audits services. In addition, the company undertakes lighting, illumination, and photovoltaics projects. Further, it provides training in the field of photovoltaics, lighting control, security and automation, programming controllers, intelligent installations, and others. It serves electrical and industrial installations companies; storehouses, hotels, and offices; and individual customers. Grodno Spólka Akcyjna was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Nieporet, Poland.

name: GreenX Metals Limited
summary: GreenX Metals Limited, headquartered in Perth, concentrates on discovering and evaluating an arctic rift copper project in Greenland. Established in 1957, it changed its name from Prairie Mining Limited in December 2021.

name: Globe Trade Centre S.A.
summary: Globe Trade Centre S.A. is a real estate company focused on property development and investment in Central and Eastern Europe. Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, the company develops and manages office and retail properties.

name: Getin Holding S.A.
summary: Getin Holding S.A., a financial holding company founded in 1996 and based in Wroclaw, Poland (originally Getin Service Provider S.A. until its name change in July 2003), conducts investment activities across Poland and globally. The company provides a comprehensive suite of financial services to both individual clients and small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Its offerings encompass traditional banking products such as deposit accounts, credit cards, cash and car loans, and various guarantees and sureties. Getin Holding also furnishes diverse investment and financial products, alongside legal, debt collection, and advisory services. Furthermore, the company specializes in tailored financing solutions, including credit facilities for medical equipment providers, leasing arrangements for hospitals, and loans specifically for purchasing hospital equipment. It also supports buying installments and finances the acquisition of light and heavy vehicles. Additional services comprise debt restructuring, financing for current operational needs, and investment product financing. The company's portfolio is rounded out with insurance brokerage and factoring services.

name: Przedsiebiorstwo Hydrauliki Silowej HYDROTOR S.A.
summary: Established in Tuchola, Poland, in 1945, HYDROTOR S.A. is a company that specializes in the global production and distribution of a comprehensive array of hydraulic components. Their extensive product portfolio features crucial hydraulic elements such as gear motors, PT piston pumps, and torque intensifiers. The firm also provides various hydraulic pumps and motors specifically engineered for use in agricultural tractors, steering units, and other machinery. Complementing these, HYDROTOR S.A. manufactures oil pumps with their corresponding valves, as well as both manual and foot-operated pumps. Their diverse range of mobile cylinders includes piston, plunger, telescopic, and eye-type models, among others. Additionally, the company produces selector valves adhering to RRB, RR, and CETOP standards, alongside essential spare parts like relief valves, valve caps, and solenoid valve coils. Beyond its manufacturing capabilities, HYDROTOR S.A. offers specialized services encompassing measurement, construction, machining, heat treatment, and repair.

name: Helio S.A.
summary: Helio S.A., a Polish enterprise founded in Zaborów in 1992, primarily specializes in the production and commercialization of pre-packaged dried fruits and nuts across Poland. As a subsidiary of Agora S.A., the company markets its extensive product line under the HELIO brand. Their offerings encompass a wide array of nuts, various dried and candied fruits, grains, poppy-seed fillings, fudge caramel masses, cake icings, and microwave popcorn. Helio S.A. distributes its products through major retail chains, wholesale distributors, and independent grocery establishments.

name: Harper Hygienics S.A.
summary: Harper Hygienics S.A., established in Warsaw, Poland, in 1990, is a prominent manufacturer and global distributor of cosmetic and hygienic personal care items. The company's diverse product line caters to women, infants, and children, reaching markets both within Poland and internationally. Their extensive portfolio includes a variety of offerings such as cotton swabs, makeup removers (both pads and wipes), specialized cosmetic buds, and a broad selection of wet wipes, including refreshing, baby, intimate hygiene, and general hand and body wipes. They also provide various disposable wet wipes, cosmetic pads, and hygienic buds. Beyond personal care, Harper Hygienics manufactures specialized cleaning wipes for a range of surfaces like kitchens, bathrooms, windows, mirrors, wooden furniture, anti-electrostatic surfaces, and leather furniture. Other key products comprise nail polish remover pads, cotton pads, and wet tissues. These items are marketed under their proprietary brand names, which include Sweet Sense, Cleanic, Cleanic Kindii, Presto Clean, Nieznost, and Ola, and are also supplied to retail chains under private label agreements.

name: Herkules S.A.
summary: Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, Herkules S.A. primarily operates in the rental of heavy lifting equipment and the transport of oversized loads throughout Poland. The company maintains a diverse fleet of cranes, including tower, field, self-propelled, and tracked models, complemented by engineering, operator, and technical consulting services. Beyond equipment rental, Herkules provides construction and assembly expertise for a wide range of projects, from general structures to wind farms, telecommunications networks, and energy installations. They also engage in manufacturing, producing electrical pylons, reinforced concrete containers, and pre-stressed concrete masts used in the energy, telecommunications, and advertising industries. Additional services encompass general construction, assembly, and electrical work, as well as the specialized installation of wind farm equipment and road-based transport for exceptionally large cargo. Furthermore, Herkules produces a variety of concrete, cement, and plaster products. The company was previously known as Gastel Zurawie S.A. before rebranding as Herkules S.A. in December 2011.

name: Huuuge, Inc.
summary: Huuuge, Inc. operates as a free-to-play games developer and publisher of digital games on mobile and web platforms. It focuses on social casino, casual, and other genres of games. The company's product portfolio includes Huuuge Casino, Billionaire Casino, Stars Slots, Traffic Puzzle, CBG portfolio, Huuuge Bingo Saga, Rogue Land, Coffee Break Games, Huuuge Publishing, Arrows & Empires, and Luna's Quest Bubble Shooter. It also provides in-app advertising services; publishes mobile game applications; and distributes in-house games. In addition, the company provides Coffee Break Games franchise; games advertisement; and games distribution. It serves customers primarily in the United States, Australia, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Canada, the Netherlands, Poland, Switzerland, Italy, Taiwan, Austria, Canada, Japan, and South Africa. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.

name: WISE Finance S.A.
summary: WISE Finance S.A. provides financial solutions in Poland. The company finances working capital, capital expenditures, mergers and acquisitions, and management buyouts through solutions, including debt financing, convertible debts, equity investments, mezzanine financing, and financial and strategic advisory solutions. It also focuses on car fleet management, such as short- and long-term vehicle rental, leasing, and vehicle fleet management solutions. The company serves deep sector knowledge, real estate, energy and renewable energy, transport and logistics, manufacturing, fitness and wellness, telecommunications, and new technologies industries. The company was formerly known as Noble Financials S.A. and changed its name to WISE Finance S.A. in March 2023. WISE Finance S.A. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Medinice S.A.
summary: Established in 2012 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, Medinice S.A. specializes in delivering advanced medical solutions for the fields of cardiology and cardiac surgery. The company actively assists scientists in the complex journey of bringing new products to market, offering comprehensive support that spans prototyping, conducting clinical trials, securing essential certifications, and overseeing product sales.

name: IDM S.A.
summary: IDM Spólka Akcyjna provides consultancy services in the field of real estate investments and receivables in Poland. The company also provides advisory services in the debt and real estate sectors; and capital operations. The company is based in Kraków, Poland. On July 22, 2014, IDM Spólka Akcyjna was declared bankrupt. IDM Spólka Akcyjna is in reorganization.

name: Ifirma S.A.
summary: Ifirma SA specializes in software development, in addition to offering recruitment and outsourcing services for IT personnel. The company also manages the ifirma.pl online platform. Established in 1997, this entity is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland, and was formerly known as Power Media S.A. before rebranding as Ifirma SA in June 2017.

name: Investment Friends SE
summary: Investment Friends SE delivers financial services within Poland, primarily specializing in extending credit to corporate clients. The company, originally established as Budvar Centrum S.A., officially transitioned its name to Investment Friends S.A. in July 2014. Founded in 1997, Investment Friends SE's main office is situated in Tallinn, Estonia.

name: IMC S.A.
summary: IMC S.A. functions as a diversified agricultural enterprise, conducting its integrated operations within Ukraine and on an international scale. The company's activities are organized into three primary divisions: Crop Farming, Dairy Farming, and Elevators and Warehouses. Within its crop farming segment, IMC cultivates a range of produce including corn, sunflowers, wheat, soybeans, potatoes, and various oilseeds. Beyond cultivation, the company is involved in the production of milk and bakery items, engages in broader agricultural and farming production, and participates in trading. Furthermore, it offers financial leasing for property, plant, and equipment, manages grain elevators, and provides storage solutions. Founded in 1998, the entity adopted its present name, IMC S.A., in May 2017, having previously operated as Industrial Milk Company S.A. Headquartered in Luxembourg, IMC S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Agrovalley Limited.

name: Imperio Alternatywna Spolka Inwestycyjna S.A.
summary: Imperio Alternatywna Spolka Inwestycyjna S.A., founded in 1995 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, operates as a private equity and venture capital firm. The company targets a broad spectrum of ventures, from nascent seed and early-stage startups to established mature businesses, as well as those undergoing expansion, preparing for an IPO, or requiring restructuring. It also backs firms seeking to expand or diversify their core operations. Its investment portfolio spans high-growth sectors such as e-commerce, biotechnology, life sciences, renewable/clean technology, energy, information and communication technology (ICT), media, telecommunications, the Internet, modern services, and innovative production technologies. The firm's primary geographical focus is Poland. Imperio's typical investment in portfolio companies ranges from PLN 4 million to PLN 15 million (approximately $0.4 million to $5.04 million), though larger commitments are possible. The company generally acquires a significant equity interest, often exceeding 35%. While it often seeks a majority stake in early-stage ventures, its involvement in pre-IPO or restructuring projects typically entails a smaller holding, usually 10% to 15%. Imperio frequently co-invests alongside other financial institutions, particularly venture capital funds, and can utilize hybrid financing structures like convertible bonds or provide direct loans. Investment horizons typically range from four to six years for early-stage ventures and three to five years for more mature projects. Potential exit strategies include mergers, buyouts by management or co-owners, sales to strategic or trade investors, or public market listings.

name: IMS S.A.
summary: IMS S.A., along with its subsidiaries, is primarily engaged in providing sensory marketing services across Poland. The company specializes in enhancing commercial environments through a diverse array of solutions. These include acoustic offerings such as background music for stores, royalty-free music, in-store radio broadcasting, and audio advertising within shopping centers and commercial networks. They also deliver comprehensive scent marketing programs, encompassing store scenting and room aromatization. Furthermore, IMS S.A. provides various digital display technologies, including digital signage, video walls, digital storefronts, interactive screens for malls, advertising totems, monitors, and touch displays. Beyond hardware, the company develops interactive applications and manages content for digital signage platforms, also supplying specialized devices like gift card kiosks. Established in 2000 and based in Warsaw, Poland, the company operated as Internet Media Services S.A. until its name change to IMS S.A. in June 2015.

name: Inc. S.a.
summary: Based in Poznan, Poland, INC S.A. delivers specialized investment and advisory solutions to small and medium-sized enterprises as well as local government entities across the country. The company, originally established in 1995, was known as INVESTcon GROUP Spólka Akcyjna until it adopted its current designation, INC S.A., in February 2014.

name: ING Bank Slaski S.A.
summary: ING Bank Śląski S.A. is a Polish bank providing retail and corporate banking services. The bank offers a range of financial products, including accounts, loans, and investment services. It is part of the ING Group.

name: Instal Krakow S.A.
summary: Instal Kraków S.A. engages in the construction business in Poland and internationally. It constructs and assembles industrial, commercial, sports, public facilities, etc.; desulphurization, denitrification, ash removal, slagging, and pneumatic transport facilities; municipal and industrial sewage treatment plants; sludge dryer and thermal waste treatment plants; water demineralization and treatment stations; water intakes; ozone and water production installations, pumping stations, and chlorination plants; external networks, water mains, and internal sewage and water installations; technological and industrial installations; gas reduction stations; heat exchangers and compact heat substations, gas-oil boiler rooms, and biogas utilization systems; heat networks; compressed air, vacuum, and pneumatic transport systems; and ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The company also constructs and executes storage tanks; silos; ventilation, air-conditioning, and dust removal systems; desulfurization and denitrification installation components; pipelines and equipment for transport media; load-bearing and supporting structures; protective barriers, platforms, and ladders; and machines and devices for various technological processes. In addition, it produces sediment scrapers and rod mixers, and heat exchangers; sells and rents real estate projects; repairs equipment, and installation power plants and industrial plants; and installs air conditioning and ventilation, heating and sanitary, heat centers, and technical gases equipment; assembles and prefabricates steel structures; and offers welding and foundry services. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Kraków, Poland.

name: Introl S.A.
summary: Introl S.A., founded in Katowice, Poland in 1990 (and known as Introl-Polon Sp. z o.o. until its renaming in 1997), operates as a comprehensive general contractor with projects spanning both Poland and international markets. The company’s core activities encompass several key sectors. In the energy domain, Introl is actively involved in modernizing commercial and thermal power plants, implementing solutions for renewable energy sources and cogeneration systems, and constructing new facilities that generate both electrical and thermal power. These energy solutions primarily serve municipal heat and power plants, sewage treatment facilities, and coal mines. The company also provides extensive environmental protection services, including water and wastewater treatment, air and exhaust gas purification, and supplying equipment for mechanical waste filtering and sludge processing. Additionally, Introl handles the transportation of industrial materials such as post-production waste, cement, ash, and sand. Introl specializes in industrial automation, developing and deploying advanced process control and monitoring systems, manufacturing automated stations, modernizing existing production lines, and offering ongoing maintenance services for industrial plants. This is further complemented by its role in distributing control and measurement equipment and designing and implementing intricate measurement systems. Furthermore, Introl extends its expertise to smart building infrastructure, where it designs, implements, integrates, and maintains various low-current systems, including telecommunications, safety, automation, and power systems. The company also delivers comfort systems, designing and constructing sophisticated ventilation and air-conditioning solutions for commercial and office buildings, as well as specialized high-end systems for industrial facilities and power plants. Completing its diverse portfolio, Introl S.A. manufactures a range of specialized industrial components, such as pressure castings, standard and custom temperature sensors, pressure molds, dies, and machining tools.

name: Inpro S.A.
summary: Inpro S.A. is a Polish enterprise primarily engaged in developing and selling both residential and commercial properties. Its housing offerings span multi-family buildings, such as apartments and flats, as well as various single-family structures including detached, semi-detached, and terraced homes. Beyond real estate development, the company fabricates precast, reinforced concrete, and steel elements for use in civil engineering, industrial, and municipal construction projects. Inpro S.A. also undertakes the management and rental of its own properties. Complementary services provided include plumbing and heating system installations, interior fit-out and finishing for residential units, and the operation of hotel services. The company, established in 1987, is based in Gdansk, Poland.

name: IPOPEMA Securities S.A.
summary: Established in 2005 in Warsaw, Poland, IPOPEMA Securities S.A. is a financial services firm delivering a comprehensive range of brokerage, equity research, and investment banking solutions. The company's operations are organized into distinct divisions. Its Investment Fund and Portfolio Management segment focuses on the creation and oversight of various investment funds, including both open-end and closed-end structures, alongside managing portfolios of financial instruments for clients. The Brokerage and Investment Banking division undertakes securities brokerage, the distribution of investment products, and provides investment advisory services to individual investors. This extensive segment also covers a full spectrum of investment banking activities, such as the preparation and execution of equity capital market transactions, public securities offerings, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and management buy-outs. Additionally, it offers expert advice on corporate financial restructuring, assists in securing funding for infrastructure projects, and guides clients through private market financing. IPOPEMA Securities S.A. further supports companies listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange with share repurchase initiatives, including tender offers and buyback programs. Through its Advisory Service segment, the company delivers specialized expertise in business and management consulting, complemented by IT-related services such as computer facilities management, general IT advisory, and various software solutions. Beyond these primary financial offerings, IPOPEMA Securities S.A. also provides intermediation services and engages in the wholesale distribution of computer hardware, peripherals, equipment, and software.

name: Intersport Polska S.A.
summary: Intersport Polska S.A. operates as a retailer in Poland, specializing in athletic and outdoor merchandise. The company provides an extensive range of apparel for men, women, and children, including outerwear like jackets and vests, base layers such as underwear and t-shirts, activewear like tracksuits and shorts, and accessories like hats and gloves. Its footwear selection encompasses items for various activities, from running and cycling shoes to hiking boots, ski boots, and casual sandals. Furthermore, Intersport Polska stocks equipment and accessories for a multitude of sports and recreational pursuits, such as cycling gear, backpacks, eyewear, and specialized equipment for football, running, fitness, water sports, racket sports, team games, and winter sports like skiing, snowboarding, and skating. The company also offers related services for skiing, snowboarding, and skating. With its headquarters located in Liszki, Poland, Intersport Polska S.A. manages a network of 31 retail outlets.

name: Interbud-Lublin S.A.
summary: Interbud-Lublin S.A. operates as a construction and development company in Poland. The company undertakes the construction of multi-family residential buildings, single-family terraced housing, and commercial and service building projects. It provides supervising of construction, sanitary, electrical, and road construction documentation; construction budget; implementation of contracts; and settlement of the current construction site. The company was formerly known as Company Sanitary and Electrical INTERBUD Limited Liability Company and changed its name to Interbud-Lublin S.A. in December 2007. Interbud-Lublin S.A. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Lublin, Poland.

name: Industria de Diseño Textil, S.A.
summary: Industria de Diseño Textil, S.A. primarily focuses on the global distribution and sale of fashion apparel, footwear, accessories, and home textiles, reaching consumers through both physical storefronts and digital platforms. The company's extensive product portfolio is offered under a collection of well-known labels, including Zara, Pull & Bear, Massimo Dutti, Bershka, Stradivarius, Oysho, and Zara Home. Beyond its core retail operations, its business activities span across textile manufacturing, logistics, product design, insurance, construction, real estate, and the provision of financial services. Founded in 1963, this enterprise maintains its corporate headquarters in A Coruña, Spain, and boasts a significant international presence throughout Spain, the wider European continent, the Americas, and various other worldwide markets.

name: Izoblok S.a.
summary: IZOBLOK S.A. provides expanded polypropylene (EPP) components to the automotive industry worldwide. Its EPP products used in the automotive, logistics, HVAC, sports gear, household appliances, and other industries. The company also offers product and tool development, design, prototyping, moulding, and CNC machining services. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Chorzów, Poland. IZOBLOK S.A. is a subsidiary of BEWi ASA.

name: Izolacja Jarocin Spolka Akcyjna
summary: IZOLACJA-JAROCIN SA engages in the production of waterproofing products and sealants for the construction industry. Its products include Asphalt felts, Bituminous roofing membranes and roofing felt for pitched roofs, and Asphalt masses. The firm also provides layered insulation covering systems. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Jarocin, Poland.

name: Izostal S.A.
summary: Izostal S.A. specializes in the production and distribution of external anticorrosive coatings for steel pipes, primarily deployed in pipeline transportation systems across Poland and globally. Their comprehensive range of coatings includes internal LAYTEC solutions, three-layer polyethylene and polypropylene coatings, alongside single and dual fusion bonded epoxy options, all designed for steel pipes used in gas, oil, liquid fuel, and water distribution networks. Beyond coatings, Izostal S.A. manufactures and supplies a diverse array of steel pipes, such as seamless, high-frequency welded, spiral-welded, and longitudinally welded types, which are integral to the fuel industry, heat engineering, water supply, sewage systems, and various other applications. The company also offers a wide selection of metallurgical products, including cold and hot rolled sheets and strips, various angles, channels, I-beams, flat bars, ribbed bars, T-bars, square and rectangular hollow sections, as well as hot rolled wire rods, round bars, and wires for concrete reinforcement. Furthermore, Izostal provides essential steel fixtures like elbows, bends, tees, and reducers, crucial for constructing transmission pipelines, pressure regulating stations, and intermediate pumping stations. Established in 1993, Izostal S.A. is located in Kolonowskie, Poland, and operates as a subsidiary of Stalprofil S.A.

name: Jerónimo Martins, SGPS, S.A.
summary: Jerónimo Martins, SGPS, S.A. is an international food retailer and distributor operating a network of supermarkets, hypermarkets, and cash & carry stores. The company's main markets are Portugal, Poland, and Colombia. Its headquarters are located in Lisbon, Portugal.

name: Jastrzebska Spólka Weglowa S.A.
summary: Jastrzębska Spółka Węglowa S.A. (JSW) is a Polish hard coking coal producer. The company's core business is the extraction and sale of hard coking coal used for steel production. JSW is headquartered in Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Poland.

name: JWW Invest S.A.
summary: JWW Invest S.A., founded in 2012 and based in Katowice, Poland, is a multifaceted enterprise deeply engaged in the Polish power sector. The company specializes in the installation, modernization, and renovation of power infrastructure, handling crucial components like boiler pressure parts, heat exchangers, tanks, and various low and high-pressure pipeline systems. Operating as a general contractor, JWW Invest undertakes a wide array of industrial and energy construction projects. This includes the construction of reservoirs, the erection of steel structures, the development of wind farms, and providing design, supervision, and reconstruction services for existing industrial plants. Beyond construction, the company offers a comprehensive suite of technical and advisory services. These encompass expert pressure element welding, non-destructive testing, management system implementation, supplier audits, assisting clients with regulatory authorizations and certifications, and both training and examining welders, as well as performing acceptance tests for steel constructions and pressure equipment. Further expanding its reach, JWW Invest is actively involved in energy generation, transmission, and distribution. This includes the planning, permitting, and construction of a solar farm near Wroclaw, alongside participation in energy trading activities.

name: Krakchemia S.A.
summary: Krakchemia S.A. functions as a wholesale distributor of chemical products, serving markets across Poland and internationally. The company offers a diverse range of plastic raw materials, which includes polyethylene, polypropylene, styrene fibers, plastics for construction, mineral fillers, masterbatches, and various processing aids. Additionally, its product portfolio extends to packaging films. Beyond plastics, Krakchemia supplies general chemical materials, specific chemical reagents, and a variety of laboratory essentials such as filters, testing standards, chemical testing kits, laboratory glassware, and advanced HPLC, GC, and UPLC chromatographic columns. An online store further supports its sales operations. Established in 1945 and based in Kraków, Poland, the company was formerly known as KrakChemia – Hurt S.A. before officially adopting its current name in November 2004.

name: Kci S.a.
summary: KCI Spolka Akcyjna, formerly known as Jupiter Spolka Akcyjna, is a private equity firm specializing in real estate and media sector. It seeks to invest in Poland. KCI Spolka Akcyjna is based in Kracow, Poland.

name: Kernel Holding S.A.
summary: Kernel Holding S.A. is a diversified agribusiness company operating in Ukraine and other countries, primarily involved in the production and export of sunflower oil, agricultural products, and grain. It is one of the largest sunflower oil producers in the world, and is involved in farming, crushing, and grain handling. The company is headquartered in Luxembourg

name: KGHM Polska Miedz S.A.
summary: KGHM Polska Miedź S.A. is a Polish copper and silver producer. The company is involved in the extraction, smelting, and refining of copper and other metals, with its headquarters located in Lubin, Poland. It also produces precious metals such as gold and silver, as well as other products like copper rods and wire.

name: Korporacja KGL S.A.
summary: Korporacja KGL S.A. functions as a significant supplier of thermoplastic polymer granules, catering to both domestic Polish and international markets. The company's diverse product catalog includes various types of polystyrene, such as expandable, low-impact, and high-impact grades, alongside styrene-butadiene copolymer. Its polyolefin offerings span numerous polypropylene varieties, including homopolymer, block copolymer, random copolymer, and metallocene polypropylene, as well as a range of polyethylenes like high-density, medium-density, low-density, and metallocene polyethylene, plus ethylene vinyl acetate copolymer. KGL also provides an extensive selection of engineering plastics, featuring polyoxymethylene polyacetal, polycarbonate, polymethyl methacrylate, polyamide, acrylonitrile-styrene-acrylic terpolymer, styrene-acrylonitrile copolymer, acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene terpolymer, PC/ABS blends, filled polypropylenes, phenylene polysulphide, and polyvinylidene fluoride. Moreover, specialized polymers are available, such as electrically conductive, thermally conductive, thermally resistant, and wear-resistant thermoplastic composites, along with high specific gravity and various filled and reinforced polymers. In the elastomers category, the company supplies thermoplastic vulcanizate, styrene/ethylene-butylene/styrene terpolymers, and styrene/butadiene/styrene copolymer. Beyond raw polymers, KGL distributes a variety of additives, including dyes, UV stabilizers, antistatic agents, antiblocks, special modifiers, and chalk fillers. The company further extends its services to encompass the design and construction of molds for thermoforming and injection systems. Additionally, it manufactures plastic food packaging for the fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industry and produces the necessary tooling for both thermoforming and injection production processes. Korporacja KGL S.A. was founded in 1992 and maintains its headquarters in Klaudyn, Poland.

name: Zespól Elektrocieplowni Wroclawskich KOGENERACJA S.A.
summary: Zespól Elektrocieplowni Wroclawskich KOGENERACJA S.A. engages in the production of electricity and heat in Poland. The company is also involved in the wholesale and retail sale of electricity, heat, and power industry products and services. It operates 3 production plants, including the Wroclaw, Czechnica, and Zawidawie heat and power plants located in Wroclaw with a total electric capacity of 365.7 megawatts; and 1,080.4 megawatts of heat power. The company is based in Wroclaw, Poland. Zespól Elektrocieplowni Wroclawskich KOGENERACJA S.A. is a subsidiary of PGE Energia Ciepla S.A.

name: Przedsiebiorstwo Produkcyjno - Handlowe KOMPAP S.A.
summary: Przedsiebiorstwo Produkcyjno - Handlowe KOMPAP S.A., founded in 1989 and headquartered in Laskowice, Poland, is a leading producer and vendor of printed materials, serving both domestic and international markets. Operating under its Kompap, BZGraf, and OZGraf brands, the company offers a comprehensive array of products. This includes informational and instructional prints such as leaflets, brochures, and user manuals specifically designed for pharmaceutical and cosmetic companies. They also supply business stationery like A4 letterheads suitable for laser printers, alongside various administrative and operational documents for accounting, HR, payroll, warehouse management, and sales. KOMPAP specializes in self-adhesive labels, provided in sheets, rolls, or continuous forms, for diverse sectors including offices, logistics, and public administration. Additional offerings feature specialized paper rolls for fiscal cash registers and ATMs, custom-printed computer papers, and secure confidential envelopes. The firm further produces packaging papers in rolls or sheets, publishes books, magazines, and albums, and provides general printing services. Its diverse client base includes companies in the printing, transport, logistics, pharmaceutical, service, and food industries, as well as paper wholesalers.

name: Komputronik S.A.
summary: Komputronik S.A. distributes IT equipment, consumer electronics, household appliances, and software under the Komputronik brand name in Poland. It offers IT and Mobile equipment, including computers, laptops, tablets, GSM, computer components, and peripherals. The company also provides home and garden products. In addition, it offers computer hardware and peripherals and IT and implementation services. Komputronik S.A. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Poznan, Poland.

name: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego S.A. (KPD.WA) operates as a manufacturer and supplier of timber goods, primarily focusing on softwood products, for both the Polish domestic and international markets. Its extensive portfolio includes various forms of processed softwood, such as dried, edged, unedged, planed, impregnated, and rounded lumber. The company also provides specialized timber items for outdoor applications, including terrace boards, garden sleepers, posts, and square timber. Furthermore, it supplies dried pine, construction-grade timber, select hardwood timber, and pine cladding solutions. Complementing its core offerings, the firm manufactures glued boards from both softwood and hardwood, provides wood fuel like firewood and briquettes, and offers essential spare parts for sawmill machinery. KPD.WA caters to a diverse clientele, which includes manufacturers of building carpentry, furniture producers, commercial distributors, companies specializing in garden products and laminated goods, and facilities involved in carpentry and the treatment of railway sleepers. Its operations are headquartered in Szczecinek, Poland.

name: Kino Polska TV Spolka Akcyjna
summary: Kino Polska TV Spolka Akcyjna operates as a media group, primarily engaged in the creation, broadcasting, and distribution of television channels across Eastern and Central Europe. Its portfolio includes well-known channels such as Kino Polska, Kino Polska Muzyka, Kino TV, and FilmBox Premium HD, along with various other thematic and terrestrial offerings. The company extends its reach by producing and distributing FilmBox movie and thematic channels to international markets. Furthermore, its operations encompass publishing, film production, and the digital archiving of works important to Polish cinematography and the internet. This company was established in 2003 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Krka, d. d.
summary: Krka, d. d. is a leading generic pharmaceutical enterprise primarily involved in the research, production, promotion, and sale of various pharmaceutical goods. Its market presence spans Slovenia, South-East Europe, East Europe, Central Europe, West Europe, and numerous other international territories. The company's offerings are categorized into prescription medications, over-the-counter products, and veterinary health solutions. Its prescription drug pipeline targets a broad spectrum of medical conditions, including cardiovascular disorders, gastrointestinal issues, central nervous system ailments, pain management, anti-infective treatments, conditions affecting blood and blood-forming organs, urological problems, diabetes, and oncology. The array of non-prescription items includes products for oral and throat care, cough and cold remedies, analgesics, nasal preparations, vitamin and mineral supplements, products designed to enhance cerebral and peripheral circulation, digestive aids, and various general healthcare products.
