Furthermore, Krka supplies animal health products such as anti-infectives, antiparasitics, and other specialized formulations for both livestock and companion animals. Beyond its pharmaceutical operations, the company also provides health resort and tourist services. Krka, d. d. was established in 1954 and has its corporate headquarters in Novo Mesto, Slovenia.

name: KRUK Spólka Akcyjna
summary: KRUK Spólka Akcyjna, alongside its various subsidiary entities, operates as an international debt management specialist, with its presence spanning Poland, Romania, Italy, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Germany, and Spain. The company’s business activities are structured across three primary segments: Debt Purchase, Credit Management, and a broader 'Other' category. Central to KRUK's operations is the acquisition and administration of diverse debt portfolios, including consumer, mortgage-backed, and corporate obligations. Beyond this, the firm extends various financial products, such as unsecured consumer loans, mortgage financing, and credit solutions tailored for SMEs and corporations, complemented by comprehensive credit management services. KRUK also manages the receivables for a wide array of clients, including financial institutions like banks, loan brokers, and insurers, as well as leasing companies. Its client base further encompasses landline and mobile telecommunications providers, cable and digital TV operators, and fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) businesses. The company's service offerings are extensive, featuring specialized Novum loan facilities, investigative services, financial intermediation, and auxiliary support specifically for small and medium-sized enterprises. Furthermore, KRUK is involved in gathering, processing, and providing credit information on individuals, delivering additional receivable management solutions, and conducting portfolio underwriting. Diversifying its operations, KRUK strategically invests in both receivables and certificates of securitization funds, and it also engages in the acquisition of agricultural real estate. Founded in 1998, KRUK Spólka Akcyjna maintains its principal office in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: KSG Agro S.A.
summary: KSG Agro S.A. is an agricultural enterprise that cultivates, processes, stores, and markets a diverse range of farm products throughout Ukraine and Europe. Its operations are structured into three main segments. The Crop Farming division focuses on producing key grains and oilseeds such as sunflower, corn, wheat, barley, and rapeseed. The Pig Breeding segment specializes in raising pigs and selling them both alive and in various processed forms. Additionally, the "Other" segment contributes to the business through the manufacture of fuel pellets and thermal energy, wholesale trade of crops and other commodities, and the provision of services to third parties. The company further diversifies its offerings by growing vegetables like potatoes, carrots, onions, beets, and cabbage, alongside fruits including cherries, apples, pears, and apricots. It also supplies retail chains with meat products, notably sausages and gourmet meat delicacies. As of December 31, 2020, KSG Agro managed approximately 21,000 hectares of agricultural land. Incorporated in 2010 and based in Luxembourg City, Luxembourg, the company adopted its current name, KSG Agro S.A., in March 2011, having previously operated as Borquest S.A. It functions as a subsidiary of OLBIS Investments LTD S.A.

name: Grupa Kety S.A.
summary: Grupa Kety S.A. is a Polish company with an international footprint, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of aluminum profiles and related components, alongside packaging solutions. Its business activities are organized across three core segments: Extruded Products, Aluminum Systems, and Flexible Packaging. The company supplies aluminum profiles and various components to both the construction and automotive industries. Furthermore, it provides comprehensive aluminum building solutions, encompassing facades, window and door systems, fire-rated and smoke-control partitions, as well as roller shutter systems and rolling gates. Diversifying its portfolio, the company also produces and distributes a variety of packaging materials, including plastic and flexible options. Its offerings are marketed under prominent brands such as Grupa Kety, Aluprof, and Alupol Packaging. Established in 1953, the company, originally named Zaklady Metali Lekkich KETY, rebranded as Grupa Kety S.A. in 2000 and is headquartered in Kety, Poland.

name: Krynica Vitamin S.A.
summary: Krynica Vitamin S.A. produces and sells non-alcoholic and low-alcoholic beverages in Poland, Germany, the United Kingdom, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and internationally. It offers energy drink; functional drinks, such as vitamin cocktails, beverage with day and night formulas, and diet supplements; carbonated soft drink includes cola type, orange type, and lemon type beverages; alcopops; coffee; and dairy drinks. In addition, the company packages and markets its products in the form of aluminum cans, PET bottles, and glass bottles, as well as provides contract manufacturing services for other brands. Krynica Vitamin S.A. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Krynica Vitamin S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Zinat Sp. Z O.O.

name: Libet S.A.
summary: Established in 2008 and based in Wroclaw, Poland, Libet S.A. is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of diverse concrete and natural stone products for landscaping. The company offers an extensive range of items, including various paving solutions like stones, concrete and porcelain slabs, and terrace tiles. Their portfolio also features essential architectural components such as palisades, steps, facade elements, and curbing, along with complementary products like outdoor lighting, water management systems, decorative accents, and necessary installation tools. These materials are widely utilized in both public infrastructure projects and private residential properties across Poland. Customers can acquire Libet's offerings through its network of physical stores or conveniently online via the e-otoszenia.pl platform.

name: Lubawa
summary: Lubawa S.A., established in 1951 and based in Ostrów Wielkopolski, Poland, specializes in manufacturing and supplying a wide array of products and services for various security and emergency sectors within Poland, including the army, police, border patrol, fire brigades, and special forces. The company's extensive portfolio encompasses personal protection gear like helmets, bulletproof vests, specialized clothing, camouflage, and rescue equipment. It also provides comprehensive vehicle enhancements, such as ballistic and optronics protection, various types of armor, and fuel tanks. Lubawa offers diverse shelter solutions, including frame and pneumatic tents, alongside advanced signature management systems like decoys and mobile camouflages. Furthermore, it produces EHS equipment, flood protection items, and a dedicated range of COVID-19 products, including masks, decontamination cabins, and mobile medical units. The company's textile division supplies a broad spectrum of specialized woven and knitted fabrics for industrial uses, protective clothing, and inflatable structures. Complementing its manufacturing capabilities, Lubawa provides various services, including vulcanization, cutting, PVC welding, water jet cutting, and sewing.

name: Lena Lighting S.A.
summary: Lena Lighting S.A., a Polish enterprise, specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing of professional illumination systems. While primarily serving the Polish market, the company boasts a significant international presence. Its diverse product range encompasses architectural lighting, featuring office luminaires, bulkheads, downlights, industrial fixtures, floodlights, streetlights, accent lighting, projectors, emergency systems, and advanced lighting controls. Furthermore, Lena Lighting S.A. offers an exhaustive selection of lighting tailored for construction sites and workshops. This includes robust floodlights, general site illumination, portable LED fittings, specialized machine lamps, incandescent and battery-powered hand lamps, tripods, portable fluorescent units, and assorted electrical materials. Their specialized offerings also extend to bactericidal and virucidal lamps, headlamps, dedicated workshop lights, lamps for paint booths, and cable hand lamps. Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Sroda Wielkopolska, Poland, the company actively exports its solutions to approximately 70 markets globally.

name: LESS S.a.
summary: Less S.A. does not have significant operations. Previously, the company engaged in purchase and sale of second-hand items, including used clothing, electronics, sports equipment, books, and toys. The company was formerly known as Groclin S.A. and changed its name to Less S.A. in August 2022. Less S.A. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Lokum Deweloper S.A.
summary: Lokum Deweloper S.A. is a Polish real estate developer that focuses on constructing and selling both residential and commercial properties across the country. The company's projects include a variety of housing units, such as apartments and flats, as well as office buildings and other business premises. Established in 2004, it operates from its headquarters in Wroclaw, Poland, and is a subsidiary of Halit s.à.r.l.

name: LPP S.A. Inhaber-Aktien ZY 2
summary: LPP S.A. functions as a fully integrated apparel enterprise, overseeing the conceptualization, production, distribution, and retail of fashion items. The company caters to a broad demographic, offering clothing, footwear, and accessories for women, men, and children through its well-known brands: Reserved, Cropp, House, Mohito, and Sinsay. Its widespread market presence is achieved through an extensive network of 2,244 physical stores, complemented by robust e-commerce platforms that serve customers in Poland and various international markets. Founded in 1989, LPP S.A. is headquartered in Gdansk, Poland.

name: LARQ S.a.
summary: Larq S.A. provides custom outdoor advertising services in Poland. The company designs, produces, and implements marketing campaigns, which include out-of-home media, modern urban media systems, and event marketing; and operates advertising space in the underpasses. It is also involved in automating marketing and sales processes through SaaS for residential developers, car dealers, and online store operators. In addition, the company engages in the rental of investment properties and other fixed assets. The company was formerly known as CAM Media S.A. and changed its name to Larq S.A. in October 2015. Larq S.A. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: LSI Software S.A.
summary: LSI Software S.A. specializes in crafting software solutions primarily for the retail and hospitality industries. Their comprehensive offerings extend beyond software development to include professional services like implementation and ongoing maintenance, alongside hardware solutions and a robust Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. Founded in 1991, the company maintains its headquarters in Lodz, Poland.

name: Lentex S.A.
summary: Lentex S.A. manufactures and sells flexible PVC floor coverings for residential and commercial areas, and sports facilities in Poland and internationally. It also offers nonwovens fabrics, including nonwoven interlinings, waddings, and spunlace fabrics, as well as mats for use in various applications, such as sanitary, technical, automotive, construction, furniture, clothing, shoe making, agricultural, filtration, and others. The company was founded in 1911 and is based in Lubliniec, Poland.

name: Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka S.A.
summary: Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka S.A. engages in the mining, agglomeration, manufacture, and sale of hard coal for industrial companies in the power industry in Poland. It offers energetic coal for the generation of electric and thermal energy, as well as for use in cement production. The company also provides services to mines, which comprise supply of heat energy; conducting water/wastewater management; recovery and reuse of spoil; mining works, auxiliary works, and run-of-mine services; renovation, repair, and construction services; works in underground machinery departments; and regeneration and production of steel constructions. In addition, it is involved in the construction and refurbishment of heat-generating, water supply, and sewage disposal installations; and sale of goods and materials, as well as provision of transportation services. The company is based in Leczna, Poland. Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka S.A. is a subsidiary of ENEA S.A.

name: Mabion S.A.
summary: Mabion S.A. is a Polish biopharmaceutical firm dedicated to pioneering the development of biological drugs, primarily leveraging monoclonal antibody technology. The company oversees the full spectrum from research and development to the manufacturing and commercialization of therapies designed to combat a wide range of diseases, including neoplastic (cancer), autoimmune, metabolic, and neurological disorders. Key products in its portfolio include MabionCD20 and MabionHER2. Established in 2007, Mabion S.A. maintains its headquarters in Konstantynów Lódzki, Poland.

name: Makarony Polskie S.A.
summary: Makarony Polskie S.A., operating from Rzeszów, Poland, along with its subsidiaries, is a significant producer and seller of diverse food products, with a primary focus on pasta, catering to various consumers both in Poland and abroad. The company's extensive pasta range includes traditional varieties made from durum wheat and standard wheat flour, alongside health-oriented options crafted from spelt, buckwheat, and rye flours. They also offer innovative vegetable pastas derived from legumes like chickpeas, red lentils, or green peas. These pastas, available with or without eggs, encompass numerous shapes such as spirals, elbows, threads, shells, spaghetti, and ribbons, distributed under well-known brands including Makarony Polskie, Sorenti, Solare, Stoczek, Meska Rzecz, Tenczynek, Novelle, SoFood, and Abak. Beyond pasta, Makarony Polskie S.A. manufactures a variety of preserves. This includes meat and vegetable options such as ready meals, pates, and canned lards; vegetable preserves like salads and pickles; and fruit preserves, specifically jams, marketed under the Stoczek, Tenczynek, SoFood, and Men's Rzecz brand names. Additionally, the company engages in intermediary activities, facilitating the sale of products sourced from external suppliers, primarily under the Novelle brand. Its market reach extends internationally, with products exported to countries including Germany, Latvia, Romania, the Czech Republic, Serbia, the United States, Sweden, Belarus, Ukraine, Norway, Belgium, Lithuania, Estonia, and Moldova.

name: ManyDev Studio SE
summary: ManyDev Studio SE is a Polish company primarily focused on the video game industry. It also provides various contractual and support services to other game development entities. The firm, headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, was formerly known as Platynowe Inwestycje S.A. before rebranding to ManyDev Studio SE in February 2021.

name: Mercedes-Benz Group AG
summary: Mercedes-Benz Group AG is a prominent automotive entity with a global reach, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sale of premium and luxury cars and vans. These vehicles are distributed under its distinguished brands: Mercedes-AMG, Mercedes-Benz, Mercedes-Maybach, and Mercedes-EQ. The company also supplies an array of associated spare parts and accessories. In addition to vehicle production, its services portfolio is extensive, featuring financing, leasing, car subscriptions, rentals, and comprehensive fleet management. It further provides insurance brokerage, various mobility solutions, and digital functionalities for vehicle charging and payments. Originally founded in 1886 and headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany, the company underwent a name change from Daimler AG to Mercedes-Benz Group AG in February 2022.

name: mBank
summary: mBank S.A. is a prominent financial institution delivering a comprehensive array of banking and financial services across Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and international markets. Its extensive offerings encompass a variety of account types, such as personal, savings, currency, investment, and business accounts, alongside diverse deposit options. The bank provides bill and credit cards, and a range of loan products including cash, vehicle, revolving, corporate, and mortgage financing. Additionally, clients can access pension schemes, insurance solutions, and stock exchange products, supported by modern transaction and mobile banking platforms. In terms of wealth management, mBank offers sophisticated services like asset management, investment advisory, access to various investment funds and tailored fund portfolios, and succession planning. The institution also facilitates foreign exchange transactions, currency deposits, and forex forward contracts. Its debt securities portfolio includes government, non-government, and Eurobonds. Further specialized services comprise factoring, leasing, investment credit, invoicing and accounting assistance, brokerage, and currency handling. Operating through 322 branches, mBank S.A. was founded in 1986. Originally known as BRE Bank S.A., the company officially adopted the mBank S.A. name in November 2013. Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, mBank S.A. functions as a subsidiary of Commerzbank AG.

name: Mo-BRUK
summary: Mo-BRUK S.A. engages in the storage, disposal, and recycling of industrial, medical, and municipal waste in Poland, Germany, Italy, Denmark, and Lithuania. It provides incineration, and solidification and stabilization of waste. The company also offers construction services, including construction of concrete pavement, roads, and squares. In addition, it owns and operates fuel stations that provide sale of liquid fuels, car wash, and car diagnostic services; produces alternative fuel from municipal and industrial waste; and provides laboratory services. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Korzenna, Poland.

name: Marie Brizard Wine & Spirits S.A.
summary: Marie Brizard Wine & Spirits SA produces and sells wine and spirits in Western Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Central and Eastern Europe, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific. It primarily offers scotch whisky under the William Peel brand; vodka under the Sobieski and Krupnik brands; wine-based beverages under the Fruits and Wine brand name; French liqueurs under the Marie Brizard brand; and cognac under the Cognac Gautier brand. Marie Brizard Wine & Spirits SA was founded in 1755 and is based in Paris, France.

name: MCI Capital Alternatywna Spólka Inwestycyjna S.A.
summary: MCI Capital Alternatywna Spólka Inwestycyjna S.A., formerly known as MCI Capital S.A. is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing direct and fund of fund investments. In direct investments, the firm specializes in mezzanine, early stage, growth capital, management buy-outs, leverage buy-outs, pre-IPO and PIPE transactions, majority investments and private debt. In fund of fund investments, the firm specializes in private equity and venture capital funds at growth, PE/LBO and private debt level. The firm prefers to invest in TMT, IT infrastructure, data centers and distributors, digital media, ecommerce, marketplace, fintech, IoT, adtech, SaaS, cloud and entertainment. It seeks to invest in CEE, Western Europe, Israel. The firm prefers to invest between EUR 5 million ($5.94 million) to EUR 100 million ($118.88 million).The firm prefers to exit its investments via reselling the company's shares or stocks to a strategic industry investor, financial investors, private investors, the company board, or by admitting the company to official stock-exchange listing (IPO). MCI Capital Alternatywna Spólka Inwestycyjna S.A. was founded in 1999 and is based in Warsaw, Poland. MCI Capital Alternatywna Spólka Inwestycyjna S.A. is a subsidiary of Czechowicz Ventures Sp z o.o.

name: MCR S.A.
summary: MCR S.A. specializes in the production and distribution of advanced fire safety systems. The company provides a comprehensive range of products, including smoke exhaust vents, roof hatches, daily ventilation flaps, smoke curtains, fire dampers, and smoke exhaust fans. Additionally, MCR S.A. supplies specialized spray systems, sealing solutions, and spray acoustical coatings, offering full-service delivery, assembly, and ongoing maintenance for all its fire protection technologies. Established in 1988 by Krzysztof Krempec and Marian Popinigis, its headquarters are located in Gdansk, Poland.

name: Medicalgorithmics S.A.
summary: Established in 2005 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, Medicalgorithmics S.A. is a prominent provider of cardiac diagnostic solutions, serving markets in Poland, the United States, and globally. The company offers an array of advanced products, including PocketECG, a comprehensive diagnostic system for arrhythmia detection that furnishes detailed ECG signals, data analysis, and exhaustive reports. Another key offering is PocketECG CRS, specifically designed for monitoring patients during cardiac rehabilitation. Its technological portfolio also encompasses ECG TechBot, a software program that utilizes algorithms for the automated analysis and interpretation of ECG signals, and PatchECG, a device enabling single-channel, offline heart monitoring. Additionally, PocketECG IV enhances the core PocketECG device by enabling continuous ECG signal transmission via LTE connectivity. Beyond its innovative devices, Medicalgorithmics S.A. delivers services in information technology, biotechnology, ECG monitoring, and scientific research and development, alongside manufacturing and distributing electro-medical equipment.

name: MDI Energia S.A.
summary: MDI Energia S.A. provides engineering services in Poland. The company constructs and installs wind, biogas, and solar farms. It also constructs multi-family residential complexes, production and warehouse halls, and office buildings. In addition, the company provides additional services, including commercial and residential buildings, designing, and energy storage. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Modivo S.A.
summary: Modivo S.A. is a retail group primarily engaged in the sale of footwear, alongside a diverse array of other consumer goods across Poland, Central and Eastern Europe, and Western Europe. The company manages several key business segments, including CCC, HalfPrice, eobuwie, MODIVO, and DeeZee. Beyond shoes, their extensive product catalog encompasses apparel, handbags, shoe care items, household essentials, various accessories, beauty products, toys, home furnishings, and health products. Modivo reaches customers through both its physical retail locations and its robust online platforms, offering a mix of its own proprietary brands as well as licensed and third-party labels. Established in 2004 and based in Polkowice, Poland, the company is slated to officially transition its name from CCC S.A. to Modivo S.A. in February 2026.

name: Mex Polska S.A.
summary: Mex Polska S.A. is a Polish company primarily involved in the creation, ownership, management, and franchising of dining establishments. By the end of 2020, its portfolio included 44 food and beverage venues, which comprised seven 'The Mexican' restaurants, 34 'Pijalnia Wódki i Piwa' bistros, two 'PanKejk' eateries, and a single 'Prosty Temat' restaurant. Established in 2007, the firm's main offices are situated in Łódź, Poland.

name: MFO S.A.
summary: MFO S.A. is a manufacturer and supplier of steel profiles, distributing its products throughout Poland, across Europe, and to global markets. These adaptable metal sections are integral components in numerous sectors, supporting applications such as uPVC window and roller shutter fabrication, drywall construction, various installations (including ventilation, air conditioning, and electrical), technical flooring systems, the assembly of semi-trailers and truck bodies, furniture production, rack and fencing systems, scaffolding, and photovoltaic energy installations. The company was founded in 2011 and operates from its base in Sochaczew, Poland.

name: Mangata Holding S.A.
summary: Mangata Holding S.A., a prominent industrial enterprise headquartered in Bielsko-Biala, Poland, has been a significant presence since its founding in 1946. Formerly known as ZETKAMA Spólka Akcyjna before its name change in September 2016, this Polish company manufactures a broad spectrum of industrial products. Its core offerings include heavy-duty forgings designed for crucial sectors like automotive, mining, construction, energy, and agriculture. Additionally, Mangata produces exhaust systems, various metal components, and specialized parts for vehicles, mechanical equipment, servo drives, agricultural machinery, and construction equipment, as well as hydraulic units and high-pressure pumps. The company is also a key supplier of industrial valves, encompassing stop, bellow, check, butterfly, ball, and gate types, alongside other flow management solutions such as strainers, backflow preventers, rubber expansion joints, and castings. Fasteners like bolts, nuts, washers, and rivets are also part of its extensive product line. Beyond manufacturing, Mangata Holding S.A. offers specialized engineering services for the research and development of industrial valves and associated regulation systems. As a subsidiary of CAPITAL MBO Sp. z o.o., the company demonstrates a strong international presence, exporting its goods to approximately 70 countries worldwide.

name: Bank Millennium
summary: Bank Millennium S.A. is a prominent financial institution operating within Poland. The bank delivers a broad spectrum of banking and financial services, organized into distinct operational segments: retail client services, corporate client services, foreign exchange mortgage lending, and treasury and asset-liability management. Its extensive product lineup encompasses transactional and savings accounts, along with diverse lending options such as personal loans, asset-backed credit, loans for securities acquisition, revolving credit facilities, and mortgages. Furthermore, it provides brokerage services, investment funds, various payment card solutions, and a suite of trade finance offerings including letters of credit, bank guarantees, and document collection. Other key services include factoring, foreign currency exchange, custodial services, pension schemes, overdraft facilities, and both life and non-life insurance products. Beyond traditional banking, the company also specializes in leasing and financing for a wide array of assets, including vehicles (cars and vans), industrial machinery and equipment, transportation infrastructure (road, rail, water, and air), and real estate. Customers can access these services through modern digital channels, including internet, mobile, and ATM banking. Bank Millennium S.A. serves a diverse client base, ranging from individual customers across the mass market to affluent individuals and sole proprietors, as well as small, medium, and large enterprises, and public sector organizations. The bank maintains a physical presence with 655 branches. Founded in 1989, the company, headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, was initially known as BIG Bank GDANSKI SA before rebranding to Bank Millennium S.A. in January 2003. It functions as a subsidiary of the Portuguese financial group, Banco Comercial Português, S.A.

name: Miraculum S.A.
summary: Established in 1924 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, Miraculum S.A. is a cosmetics manufacturer specializing in the development and marketing of a wide array of personal care items. Their extensive product line caters to both men and women, encompassing face and body care, fragrances, depilatories, makeup, shaving essentials, deodorants, and hair care solutions. These offerings are primarily distributed in Poland and across international markets under well-known brands such as Pani Walewska, Miraculum, Gracja, Tanita, Paloma, Joko, Chopin, Lider, Wars, and Byc Moze.

name: MLP Group S.A.
summary: MLP Group S.A. is a real estate development and investment company that acquires, develops, leases, and sells properties throughout Poland, Germany, Romania, and Austria. Beyond its core real estate transactions, the company also provides property management services for both residential and commercial assets, and it undertakes building construction projects, including offering general construction services. A significant area of its expertise lies in the creation and management of modern warehouse and office facilities. MLP Group S.A. currently oversees a portfolio of 20 logistics parks. Its diverse clientele includes not only logistics providers but also businesses from various sectors such as paper, cosmetics, household goods, and the automotive industry. Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Pruszków, Poland, MLP Group S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Cajamarca Holland B.V.

name: MLK Foods Public Company Ltd.
summary: MLK Foods Public Company Ltd, known as Milkiland Public Company Limited until its name change in January 2022, is a leading producer and distributor of dairy products. The company primarily serves markets in the European Union and CIS countries, additionally exporting its offerings to roughly 30 nations worldwide. Its operations are structured into three key segments: Cheese & Butter, Whole-Milk, and Ingredients. The diverse product range encompasses various types of cheeses (hard, mould, fresh, processed, and creamy), a selection of dairy beverages including sterilized and pasteurized milk, kefir, and ryazhenka, as well as cream, sour cream, and tvorog. They also provide drinkable and spoonable bio yoghurts and develop private label products for retailers. For industrial customers such as confectioneries and bakeries, MLK Foods supplies butter and a comprehensive suite of milk and whey powders, including skimmed milk powder, whole milk powder, various demineralized and sweet whey powders, whey protein concentrate, and demineralized permeate whey powder. Products are sold under established brands like Dobryana, Ostankinskoye, 36 kopeyek, Ostrowia, and Milkiland. Founded in 1994, MLK Foods Public Company Ltd is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, and functions as a subsidiary of 1, Inc. Cooperatief U.A.

name: ML Systems
summary: ML SYSTEM SA is a Polish technology company that develops and integrates advanced IT and automation solutions, particularly in the areas of transport, energy, and healthcare. They specialize in LED lighting systems, photovoltaic installations, and intelligent transportation systems. The company is headquartered in Zaczernie, Poland.

name: Mennica Polska S.A.
summary: MENNICA POLSKA ZY 1 is a Polish company that operates primarily in two segments: minting services (producing coins, medals, and other numismatic products) and security printing (producing banknotes, ID documents, and other security-sensitive items). They also provide electronic payment services and operate a precious metals e-commerce platform. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Molecure S.A.
summary: MOLECURE SA is a Polish biotechnology company focused on the discovery and development of innovative drugs, particularly in the field of oncology and neurodegenerative diseases. They are involved in preclinical and clinical research, aiming to develop novel therapeutic candidates. The company is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: MOL Magyar Olaj- és Gázipari Nyilvánosan Muködo Részvénytársaság
summary: MOL Magyar Olaj- és Gázipari Nyilvánosan Muködo Részvénytársaság, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated oil and gas company in Hungary and internationally. The company offers MOL EVO fuel products; operates convenience store under the Fresh Corner brand; and provides e-charging solutions. It also provides lubricants and autochemicals; gasoline, diesel, heating oil, and bunker diesel; JET A-1 aviation fuel; liquefied petroleum gas, including butanes, propane-butane mix, autogas, propane; petrochemicals; black products, such as bitumen, HFO, petrolcoke, and liquid sulphur, as well as other crude processing/petchem residues, including fcc residue, c9+, and pyrooil; and base oil, waxes, and finished lubricants. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of retail services, which operates service stations under the MOL, Slovnaft, INA, Tifon, and Energopetrol brands; mobility solutions comprising e-mobility, car sharing, bike sharing, fleet management services; oilfield chemicals and technologies business; and oilfield services, such as drilling, workover, pressure pumping, cementing and stimulation, coiled tubing and nitrogen, tubular handling, well test, slickline, wireline mud logging, and seismic data processing service lines. Further, it engages in the provision of digital factory services, including data science, master data management, loyalty, customer relationship management, campaign management, API integration, omnichannel and payment; and natural gas transmission business. Additionally, the company produces, supplies, and treats water; fire and ambulance services; investment management; engineering activity and consultancy; hydrocarbon exploration; trading of oil products; financial services; exploration financing; private security; accounting; bookkeeping and auditing; tax consultancy; and computer facilities management activities. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Budapest, Hungary.

name: Monnari Trade S.A.
summary: Monnari Trade S.A. operates within the women's fashion industry, specializing in the creation, external production, promotion, and sale of apparel and accessories for women. These items are marketed under the MONNARI brand, reaching customers through the company's network of retail stores and online platforms, both within Poland and globally. The firm, established in 1998 and headquartered in Lodz, Poland, adopted its current name, Monnari Trade S.A., in 2000, having previously operated as MONNARI s.c.

name: Movie Games S.A.
summary: Movie Games S.A. is a Polish video game development studio, established in 2016 and based in Warsaw. They craft a variety of titles for PC, Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and Nintendo Switch, with their portfolio encompassing genres such as roguelike, horror, simulation, and war games.

name: Mirbud S.A.
summary: Mirbud S.A. operates as a general contractor in the construction market in Poland. The company constructs industrial projects, such as production and logistics halls, and cold stores and freezers; and public utility buildings, including commune and customs offices, sports halls, gyms, stadiums, public administration offices, shopping malls, offices, hotel facilities, hospitals, didactic buildings, specialised research units, car showrooms and service stations, and schools. It is also involved road engineering construction consisting of roads with crossings, junctions, roundabouts, and accompanying infrastructure; streets, car parks, and sidewalks; railway sidings and tram lines; viaducts and bridges; and culverts. In addition, the company constructs single-family, terraced, and multi-family residential buildings. It also rents construction equipment, as well as engages in the production of mineral and bituminous masses. The company was founded in 2002 is based in Skierniewice, Poland.

name: Mercator Medical S.A.
summary: Mercator Medical S.A. is a Poland-based manufacturer and distributor of disposable medical gloves and other medical products. The company's product portfolio includes examination, surgical, and protective gloves made of latex, nitrile, and vinyl, as well as medical clothing and dressings, operating from its headquarters in Poland.

name: Mostostal Plock S.A.
summary: Mostostal Plock S.A. operates as a mechanical company in Poland. It engages in the production and assembly of storage tanks, prefabrication and assembly of industrial installations and pipelines. The company is also involved in the prefabrication and erection of industrial, sports halls and indoor swimming pools, general and industrial constructions elements, radio and television masts, bridge and sewage treatment plant structures, industrial apparatus subject to UDT approvals, grain silos, industrial furnaces, steel chimneys, columns, reactors with accessories, compressors and pumps, and other structures and devices. In addition, it engages in the prefabrication and erection of storage tanks, including carbon steel tanks, stainless steel tanks, horizontal tanks, spherical tanks, and tanks with floating roof, as well as double shell and bottom tanks; and crane rental activities. Further, the company is involved in the industry installation and workshop services. The company serves oil and gas sectors, as well as in the chemical, energy, and food industries. Mostostal Plock S.A. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Plock, Poland.

name: Mostostal Warszawa S.A.
summary: Mostostal Warszawa S.A. operates in the construction industry in Poland and internationally. The company operates through Industry and Power Engineering, Infrastructure, and General Construction segments. It also engages in the construction of residential buildings and housing development activities, office facilities and public buildings, and production halls and warehouses; and technological installations and steel structures. In addition, the company constructs bridges, overpasses, and multi-level crossings, as well as underground structures, such as tunnels and underground facilities; modernizes and constructs national roads, provincial roads, express roads, and motorways; and constructs elements of municipal transport infrastructure and railway projects. Further, it is involved in the execution and supply of equipment related to environmental protection, including turnkey energy facilities based on renewable fuels, sewage treatment plants, water treatment plants, water supply and sewage discharge networks, and de-dusting installations for heavy industry or hydro-technical facilities; and constructing energy facilities relying on fossil fuels, as well as provides design, renovation and modernization, and assembly services for energy boilers and turbo sets. Additionally, the company manufactures bituminous mixtures; offers construction designs for new production capacities; and provides laboratory services for construction contracts, as well as offers equipment and transport services. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. Mostostal Warszawa S.A. is a subsidiary of Acciona Construccion S.A.

name: Mostostal Zabrze S.A.
summary: Mostostal Zabrze S.A., established in 1945 and based in Gliwice, Poland, specializes in comprehensive design, manufacturing, construction, and assembly services. The company is responsible for building a broad range of facilities, from industrial complexes to public infrastructure such as hospitals, office and residential buildings, swimming pools, and commercial centers, along with critical civil engineering projects like roads, sewage systems, and treatment plants. Their expertise extends to specialized construction works across various sectors, including metallurgy, cement, building materials, automotive, mining, and cableways. Mostostal Zabrze's service portfolio also encompasses the installation of industrial plant and process equipment, pipelines, steel structures, and storage tanks for petroleum and chemicals, in addition to facilities for oxygen and hydrogen production. Furthermore, they provide power and environmental protection solutions, and manufacture a diverse array of steel products, including structural components, hall elements, secondary structures, ducts, silos, drilling towers, and piping. The company also produces cranes, turntables for mobile cranes, subcomponents for boom sections, and frames for locomotive bodies and bogies. Additional services include machining, anticorrosive protection, and electrical installations for power networks, industrial, general, steel, coke, chemical, and petrochemical industries.

name: Murapol S.A.
summary: Operating within Poland, Murapol S.A. is a residential property developer. The firm's projects encompass a range of apartment complexes and commercial structures. This company, headquartered in Bielsko-Biala, Poland, was established in 2001.

name: Marvipol Development S.A.
summary: Established in 1996 with its main office in Warsaw, Poland, Marvipol Development S.A. is a Polish real estate firm. The company concentrates on property investment and development, specifically targeting multi-family residential buildings and warehouse complexes. It operates as a subsidiary under the ownership of Ksiazek Holding Sp. z.o.o.

name: M.W. Trade S.A.
summary: M.W. Trade SA is a company that specializes in providing financial services to the healthcare sector, operating both within Poland and internationally. The firm offers a variety of financial solutions for hospitals, including a dedicated fund to help resolve debt and liquidity problems, as well as providing immediate funding for short-term cash flow needs related to ongoing operations or investment projects. Additionally, it provides a comprehensive suite of banking products, such as current accounts, working capital loans, investment credit, leasing, bank deposits, and specialized banking and investment options for healthcare employees. Healthcare suppliers can also access financial support from M.W. Trade, covering transaction security, investment financing, and general banking services. Beyond hospitals and suppliers, its client base includes pharmaceutical companies, medical equipment manufacturers, and other local enterprises. Founded in 2004, M.W. Trade SA is based in Wroclaw, Poland, and functions as a subsidiary of Getin Holding SA.

name: Maxcom S.A.
summary: Maxcom S.A. produces, distributes, and sells consumer electronics products in Poland and internationally. It offers phones, smartwatches, Mring, payment devices, gsm accessories, laptops, computer accessories, sound, smart home, sports accessories, car accessories, translators, and other products. Maxcom S.A. was founded in 2001 and is based in Tychy, Poland.

name: Muza S.A.
summary: Muza S.A. publishes books in Poland. It publishes various categories of books that include literature, crime fiction, fantastic, non-fiction, social sciences and business, cuisine and diets, culture and traditions, art and albums, guides, gadgets, audiobooks, history, biographies, and horror, as well as books for children and youth. The company also operates online bookstores and various outlets. Muza S.A. was founded in 1991 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Neuca S.a.
summary: NEUCA S.A., headquartered in Torun, Poland, specializes in supplying pharmaceutical products to pharmacies and healthcare facilities throughout the country. The firm structures its business around distinct segments: wholesale pharmaceutical distribution, the development and marketing of proprietary drug brands, and a comprehensive healthcare services division. This healthcare arm specifically encompasses outpatient care, clinical trials, and telemedicine. Beyond these core areas, NEUCA S.A. provides an extensive array of additional services, including marketing and advertising support, agency functions, financial solutions, logistics through road cargo transport, accounting and bookkeeping, software development, information technology support, and specialized services for hospitals. The company also offers various insurance products—covering health, property, and other personal lines—and operates its own network of medical supply stores. Established in 1990 as Torfarm SA, the company rebranded to NEUCA S.A. in April 2010.

name: NanoGroup S.A.
summary: NanoGroup S.A. operates as a biotechnology company in Poland. It engages in the production of medicines and other pharmaceutical products, and research and development work in the field of biotechnology and other natural and technical sciences. The company is also involved in technical research and analysis. In addition, it manages a portfolio of companies that manage projects to meet the needs of modern medicine in the field of oncology and transplantology. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: New Tech Capital S.A.
summary: Based in Warsaw, Poland, New Tech Capital S.A. operates as a Polish investment firm. Its diverse asset portfolio encompasses equities, outstanding financial claims, and real estate properties. The company also dedicates capital to various other corporate ventures. Founded in 2000, this entity was previously identified as Invista S.A.

name: NTT System S.A.
summary: NTT System S.A., headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of desktop computers across the Polish market. The company offers these systems under its own proprietary brand, as well as through various private label agreements. Beyond its core desktop offerings, NTT System S.A. extends its portfolio to include the distribution of a comprehensive range of IT hardware, such as laptops, tablets, gaming consoles, computer components, accessories, and peripheral devices. Additionally, the firm provides computer leasing services and facilitates sales through its online platform. Its customer base is diverse, encompassing corporate clients, governmental and educational institutions, and individual consumers.

name: Novaturas AB
summary: Novaturas AB engages in the tour operator and travel agency activities in the Baltic States. The company operates through Flight Package Tours, Sightseeing Tours by Plane, Sightseeing Tours by Coach, and Other segments. It offers summer and winter package holidays, as well as sightseeing tours by coach and aircraft to approximately 30 destinations worldwide. The company also sells flight tickets and hotel accommodations. It offers its products through retail travel agencies and internal sales channels, as well as an e-commerce platform. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Kaunas, Lithuania.

name: P.A. Nova S.A.
summary: Established in 1987 and headquartered in Gliwice, Poland, P.A. Nova S.A. is a prominent Polish construction company. The firm acts as a general contractor, delivering a wide array of construction services for commercial properties. Its diverse project portfolio includes retail chains, industrial halls, warehouses, petrol stations, shopping and commercial centers, public transport hubs like bus and train stations, schools, sports facilities, residential houses, and road infrastructure. Beyond construction, P.A. Nova S.A. offers comprehensive design services. This encompasses architectural design for commercial, industrial, social utility, and multi-family housing, alongside renovation designs for post-industrial sites and buildings listed as cultural heritage. Their design expertise also extends to interior design, visual information elements, public area planning, lighting for buildings and public spaces, and graphic designs with visualizations. The company further provides planning services, including studies of spatial planning conditions, local spatial planning, specialized planning designs, and urban and architectural concepts. In addition, P.A. Nova S.A. engages in property development and management. Distinctively, it also develops CAD/CFD/PDM software and provides specialized solutions for the water and sewage industry.

name: Novavis Group S.A.
summary: Novavis Group S.A. provides a comprehensive array of investment banking solutions to clients within Poland and internationally. Their core services involve orchestrating financing arrangements, facilitating mergers and acquisitions (M&A), offering corporate finance expertise, and delivering strategic advisory. The firm also strategically invests in emerging start-up companies. Novavis serves a diverse clientele, which includes brokerage firms, institutional investors, private equity and venture capital funds, individual business angels, private wealth investors, legal practices, and certified auditors. Previously known as Rubicon Partners S.A., the company officially adopted the name Novavis Group S.A. in September 2020. Its operations are headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Novita S.A.
summary: Operating internationally from Zielona Góra, Poland, Novita S.A. specializes in the manufacturing and global distribution of diverse nonwoven materials. Its comprehensive product line features spunlace and needlepunched fabrics, as well as specialized nonwovens for medical, hygiene, footwear, and apparel industries. The company also supplies geononwovens and provides private label manufacturing services. Under the Unitex brand, Novita crafts distinctive nonwovens for applications like leathercraft and loudspeaker components. These versatile materials are integral to numerous sectors, including personal hygiene, industrial, household, medical, construction, and footwear. Established in 2001, Novita S.A. functions as a subsidiary of Tebesa Sp. z o.o. In addition to its core business, the company offers rental of office and warehouse facilities.

name: Newag
summary: Newag S.A. is a Polish company specializing in the production and distribution of railway vehicles. Its offerings encompass electric and diesel multiple units, various diesel and electric locomotives, trams, and passenger cars, alongside general rolling stock components and control systems. Beyond manufacturing, the company delivers repair and modernization services for rolling stock, electric multiple units, and passenger carriages. Newag also leases out rolling stock and engages in property management. The enterprise, founded in 1876, is headquartered in Nowy Sacz, Poland.

name: Nexity Global S.A.
summary: Everest Investments S.A., a publicly listed firm, functions as an investment manager. This company is responsible for overseeing various types of investment vehicles, including closed-end, mutual, and hedge funds. Its strategic focus lies in allocating capital to businesses situated throughout Central and Eastern Europe, with its operational base located in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Orzel Bialy S.A.
summary: Orzel Bialy S.A. specializes in the production and global distribution of refined lead and various lead alloys, which are primarily recovered through the recycling of used batteries and other lead-containing waste materials. The company also supplies polypropylene and regranulated polypropylene, generated as byproducts from its battery reprocessing activities. Their principal customers are battery manufacturers, particularly those serving the automotive sector. Established in 1858, the firm is headquartered in Piekary Slaskie, Poland, and has operated as a subsidiary of ZAP Sznajder Batterien S.A. since October 7, 2019.

name: Odlewnie Polskie S.a.
summary: Odlewnie Polskie S.A. produces and sells castings in Germany, the Czech Republic, the Netherlands, the United States, Sweden, Hungary, Great Britain, Austria, Slovakia, Denmark, Turkey, Spain, Italy, Switzerland, France, and Serbia. It offers ductile iron products using grey, nodular, ADI, SiMo, and steel cast iron materials. The company is involved in the buying ang selling of foreign castings; and provision of services in German foundries. In addition, it provides customer service, including design, production of foundry equipment and the creation of castings, their machining and heat treatment, as well as priming, assembly, and shipment services. The company offers its products to machine, automotive, industrial instruments, plumbing and sewage systems, heavy rail, energy, and appliance industries. The company was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Starachowice, Poland.

name: Onde S.A.
summary: Onde S.A. is an enterprise focused on delivering design and construction services for the sustainable energy sector, with operations extending across Poland and into international markets. The company's expertise includes the development and construction of both wind and solar power facilities. Additionally, Onde S.A. provides ongoing operation and maintenance support for these installations, as well as offering general civil engineering and road construction services. Established in 1998, the company's primary office is situated in Torun, Poland.

name: onesano S.A.
summary: Established in 1995 and based in Chorzów, Poland, onesano S.A. specializes in research and development within Poland, particularly in dietetics, animal nutrition, bioremediation, and agrotechnological processes. The company provides a range of human dietary supplements, notably under its Estrovita brand. Additionally, it offers animal health products such as Yarrowia Equinox, Yarrowia Canifelox, and Yarrowia Farminox. Its broader product portfolio encompasses various dietary supplements, food additives, functional foods, and raw materials for cosmetic use. onesano distributes its offerings through a comprehensive network including chain pharmacies, pharmaceutical wholesalers, organic/health food stores, drugstores, e-commerce platforms, zoological outlets, veterinary clinics, zoological and veterinary wholesalers, as well as directly to producers of animal feed and supplementary mixtures and contract manufacturers. The company, previously known as Skotan SA, officially adopted the name onesano S.A. in March 2023.

name: Cpi Fim S.a.
summary: CPI FIM SA, société anonyme and its subsidiaries is an owner of income-generating real estate and land bank primarily in Poland and in the Czech Republic. The Company is a subsidiary of CPI Property Group (also CPIPG and together with its subsidiaries as the CPIPG Group), which holds 97.31% of the Company shares. The Company is also involved in providing equity loans to other entities within the CPIPG Group. The Company is a joint stock company incorporated for an unlimited term and registered in Luxembourg. The trade registry number of the Company is B 44 996. The Company's shares registered under ISIN code LU0122624777 are listed on the regulated markets of the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and the Warsaw Stock Exchange. CPI FIM SA registered office is 40, rue de la Vallée, L-2661 Luxembourg, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

name: Orange Polska S.A.
summary: Orange Polska S.A. is a Polish telecommunications provider. The company offers mobile and fixed-line telephone services, internet access, and digital television. Orange Polska is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: OPTeam Spólka Akcyjna
summary: OPTEAM SA is a Polish IT company that provides software development, IT consulting, and system integration services. They specialize in developing and implementing solutions for enterprise resource planning (ERP), business intelligence, and customer relationship management (CRM). The company is headquartered in Krakow, Poland.

name: Oponeo.pl S.A.
summary: Oponeo.pl S.A. engages in the online retail of tyres and wheels for motor vehicles in Poland. The company operates through Car Accessories, Bicycle Accessories and Tools segments. It develops bicycles and bicycle accessories; tires, rims, and accessories; and tools, power tools. The company's tires are used in passenger cars, vans, cars with four-wheel drive, trucks, motorcycles, and quads. Oponeo.pl S.A. was founded in 1999 and is based in Bydgoszcz, Poland.

name: Zaklady Przemyslu Cukierniczego Otmuchów S.A.
summary: Zaklady Przemyslu Cukierniczego Otmuchów S.A. specializes in the production and global distribution of a variety of confectionery items, savory snacks, and breakfast cereals, serving both domestic and international markets. Its extensive product line features a diverse assortment of sweets, including cakes, intricately molded sugar figures, chocolate-covered and glazed gingerbread hearts and stars, ice cream, lollipops, chocolate-enrobed cherries, various jellies (both chocolate and sugar-dusted), halvah, hard and filled caramels, chocolate bars and individual candies, sesame snaps and dragees, marshmallows, premium pralines and assorted candy boxes, chewy candies, milk fondants, and traditional hard candies. These products are predominantly sold under the company's well-known Odra and FREEYU brands. Furthermore, the company offers a range of logistics services, such as transportation, shipping, warehousing, comprehensive packaging management, and co-packing. Founded in 1952, Zaklady Przemyslu Cukierniczego Otmuchów S.A. is headquartered in Otmuchów, Poland.

name: OT Logistics S.A.
summary: OT Logistics S.A. delivers extensive transportation, freight forwarding, and logistics solutions across a broad European operational footprint, serving Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands, Austria, Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Hungary. The company manages transshipment and storage activities through strategically located facilities, which include the inland port in Wroclaw, sea terminals in Swinoujscie and Gdynia, and the Croatian port of Rijeka. Beyond these core services, OT Logistics S.A. orchestrates inland conveyance for various goods, offers specialized equipment leasing for hydraulic engineering projects, provides comprehensive cargo handling, facilitates rail-based transportation, and conducts intermodal shipping that integrates sea, rail, and road modalities. The firm also owns and operates its own fleet of river vessels. Established in 1946 and headquartered in Szczecin, Poland, the company rebranded from its former identity, Odratrans S.A., to OT Logistics S.A. in 2012.

name: Passus S.A.
summary: Passus S.A., a company based in Warsaw, Poland, established in 2014, specializes in developing and deploying IT solutions within Poland. Their expertise lies in enhancing the performance of IT networks and applications, as well as strengthening cybersecurity. The company offers its own suite of products, including Sycope, a tool for monitoring network performance through real-time flow analysis, which helps evaluate performance and secure IT infrastructure; Passus Ambience, a real-time solution for analyzing network data streams; and Passus nDiagram, an application that visualizes network device connections and operational metrics as graphical diagrams. Beyond its proprietary offerings, Passus S.A. also provides solutions from leading third-party vendors. For network performance, these include Riverbed to boost network and application efficiency, NetScout for comprehensive network monitoring and analysis, and ManageEngine for managing diverse IT operations, from servers and applications to security and mobile devices. In the realm of IT security, their portfolio features Splunk Enterprise for big data analysis, FireEye for advanced threat defense, Tenable (Nessus and SecurityCenter) for vulnerability management and continuous network surveillance, Broadcom for infrastructure protection, CORE Security for predictive intelligence, Fidelis Cybersecurity for threat combat and breach prevention, Cisco for holistic security, FUDO for remote access control and logging, and IBM. Additionally, Passus S.A. delivers a full spectrum of services, encompassing planning, implementation, staff training, ongoing maintenance, and post-sales support.

name: Patentus S.A.
summary: Patentus S.A. engages in design, production, service, and renovation of mining machinery and equipment, and the production of welded steel structures in Poland. It operates through Products and services and Wholesale segments. The company offers mining equipment such as scraper conveyors, belt conveyors, bucket conveyors, coal, concrete, rock, and other crushers, as well as devices for transport. It also provides gear wheels of main gears of traction vehicles; forgings and axles of wheelsets for railway vehicles; pins for rolling stock; hollow shafts; journal box housings; coupling hooks; bumper elements; hollow shafts; and gear wheels of main gearboxes. In addition, the company offers gears; steel structures; and metal processing services. Further, it engages in repairs of toothed gears and heat treatment, packaging business, and protective clothing and office supplies, as well as trades in steel, metallurgical products, welding equipment. Patentus S.A. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Pszczyna, Poland.

name: PBS Finanse S.A.
summary: PBS Finanse S.A. primarily conducts its operations in the real estate rental sector throughout Poland. Established in 2001, the company has its headquarters situated in Sanok, Poland.

name: Pekabex S.A.
summary: Pekabex S.A. manufactures and sells prefabricated reinforced and pre-stressed concrete elements in Poland, Germany, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Scandinavia. It offers foundations, floor beams, slabs, roof beams, walls, engineering prefabricated elements, and columns; auditorium slabs, toothed beams, and columns for stadiums; and other elements, including bridge abutments, tanks, stairs, prefabricated shells, and foundation basins. The company also executes special orders for individual designs; and provides designing, transportation, and assembly services. Its products and services serve industrial, trade, residential and office, infrastructural, and power industry objects, as well as stadiums, parking places, and atypical designs. Pekabex S.A. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Poznan, Poland.

name: Grupa Azoty Zaklady Chemiczne Police S.A.
summary: Grupa Azoty Zaklady Chemiczne Police S.A. manufactures and sells mineral fertilizers in Poland, Germany, South America, rest of Europe, and internationally. It provides compound fertilizers, such as nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium fertilizers under the POLIFOSKA and POLIDAP brand; nitrogen-based fertilizers; and phosphoric and sulfuric acids. The company also offers urea solutions to reduce nitrogen oxide emissions from diesel engines and used as a reducing agent in vehicle emissions control technologies under the NOXy and Pulnox name, as well as liquid ammonia. In addition, it provides pigments comprising titanium white products, including iron sulfate and hydrolytic acid under the TYTANPOL brand, which is used in production of paints and varnishes, printing inks, and plastics, as well as paper and laminates. Further, the company produces electricity, hot steam, and heating water, as well as fly ash. Additionally, it offers design services for construction, assembly, mechanical, electrical, automation and measurement, technological, and chemical industries; printing and binding services; logistics, transport, plant and equipment, and workshop services; and sea port operation, port construction, property management, research and development, sea and inland shipping, and coastal water transportation services. The company also engages in the provision of overhauls and services for mechanical and construction industries; project execution, technical, and engineering activities in automation and power engineering; repairing of instrumentation and control equipment, and power generation plant and equipment; and plant engineering in process control and visualization systems. In addition, the company is involved in wastewater disposal, waste storage, laboratory, property rental, and other activities. The company is based in Police, Poland. Grupa Azoty Zaklady Chemiczne Police S.A. is a subsidiary of Grupa Azoty S.A.

name: PCF Group Spólka Akcyjna
summary: PCF Group SA is a Polish video game developer and publisher. The company develops and publishes games for PC and consoles. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Pepco Group NV
summary: Pepco Group N.V. operates as a prominent budget-friendly general merchandise retailer, serving customers across the United Kingdom, Poland, and other European nations. The company provides an extensive array of products, encompassing children's clothing, a wide selection of homeware such as toys, decorative items, and seasonal merchandise, alongside fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG). Its offerings also include groceries, health and beauty essentials, household goods, gardening tools, DIY supplies, pet products, stationery, books, and DVDs. As of September 30, 2021, the group managed a substantial network of 3,504 retail outlets, which comprised 2,464 Pepco stores, 801 Poundland locations, and 239 Dealz establishments. Established in 2014 and headquartered in London, United Kingdom, Pepco Group N.V. functions as a subsidiary of Pepco Holdco Limited.

name: PCC Rokita S.A.
summary: PCC Rokita SA manufactures and distributes a wide range of chemical products. The company's products include polyols, chlorine, and other specialty chemicals used in various industries. Its headquarters is located in Brzeg Dolny, Poland.

name: PCC Exol S.A.
summary: PCC Exol S.A. manufactures and distributes surfactants in Poland and internationally. The company provides anionic and nonionic surfactants. It primarily serves household and industrial chemical, textile, plastic, industrial cleaning, metal working, and other industries. The company is headquartered in Brzeg Dolny, Poland. PCC Exol S.A. is a subsidiary of PCC SE.

name: Photon Energy N.V.
summary: Photon Energy N.V., through its subsidiaries, provides solar power solutions and services worldwide. The company operates through Energy Solutions; Production of Electricity; FVE Investment; Operations, Maintenance, and PVPP Supervision; and Other segments. It had a portfolio of 69 power plants with an installed capacity of 57.1 MWp. The company is also involved in the design, development, finance, installation, operation, and maintenance of photovoltaic equipment focusing on green-field and rooftop installations. In addition, it offers project development; investment management; project finance; insurance; engineering, procurement, and construction; supervision services; and operations and maintenance services, as well as technology solutions for photovoltaic power plants. Further, the company engages in the import and wholesale of FVE components. Its power solutions provide solar and solar-hybrid power to a range of customers and applications. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

name: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki S.A.
summary: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki Spółka Akcyjna, commonly known as Bank Pekao S.A., is a Polish bank that provides a wide range of financial services to individuals, small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and corporate clients. These services include retail banking, corporate banking, investment banking, and asset management. Bank Pekao S.A. is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Polenergia S.A.
summary: Polenergia S.A., together with its subsidiaries, generates, distributes, and trades in electricity in Poland. The company operates through Onshore Wind Farms, Photovoltaics, Gas and Clean Fuels, Trading and Sales, and Distribution segments. The Onshore Wind Farms segment engages in the development, construction, and maintenance of facilities generating electrical energy from onshore wind. The Photovoltaics segment develops, constructs, and maintains facilities generating electrical energy using the solar radiation. The Gas and Clean Fuels segment is involved in the development, construction, and maintenance of facilities generating electrical energy in gas cogeneration; and development work in the manufacture of hydrogen and generation of energy from hydrogen based on the renewable sources originating energy. The Trading and Sales segment trades in electricity, and certificates of origin, and other energy market instruments; sells electricity to industrial customers; and provides market access services to energy producers using renewable energy sources. The Distribution segment offers electrical energy and gas distribution and sale services to commercial, industrial, and household customers. It also sells pellets. The company was formerly known as Polish Energy Partners Spolka Akcyjna. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Warsaw, Poland. Polenergia S.A. is a subsidiary of Mansa Investments Sp. z o.o.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna S.A.
summary: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna S.A. is a Polish energy company engaged in the generation, distribution, and sale of electricity and heat, as well as the exploration and extraction of lignite, headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: PMPG Polskie Media S.A.
summary: PMPG Polskie Media S.A., along with its various subsidiaries, is active across both traditional and emerging media sectors. The company's publishing portfolio includes the weekly journal WPROST, as well as Tygodnik Do Reczy and Historia Do Rzeczy magazines. Beyond these, the firm engages in the publication and distribution of a broad range of print materials such as books, newspapers, magazines, coloring books (colorages), and other serial publications. It also offers advertising solutions and manages event planning. The company, which was initially known as Platforma Mediowa Point Group Spólka Akcyjna, officially adopted the name PMPG Polskie Media S.A. in December 2014. Established in 1997, its corporate headquarters are located in Warsaw, Poland.

name: PGF Polska Grupa Fotowoltaiczna S.A.
summary: PGF Polska Grupa Fotowoltaiczna S.A. (PGF), an enterprise established in 1945, operates from its headquarters in Zielona Góra, Poland. The company specializes in the manufacturing of rolling stock and various steel structures. Beyond production, PGF's extensive operations also encompass container fabrication and repair, precision laser cutting, and sheet metal bending. Additionally, the firm provides a diverse suite of services, including equipment rental and leasing, comprehensive transport and shipping logistics, commercial vehicle servicing, financial solutions, and warehousing coupled with secure document archiving. Historically, the company was known as Zastal S.A.

name: Polski Holding Nieruchomosci S.A.
summary: Polski Hldg Nieruchomosci S.A.I likely represents investment shares in a Polish real estate holding company. It focuses on property investments within Poland.

name: Pharmena S.a.
summary: Pharmena S.A. engages in the sale of dietary supplements in Poland and internationally. It also develops 1-MNA (PHR-701 program), a medical device for use in difficult-to-heal wounds. In addition, the company is involved in research and development of therapeutic applications of 1 MNA as an anti-inflammatory and anti-fibrotic drug; and research and development at pulmonary fibrosis, respiratory tract infections, including viral infections, COVID-19, inflammatory diseases, metabolic diseases and other therapeutic applications. Pharmena S.A. was founded in 2002 and is based in Lódz, Poland. Pharmena S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Pelion S.A.

name: PJP Makrum S.A.
summary: PJP Makrum S.A. engages in manufactures and sells industrial equipment and provides industrial construction services in Poland and internationally. The company offers handling systems, aluminium façades, flood dams, crushing and grinding machines, parking platforms, industrial construction, forklifts, warehouse equipment, fire protection products, and aluminium joinery, lift-and-slide doors; and construction of office buildings, shopping centers, supermarkets, and residential buildings. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Bydgoszcz, Poland. PJP MAKRUM SA operates as a subsidiary of Immobile SA.

name: Polski Koncern Naftowy ORLEN Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Polski Koncern Naftowy ORLEN Spółka Akcyjna, a prominent energy conglomerate established in 1999 and headquartered in Płock, Poland, engages in a comprehensive array of activities spanning the crude oil value chain. Its operations, which include extraction, processing, refining, storage, and wholesale distribution, extend across numerous countries such as Poland, Germany, the Czech Republic, Lithuania, Malta, Sweden, Slovakia, Hungary, Estonia, Latvia, Canada, and China. The company's diverse business is organized into several key segments: Refining, Petrochemical, Energy, Retail, and Upstream. ORLEN offers an extensive product portfolio, including various fuels like petrol, diesel, LPG, biofuels, aviation fuels, and heating oils. Its petrochemical division manufactures aromatics such as phenol, benzene, paraxylene, and purified terephthalic acid, alongside olefins, polyolefins, plastics, glycols, and nitrogen fertilizers. Additional chemical products encompass acetone, ethylene oxide, masterbatch, advanced technical carbon black Chezacarb, caprolactam, soda lye, and sodium hypochlorite. Furthermore, it provides a wide range of lubricants, including base oils, automotive oils (for cars, motorbikes, trucks, marine, and agricultural use), industrial oils, paraffin, and solvents. Beyond its oil and chemical endeavors, ORLEN is a significant participant in the energy sector, producing, distributing, and transmitting both electricity and heat. The company boasts an impressive installed power capacity of approximately 3.4 GW and actively trades in thermal energy. Complementing its industrial operations, ORLEN maintained a substantial retail footprint with a network of 2,881 fuel stations as of December 31, 2021.

name: Powszechna Kasa Oszczednosci Bank Polski Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Powszechna Kasa Oszczednosci Bank Polski Spólka Akcyjna provides various banking products and services in Poland and internationally. It operates through three segments: Retail, Corporate and Investment, and Transfer Center and Other. The company offers current, currency, children and teenagers, and savings accounts; term deposits; and consumer, real estate, business, mortgage, and corporate loans. It also provides investment and insurance products; investment funds; credit, account, and debit cards; payments and online banking services; and private banking, electronic, and mobile banking services; leases and factoring services to firms and enterprises, developers, cooperatives, and property managers; and cash management and trade finance services, safekeeping of securities, and currency products and derivatives. In addition, the company is involved in agreement for financing large projects; issuing non-treasury securities; and investing and brokerage activities, as well as transactions in derivative instruments and debt securities; investment and pension fund management; sale of post-lease assets; securitization of lease receivables; lease of cars; outsourcing of IT specialists; and developing, leasing, buying, selling, and managing real estate. Further, it offers life, house and apartment, travel, health, banking product, and personal insurance; and transfer agent, debt collection, and fleet management services. It serves its products and services to individual customers, companies, enterprises, and corporations and local governments. The company was founded in 1919 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Pkp Cargo
summary: PKP Cargo S.A. is a prominent provider of rail freight transportation and comprehensive logistics solutions, operating extensively across Poland and in international markets. The company facilitates the railway movement of a wide array of goods, including bulk commodities like coal, coke, aggregates, and building materials, as well as timber, agricultural products, chemicals, liquid fuels, metals, ores, automotive components, and various specialized cargo. Complementing these services, PKP Cargo delivers intermodal transport, coordinating container shipments across integrated networks utilizing rail, sea, and road connections. To support its operations, PKP Cargo manages 25 strategically located handling terminals that offer crucial services such as cargo handling, storage, packaging, and forwarding. The company's expansive forwarding capabilities span rail, road, maritime, and air transport. Additionally, it oversees the operation, diagnostics, and maintenance of railway sidings, alongside conducting upkeep, modernization, and repairs of rolling stock. Beyond its core transport business, PKP Cargo engages in diverse activities including general goods distribution and coal trading. Industrial services offered encompass the physical decommissioning of carriages and locomotives, refurbishment of electrical machinery and wheelsets, and the precise weighing and calibration of rolling stock. Environmental management services are also provided, covering waste collection, processing, disposal, raw material recovery, and the cleaning of railway and road tanks. Furthermore, the company offers border and fleet management services. Its civil engineering division undertakes complex projects focused on the revitalization of post-industrial sites, encompassing mining operations, demolition, waste facility management, site liquidation, and soil remediation. PKP Cargo primarily serves key industrial sectors including mining, metallurgy, construction, chemicals, timber, food production, and automotive manufacturing. Established in 2001, the company maintains its headquarters in Warsaw, Poland.

name: PlayWay S.A.
summary: PlayWay S.A. is a developer and publisher of interactive entertainment titles for personal computers and mobile platforms. Its global operations encompass key territories such as Poland, Western Europe, Germany, and North America. The company distributes its diverse range of games via prominent digital storefronts, including Steam, Apple's App Store, and Google Play. Founded in 2011, PlayWay S.A. maintains its primary corporate headquarters in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Plaza Centers N.V.
summary: Plaza Centers N.V. does not have significant operations. Previously, it was involved in the establishment, operation, and sale of shopping and entertainment centers, as well as other mixed-use projects, such as retail, office, and residential projects in Central and Eastern Europe, and India. The company was formerly known as Plaza Centers (Europe) B.V. and changed its name to Plaza Centers N.V. in October 2006. Plaza Centers N.V. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

name: Pepees S.A.
summary: Pepees S.A. operates starch potato processing plants in Poland. The company manufactures and sells starches and starch products, as well as starch hydrolysates; engages in service activities related to the processing and preservation of fruit and vegetables; and produces and sells fruit and vegetable juices. It also offers potato starch with a range of applications in the food, pharmaceutical, paper, textile, and chemical industries; various glucose used by the food, confectionery, and pharmaceutical industries; maltodextrin, an important ingredient in powdered products, such as ice creams, sauces, soups, fruit extracts, and flavoured sprinkles; and nutritional, vitamin, and mineral preparations for children and athletes. In addition, the company provides starch syrups for use in the confectionery and baking industry; and potato grits and potato flakes used in the food industry. Further, it offers crystalline and anhydrous glucose, glucose syrups, hydrol, feedstuff potato protein, seed potatoes, plant protection products, and materials. Pepees S.A. was founded in 1960 and is based in Lomza, Poland.

name: NPL Nova S.A.
