summary: Founded in 2002 and based in Tarnowskie Góry, Poland, Pragma Inkaso S.A. delivers comprehensive debt collection and business financing services across the country. For entrepreneurs, the company provides diverse financial instruments like factoring, loans, and invoice discounting. Beyond direct financing, its operations encompass the liquidation of various assets, including investment, commercial, and industrial properties. It also specializes in acquiring and restructuring debt, managing bankruptcy proceedings, and performing valuations of mortgage securities. Additionally, Pragma Inkaso acquires and services portfolios of receivables from corporate, SME, and mortgage clients, and offers support for B2B receivables.

name: Prochem S.A.
summary: Prochem S.A., a Polish firm, specializes in a broad spectrum of engineering and construction solutions. Their initial phase offerings encompass preliminary concepts, detailed expert assessments, and technical guidance, alongside conducting viability studies for both new ventures and existing facility upgrades or expansions. The company's extensive service portfolio includes multifaceted design work, managing the acquisition of necessary permits and authorizations, and overseeing project implementation which covers sourcing materials and labor, and on-site construction supervision. Additionally, they offer dedicated project management, procurement assistance, holistic project delivery, and expert advisory services. Furthermore, Prochem S.A. provides installation for electrical systems and equipment, engages in property development, manages commercial properties, and offers property leasing. Their capabilities also extend to the technology sector, encompassing software solutions, integration of computer systems, and various IT services. They cater to clients across the industrial, building construction, and environmental protection sectors. Established in 1947, Prochem S.A. is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Protektor S.A.
summary: Established in 1944 and headquartered in Lublin, Poland, Protektor S.A. is a prominent player in the production, distribution, and global sales of specialized footwear. The company crafts safety, work, and military-grade footwear, serving a broad international market spanning Europe, Asia, Africa, and South America. Their extensive catalog provides essential footwear for demanding professions such as police, firefighters, military, and other uniformed services, as well as security personnel, healthcare workers, individuals in high-risk occupations, and hobbyists. All products are offered under their well-known PROTEKTOR and ABEBA brand names.

name: Porsche Automobil Holding SE
summary: Porsche Automobil Holding SE, through its subsidiaries, operates as an automobile manufacturer worldwide. It operates through two segments, PSE and Intelligent Transport Systems. The company offers motorcycles, small cars, and luxury vehicles, as well as commercial vehicles, such as pick-ups, buses, and heavy trucks under the Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, ŠKODA, Bentley, Bugatti, Lamborghini, Porsche, Ducati, Scania, and MAN brand names. It also develops software solutions for transport logistics, as well as traffic planning and management; and provides dealer and customer financing, leasing, banking, insurance, fleet management, and mobility services. Porsche has an agreement with ABB to develop a high-power charger for its electric vehicles in Japan. The company was formerly known as Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche Aktiengesellschaft and changed its name to Porsche Automobil Holding SE in November 2007. Porsche Automobil Holding SE is headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany.

name: Poltreg S.A.
summary: Poltreg S.A. is a biotechnology enterprise based in Gdansk, Poland, specializing in the creation of therapeutic solutions for autoimmune conditions. The company's research and development efforts are centered on harnessing T-regulatory cells to develop treatments, specifically targeting type 1 diabetes in children and multiple sclerosis.

name: Polwax S.A.
summary: Polwax S.A. produces and distributes refined and deodorized paraffin, waxes, and specialty industrial paraffin compositions. The company also offers anti-corrosion agents, anti-caking agents, casting waxes, hot-melt adhesives, and other industrial products, as well as candles and grave lights. Its products are used in fertilizer, rubber, food, and paper and packaging industries; the production of varnishes, paints, and construction materials; and the manufacture of wood impregnations, explosives, candles, and grave lights, as well as in investment casting and wood processing activities, and other special applications. Polwax S.A. was founded in 2012 and is based in Jaslo, Poland.

name: Polimex-Mostostal S.A.
summary: Polimex-Mostostal S.A. operates as an engineering and construction company in Poland and internationally. The company designs and constructs roads, bridges, railway infrastructure, large-size structures, and hydrotechnical infrastructure; supervises works; and provides contract management services. It also produces steel structures and platform grates, as well as offers various transport pallets and services related to steel products. In addition, the company constructs production plants, warehouses, and environmental protection facilities; and administrative and office buildings, shopping centers, multiplexes, halls, and sports stadiums. Further, it constructs storage tanks, industrial installations, terminals and transshipment ports, and fuel pipelines; provides repair services for refinery and petrochemical industries; and manufactures furnaces and process heaters, as well as offers assembly and commissioning services. Additionally, the company provides turnkey energy facilities in the field of air and water protection, flue gas desulfurization, dedusting, water treatment plants, and waste treatment plants; and services in the galvanizing and painting of steel structures. Polimex-Mostostal S.A. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen S.A.
summary: POWSZECHNY ZAKLAD UBEZP. (PZU) is a Polish insurance company providing a wide range of insurance products and services. These products and services include life insurance, property and casualty insurance, and other financial services to individuals and businesses. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Quantum software S.A.
summary: Quantum software S.A. provides IT systems for enterprises in the domain of logistics and delivery chain management in Poland and internationally. It offers Qguar Manufacturing Execution System, a manufacturing execution system that enables the user to model production processes and to monitor the course of their realization; Qguar Advanced Planning & Scheduling, a system designed for production planning and scheduling; Qguar Warehouse Management System (WMS) Pro, a system designed to support warehousing processes in company-owned warehouses or warehouses that rent storage space; and Qguar WMS Easyway and Qguar WMS e-Commerce solutions. The company also provides Qguar Material Flow Control, a system that takes care of communication between a WMS and automated warehousing equipment; Qguar Link4Ship, a software developed to provide on-line communication between the WMS and IT systems of courier services; Qguar Transport Management System (TMS), a software for transport management; Qguar TMS Mobile, a TMS designed for mobile devices; and Qguar DS System for planning of time windows and management of traffic in warehouse loading docks. It offers Qguar Yard Management System, a software that allows vehicle and pedestrian traffic to be controlled within plant premises; Qguar 4WEB system, a tool designed to carry out a specific set of activities by means of a web browser; Qguar DAS System for data archiving and reduction of production servers load; Qguar IFC, a ready-to-use tool for data exchange between Qguar and external systems; Qguar RPS system for the circulation of pallets and returnable packing units; Qguar SBS System; internet of things products and SCADA system; industrial sensors; and processes visualisation solutions. The company also provides implementation, training, support, wireless and cable network, and IT related services. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Kraków, Poland. Quantum software S.A. is a subsidiary of Quantum Assets Sp. z o.o.

name: Quercus TFI S.A.
summary: Quercus TFI S.A., a publicly traded investment management company established in August 2007, is based in Warsaw, Poland. The firm provides investment management and advisory services, primarily serving affluent and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. It develops and administers a diverse portfolio of mutual funds, covering equity, fixed income, commodity, multi-asset, and balanced strategies, while also managing customized portfolios tailored for individual clients. The company allocates capital across public equity, fixed income, and alternative markets, including commodities. Its investment approach relies on fundamental analysis, supported by proprietary in-house research, with a general emphasis on companies operating within the service sector.

name: Fabryka Obrabiarek RAFAMET S.A.
summary: Fabryka Obrabiarek RAFAMET S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of special purpose machine tools for wheelset machining worldwide. It offers machines for railways, including above and under floor wheel lathes, wheel boring machines, wheel and axle lathes, and shunting vehicles, as well as IT, measuring, diagnostic systems. The company also provides vertical turning and horizontal lathes. In addition, the company provides heavy-duty special-purpose machine tools for the customers in the machine-building, power generation, shipbuilding, metallurgical, and defense industries. Further, it offers large part machining, overhauling and modernization of machine tools, and design and software services. The company sells its products under the RAFAMET and POREBA brands. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1846 and is based in Kuznia Raciborska, Poland. Fabryka Obrabiarek RAFAMET S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Agencja Rozwoju Przemyslu S.A.

name: Rainbow Tours S.A.
summary: Established in 1990 and based in Lódz, Poland, Rainbow Tours S.A. functions as both a tour operator and a travel agency. The company extends its services across Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Lithuania, Belarus, and Ukraine.

name: Redan S.A.
summary: Established in 1995 and based in Łódź, Poland, Redan S.A. specializes in the design and distribution of apparel across the Polish market. The company markets its fashion collections, including those under the Top Secret, Troll, and Drywash labels, through a comprehensive retail network comprising its proprietary stores, independent franchise outlets, and its dedicated online sales platform.

name: Reinhold Europe AB (publ)
summary: Reinhold Europe AB (publ) operates in the real estate sector, offering a variety of related services. The company serves as a vendor and representative for prefabricated properties, notably specializing in modular constructions. Its portfolio includes building residences for senior citizens and permanent housing for immigrant communities. Additionally, Reinhold Europe is involved in developing prefabricated apartment modules suitable for both temporary and long-term accommodation solutions. The firm, which was formerly known as Reinhold Polska AB, officially changed its name to Reinhold Europe AB (publ) in May 2014. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Stockholm, Sweden.

name: Relpol S.A.
summary: Relpol S.A. is a global manufacturer and supplier of relays. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a diverse range of relay types, such as electromagnetic (including subminiature, miniature PCB power, industrial, installation, interface, programmable, time, monitoring, solid state, and CZIP protection models). Additionally, Relpol provides related components like plug-in sockets, various accessories, signal lamps, contactors, power supply units, surge arresters, and radiation portal monitoring equipment. These offerings are widely deployed across numerous sectors, including industrial and power automation, power electronics, general industrial and applied electronics, telecommunications, and household appliances. Established in 1958, Relpol S.A. is headquartered in Zary, Poland.

name: Remak-Energomontaz S.A.
summary: Remak-Energomontaz S.A. specializes in the modernization and repair of steam and water boilers, serving clients both in Poland and across international markets. Its expertise extends to the installation of various energy infrastructure, including power equipment, flue gas desulphurization (FGD) systems, electrostatic precipitators, and industrial pipelines. Additionally, the firm handles the refurbishment and construction of power plants, focusing on critical components like pressure vessels and steam pipelines, and provides comprehensive repair services for pressure equipment. Further offerings include destructive and non-destructive testing (NDT), specialized welding and radiographic inspections, the development of bespoke repair technologies, and the installation and maintenance of diverse industrial installations. Founded in 1970, Remak-Energomontaz S.A. is headquartered in Warszawa, Poland.

name: REINO Capital S.A.
summary: REINO Capital S.A. focuses on investment and portfolio management within the commercial property sector. The company, previously known as Graviton Capital S.A., adopted its current name in December 2018. Its main corporate offices are situated in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Render
summary: Based in Łódź, Poland, Render Cube S.A. is a game developer and publisher that commenced operations in 2012. The company specializes in creating and distributing simulation, strategy, and survival games for both personal computers and consoles, reaching audiences across Poland and around the world.

name: Rank Progress S.A.
summary: Rank Progress S.A. is a real estate firm specializing in the investment, development, leasing, and sale of commercial properties. Operating both in Poland and internationally, the company constructs a diverse range of projects, including shopping centers, retail malls, residential buildings, service establishments, and office complexes. Established in 1997, Rank Progress S.A. is headquartered in Legnica, Poland.

name: Zaklady Magnezytowe ROPCZYCE S.A.
summary: Zaklady Magnezytowe ROPCZYCE S.A., established in 1971 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, is a manufacturer and international supplier of essential and high-temperature refractory materials. The company's extensive portfolio includes a wide array of pre-formed (shaped) refractories. Among its burned shaped products are magnesia, magnesia-chrome, magnesia-spinel (with and without ZrO2 additions), magnesia-zirconia, forsterite, zirconia, alumina-chrome, nitride-bonded alumina, silica, aluminosilicate, and alumina refractories. Unburned shaped refractories offered encompass magnesia-graphite, magnesia-carbon, alumina-magnesia-carbon, magnesia-spinel-graphite, magnesia-chrome, alumina-graphite, and aluminosilicate types. Additionally, the firm provides precast shapes crafted from low-cement alumina-spinel, spinel, basic, and aluminosilicate castables. For furnace installations, ROPCZYCE supplies unshaped refractories designed for various functions, such as mortars, construction and patching mixes, and protective coatings. Its specialized refractory offerings include gas-purging components, RH snorkels, monolithic roofs for electric arc furnaces, Maerz Kiln monolithic pillars, and various tapping sets for electric arc furnaces, oxygen converters, steel ladles, and metering tapping sets for tundishes. The company serves a diverse range of industries, including iron and steel production, non-ferrous metal processing, glass manufacturing, cement and lime production, coke production, and foundries.

name: Ryvu Therapeutics S.A.
summary: Ryvu Therapeutics S.A., a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, engages in developing of novel small molecule therapies for treatment of oncology. Its lead candidate, SEL120, is a CDK8 kinase inhibitor with potential for development in hematological malignancies and solid tumors, which is in Phase 1b study for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndrome. The company's products also include SEL24/MEN1703, a dual PIM/FLT3 kinase inhibitor licensed to the Menarini Group has completed Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia. In addition, its early pipeline candidates include candidates in the area of kinases, cancer metabolism, synthetic lethality, and immuno-oncology. Ryvu Therapeutics S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Kraków, Poland.

name: RWE Aktiengesellschaft
summary: RWE Aktiengesellschaft generates and supplies electricity from renewable and conventional sources primarily in Europe and the United States. It operates through five segments: Offshore Wind; Onshore Wind/Solar; Hydro/Biomass/Gas; Supply & Trading; and Coal/Nuclear. The company generates wind, solar, hydro, nuclear, gas, and biomass electricity. It also trades in energy commodities; and operates gas storage facilities. The company serves commercial, industrial, and corporate customers. RWE Aktiengesellschaft was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Essen, Germany.

name: Rawlplug S.A.
summary: Rawlplug S.A., established in 1887 and headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland (formerly known as Koelner S.A. until its name change in 2013), is a global enterprise specializing in the production, installation, and distribution of a wide array of fastening solutions and tools. Their extensive product lineup encompasses various power tools, such as cordless options, batteries, chargers, and storage equipment, along with a comprehensive selection of power tool accessories including diverse drill bits, chisels, sockets, sawing blades, diamond tools, and grinding wheels. They also offer a range of hand tools. The company provides numerous anchoring systems, from chemical bonded anchors (like injection cartridge and capsule systems) to mechanical anchors (including heavy-duty expansion, screw, and through-bolt types), as well as lightweight fixings designed for frames, plasterboard, and other applications. Additional offerings include specialized fixings for façade and roofing insulation, passive fire protection systems, foams, sealants, protective and cleaning supplies, and both direct and manual fastening systems. Beyond products, Rawlplug S.A. delivers comprehensive support services, which feature a technical helpdesk, on-site technical assistance, equipment repair services, and the provision of spare parts.

name: Banco Santander, S.A.
summary: Banco Santander, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides various retail and commercial banking products and services to individuals, small and medium-sized enterprises, and large companies worldwide. It offers demand and time deposits, and current and savings accounts; mortgages, consumer finance, syndicated corporate loans, structured financing, cash management, export and agency finance, trade and working capital solutions, and corporate finance; and insurance products. The company also provides cash, asset, and wealth management; and private banking services. In addition, it is involved in the corporate banking; treasury, risk hedging, foreign trade, confirming, custody, and investment banking activities. The company operates through a network of 11,236 branches. The company was formerly known as Banco Santander Central Hispano S.A. and changed its name to Banco Santander, S.A. in June 2007. Banco Santander, S.A. was founded in 1856 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain.

name: Scope Fluidics S.A.
summary: Scope Fluidics S.A. is a biotechnology firm dedicated to conceiving and advancing initiatives that harness microfluidic technologies within medical diagnostics and the broader healthcare landscape. Among its key offerings is BacterOMIC, a specialized system for conducting antibiotic susceptibility testing. This enterprise, established in 2010, conducts its operations from Warsaw, Poland.

name: Seko S.A.
summary: Seko S.A. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse array of fish and seafood products. Their extensive range includes fresh and processed fish, delectable spreads, various salads, canned and miniature fish selections, convenient ready meals, and frozen items. Noteworthy offerings feature Greek cod and "round'n'round" herring products. The company further provides an assortment of pickled goods (both vinegar and oil-based), premium fillets, savory roast products (available with marinade or sauce), galantines, and a variety of sandwich spreads, encompassing both herring-based and vegetable options. Some products are conveniently packaged in aluminum foil containers. With operations spanning Poland, Germany, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Romania, Italy, France, and Lithuania, Seko S.A. boasts a broad European footprint. Founded in 1992, the enterprise is based in Chojnice, Poland, and operates as a subsidiary of Zlota Rybka Sp. Z.o.o.

name: Selena FM S.A.
summary: Selena FM S.A., through its subsidiaries, produces, distributes, and sells construction chemicals, building materials for doors and windows, and general building accessories to professional contractors and individual users. Its products include polyurethane foams, adhesives, sealants, insulation systems, flooring systems, interior wall systems, ceramic tile systems, construction mortars, waterproofing materials, passive fire protection solutions, and other products primarily under the Tytan, Artelit, Quilosa, Cool-R, and Matizol brand names. The company's products are used for various applications, such as windows and doors, walls and ceilings, kitchens and bathrooms, installations, floors, thermal insulation, facades, claddings, roofs, foundations, and terraces and balconies. It also provides various solutions for the woodworking, upholstery, window and door manufacturing, assembly, and packaging industries. The company operates in European Union, Eastern Europe, Asia, North America, and South America. Selena FM S.A. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: AS Silvano Fashion Group
summary: AS Silvano Fashion Group designs, manufactures, distributes, and retails women's lingerie. The company sells its lingerie, beachwear, and underwear products under the Milavitsa, Lauma Lingerie, Alisee, Aveline, Laumelle, and Hidalgo brands through wholesale channel and franchised sales, as well as through Milavitsa and Lauma Lingerie retail stores. It also offers logistics services. As of December 31, 2019, the company had 666 branded stores, including 628 Milavitsa and 38 Lauma Lingerie stores, which include 556 franchise and 86 Group 110 operated retail stores in Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, the Baltics, and internationally. AS Silvano Fashion Group was founded in 1908 and is based in Tallinn, Estonia.

name: Sfinks Polska S.A.
summary: Sfinks Polska S.A. is actively involved in both managing and franchising restaurants within the casual dining sector. The company maintains a substantial network of 117 dining establishments spanning Poland, the Czech Republic, and Hungary. These outlets operate under its distinct brand names: Sphinx, WOOK, and Chlopskie Jadlo. Established in 1995, its central corporate functions are performed from its headquarters situated in Piaseczno, Poland.

name: Sygnity S.A.
summary: Sygnity S.A. provides IT products and services in Poland and internationally. The company engages in the production, purchase, and sale of integrated IT systems, infrastructure, and hardware for the banking, finance, insurance, industry and energy, and public administration sectors. It also offers spatial information, geodesy, and cartography services; supplies software and IT services; and sells software and computer hardware, as well as provides electricity trading services. The company was formerly known as Computerland Poland SA and changed its name to Sygnity S.A. in April 2007. Sygnity S.A. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Soho Development S.A.
summary: Soho Development S.A. operates as an investment vehicle, primarily directing its capital towards real estate, healthcare, food, and publishing sectors, as well as emerging companies in their initial growth phases. The firm, which was established in 1994 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, was formerly known as Black Lion Fund S.A. before officially changing its designation to Soho Development S.A. in May 2015.

name: Starhedge S.A.
summary: Starhedge S.A. functions as an investment firm with a broad mandate, deploying capital across diverse sectors both within Poland and on an international scale. Its strategic investments target the energy industry (encompassing both conventional and renewable sources), the financial services sector, commodity markets, real estate, and innovative technologies. The firm's portfolio includes acquiring equity in businesses within these sectors, alongside direct involvement in commodities like fuels, industrial minerals, precious metals, and foodstuffs. Beyond direct stakes, Starhedge also allocates capital to other financial instruments, such as derivatives, as well as corporate and government bonds. The company's operations further involve trading shares of publicly listed entities, issuing and distributing financial products, and conducting in-depth analytical research on individual companies and market segments. Established in 1970, Starhedge S.A. is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: SimFabric S.A.
summary: SimFabric S.A. is a Polish entity specializing in the development, porting, and publishing of computer games. Their creative output encompasses both detailed computer simulators and a variety of other interactive titles, designed for availability across personal computers (PCs) and mobile devices. Established in 2016, the company maintains its headquarters in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Fabryka Farb i Lakierow Sniezka S.A.
summary: Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Sniezka SA manufactures and sells paints and varnishes in Poland. The company primarily provides its products under the Sniezka, Magnat, Vidaron, Foveo-Tech, and Beston brands. It primarily exports its products. Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Sniezka SA was founded in 1984 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Skarbiec Holding S.A.
summary: Skarbiec Holding S.A. is a Polish financial institution dedicated to establishing and managing investment funds within the country. The company's diverse activities include providing general management services, engaging in securities trading, and offering a range of ancillary financial and intermediation services. It further extends its expertise to portfolio management for financial instruments, alongside distributing participation units and investment certificates for its funds. Skarbiec Holding serves a broad client base, encompassing both private individuals and corporate entities. The firm, headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, officially changed its name from Skarbiec Holding Sp. z o.o. to Skarbiec Holding S.A. in March 2014.

name: Skyline Investment S.A.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Warsaw, Poland, Skyline Investment S.A. delivers a comprehensive suite of investment and financial advisory services. The company's financial consultancy expertise encompasses guiding public share offerings, facilitating mergers and acquisitions, managing both public and private placements of debt instruments, and securing capital from private markets. Its offerings further extend to include fund management, temporary executive leadership, mandated administrative duties, raising capital for environmental initiatives, and strategies for optimizing electricity costs and usage. Established in 1997, the firm was initially known as Przedsiebiorstwo Skyline Investment S.A. before its re-branding to Skyline Investment S.A. in October 2006.

name: Selvita S.A.
summary: Selvita S.A., a contract research organization (CRO), provides its services across Poland, throughout Europe, in the United States, and to global clients. The company is structured around two main divisions: its core Contract Research Organization (CRO) offerings and Bioinformatics. Within its drug discovery portfolio, Selvita delivers a comprehensive suite of services including assay development and screening, expertise in medicinal and synthetic chemistry, advanced computer-aided drug design leveraging artificial intelligence, structural biology, in vitro and in vivo pharmacology studies, ADME/DMPK assessments, and general analytical testing. Furthermore, Selvita extends its capabilities to pharmaceutical services, encompassing drug testing and bioanalytical analysis. These services cover development and optimization processes, validation and transfer, stability studies, rigorous quality control, and assistance with regulatory compliance. The organization also engages in diverse research and development activities, such as process research, bespoke laboratory-scale synthesis of New Chemical Entities (NCEs), industrial chemistry solutions, and the creation of isotopically labeled compounds. Support for the agrochemical industry is also part of their R&D offerings. Moreover, Selvita delivers specialized bio-data science and sophisticated software solutions tailored for data-centric organizations within the life science and healthcare sectors. Established in 2007, Selvita S.A. maintains its headquarters in Krakow, Poland.

name: Sanok Rubber Company Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Sanok Rubber Company Spólka Akcyjna provides rubber products, rubber-to-metal articles, and rubber with other materials for automotive, construction, agriculture, pharmacy, and household appliance markets in Europe and internationally. The company offers anti-vibration systems for springs and dampers, stabilizer bars and links, exhaust systems, steering systems, suspension arms, and subframes; car body sealing systems for convertibles, passenger cars, vans, and trucks lorries; gaskets for PVC, aluminum, wooden windows, gutters, facade systems, ventilation systems, and garage gates; and self-adhesive gaskets for wood joinery. It also provides V-belts, harvest belts, and garden belts; closures for containers; and pistons for disposable syringes and insulin pen injectors. In addition, the company offers household appliances, such as dampers for motors and fans; rubber bumpers and limiters; profiles to seal covers made of solid and porous rubber; door gaskets; accordion hoses; straight and profiled hoses for water supply and discharge; and open- and closed-loop sealing profiles made of porous and solid rubber. Further, it provides accumulator bladders for industry and automotive, rubber-metal rings, and membranes for heating and potable water tanks; and rubber and porous rubber compounds. The company was formerly known as Stomil Sanok S.A. and changed its name to Sanok Rubber Company Spólka Akcyjna in November 2015. Sanok Rubber Company Spólka Akcyjna was founded in 1932 and is based in Sanok, Poland.

name: Synektik Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Synektik Spólka Akcyjna, founded in 2001 and headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, operates as a comprehensive provider of products, services, and information technology solutions within the Polish market. The company focuses its offerings on the fields of surgery, diagnostic imaging, and nuclear medicine. Its core business activities include the distribution of medical equipment utilized in diagnostics, therapy, and nuclear medicine, alongside the creation of specialized IT solutions for radiology. Synektik also manufactures and supplies radiopharmaceutical products crucial for cancer diagnostics. In addition to these, it maintains a research laboratory dedicated to advancing diagnostic imaging systems and runs a service center for medical apparatus. The company further extends its services to include maintenance for medical equipment and the execution of essential acceptance and specialist tests.

name: Sanwil Holding S.A.
summary: Sanwil Holding Spólka Akcyjna engages in the production and sale of coated products. The company also manufactures and sells fabrics for furniture, footwear, and other industries, such as medical, clothing, transport, tarpaulins, specialist technical fabrics. The company operates in Poland, the rest of European Union countries, and Ukraine. Sanwil Holding Spólka Akcyjna was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Lublin, Poland.

name: Sunex S.A.
summary: Founded in 2002 and based in Racibórz, Poland, Sunex S.A. is a manufacturer and supplier of diverse renewable energy solutions. Its product portfolio encompasses items such as heat pumps, solar panels, thermo-siphons, and an extensive range of associated components like water heater tanks, pump stations, solar controllers, and hybrid systems. In addition to its energy offerings, the company provides sheet metal forming services, including bending, cutting, and punching. Sunex S.A., a subsidiary of Polska Ekologia Sp. z o.o., serves both the domestic Polish market and international customers through exports.

name: Sonel S.A.
summary: Sonel S.A., established in 1994 and headquartered in Swidnica, Poland, develops and distributes a wide array of measurement and diagnostic instruments globally for the power generation and telecommunications industries. The company's offerings span crucial electrical safety testing and verification equipment, including devices for low resistance measurements, fault detection, and leakage current monitoring, as well as illuminance meters and portable power quality analyzers. For advanced analysis, Sonel provides thermal imagers, pyrometers, and UV cameras. Their general instrument range features high-voltage apparatus, laboratory equipment, and fundamental electrical measurement tools such as multimeters, clamp meters, voltage testers, and other handheld devices. To complement its hardware, Sonel offers an extensive selection of accessories, including various clamps, adapters, test leads, probes, battery packs, and carrying cases, along with specific attachments for thermal imagers. Furthermore, the company delivers a comprehensive suite of software, encompassing solutions for instrument data retrieval (Sonel Reader), generating electrical installation test documentation (Sonel Reports Plus, Pat Analysis), thermal image analysis (Sonel ThermoAnalyze), and dedicated applications for analyzers (Sonel Analysis). Additionally, Sonel provides numerous mobile applications for its instruments (e.g., Sonel Multimeter Mobile, Sonel PAT Analysis Mobile, Sonel MPI Mobile, Sonel Analysis Mobile), alongside control software, terminal applications, and simulators.

name: Sopharma AD
summary: Sopharma AD, an international pharmaceutical company founded in Sofia, Bulgaria, in 1933, specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of a wide array of healthcare products. Its offerings span medicinal substances, finished drug formulations, veterinary vaccines, infusion solutions, and disposable plastic medical devices for both human and animal health, in addition to food supplements. The company's diverse product portfolio addresses numerous therapeutic categories, including cardiology, gastroenterology, pain management, cough and cold remedies, immunology and dermatology, respiratory conditions (like asthma), neurology and psychiatry, urology, and gynecology. Key products include Carsil for gastrointestinal issues, the analgesic Tempalgin, Tabex for smoking cessation, Tribestan to support sexual system functions, Broncholytin for coughs, the common pain reliever Analgin, Nivalin for peripheral nervous system disorders, and Methylprednisolon for severe allergies and critical medical situations. Beyond its core pharmaceutical business, Sopharma AD engages in a variety of other ventures. These include providing secondary packaging services for pharmaceuticals, leasing real estate, and operating in the retail sector for medicines and medical equipment. The company also handles the cultivation, collection, and trade of herbs and medicinal plants. Furthermore, it is involved in the trading, transport, and packaging of radioactive materials and nuclear equipment for medical applications, as well as household electronics and electrical equipment. Sopharma AD also offers market and public opinion research, provides franchising and know-how, and participates in various consulting and non-pharmaceutical activities, such as the production of veterinary vaccines and infusion solutions.

name: Spyrosoft Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Spyrosoft Spólka Akcyjna functions as a dedicated software engineering firm, providing a comprehensive array of software development services. Their expertise covers advanced areas such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, enterprise and embedded software engineering, and cloud solutions. Furthermore, they offer services including business and product design, optimization, technology consulting, and managed support. The company caters to a diverse range of sectors, including automotive, financial services, geospatial, and the employee experience and education industries, among others. Established in 2016, Spyrosoft maintains its headquarters in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Stalprofil S.A.
summary: Stalprofil S.A. operates as an international distributor of steel products, serving markets both within Poland and globally. Its diverse product catalog features an array of steel forms, including hot-rolled profiles, channels, equal-leg and unequal angles, and T-bars. The company also supplies cold-formed profiles, such as square and rectangular sections and channels, alongside flat, round, square, drawn, and ribbed bars, as well as wire rods. Furthermore, Stalprofil offers hot-rolled and cold-rolled plates, along with patterned sheets. A significant portion of its offerings comprises various I-beams, including standard, economical parallel, wide flange, W-shape, and special economical types, as well as ordinary, economical, and UPE channels. Beyond general steel materials, the company specializes in manufacturing and selling external anti-corrosive insulation for steel pipes and tubes, primarily destined for transmission pipeline construction. It also acts as a crucial supplier of pipes and tubes for a wide array of sectors, such as gas engineering, fuel, heat engineering, water pipelines, sewage systems, and other industrial applications. To complement its material supply, Stalprofil S.A. provides services like steel structure assembly and protective painting. Established in 1988, Stalprofil S.A. is headquartered in Dabrowa Górnicza, Poland.

name: Stalprodukt S.A.
summary: Stalprodukt S.A., a Polish enterprise operating with its subsidiaries, specializes in the production and sale of a wide array of processed steel products. Its extensive operations are organized into three primary divisions: Electrical Sheets, Profiles, and Zinc. The company's product portfolio encompasses cold-rolled electrical steel, a diverse range of cold-rolled sections including closed and open structural profiles, precision structural tubing, reinforcing sections for PVC profiles, and specialized sections. It also provides both cold and hot rolled sheets, coils, and strips, in addition to transformer cores and steel safety barriers. Beyond manufacturing, Stalprodukt S.A. engages in the wholesale distribution of steel commodities, the fabrication of steel structures and spare parts, the provision of repair services, and the creation of metallic elements for construction applications. Furthermore, its activities extend to offering galvanizing and security services, producing galvanized strips and wires, extracting non-ferrous metals, manufacturing zinc and lead, and designing renewable energy solutions. The firm's offerings are also supplied to international markets. Established in 1971 and headquartered in Bochnia, Poland, the company was previously known as ZPH Stalprodukt S.A. before adopting its current name, Stalprodukt S.A., in 2005.

name: Satis Group S.A.
summary: Satis Group S.A., through its subsidiary, develops and provides software-related services in Poland. The company offers web and mobile applications; IT HR outsourcing services; integration of IT systems; and other applications. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Stalexport Autostrady S.A.
summary: Stalexport Autostrady S.A., along with its affiliated companies, is engaged in the development and management of motorways throughout Poland. A key part of its operations involves overseeing the Katowice-Kraków section of the A4 highway. Beyond its core business, the firm also undertakes construction projects for general roads and railways, and leases office and parking facilities. Established in 1963 and based in Myslowice, Poland, the company was formerly known as STALEXPORT S.A. before adopting its current name, Stalexport Autostrady S.A., in September 2007.

name: Synthaverse S.A.
summary: Synthaverse S.A., a pharmaceutical company, manufactures and sells medicinal preparations, medical devices, and laboratory reagents in Poland, rest of the European Union, and internationally. It operates through BCG and Traditional segments. The company offers OnkoBCG 50 and 100, which are oncological immunotherapy products used to treat superficial and non-invasive bladder tumors; GAMMA anty-D 50 and GAMMA anty-D 150, which are human anti-rh0(d) immunoglobulin products used in the prevention of maternal-fetal conflict in terms of the D antigen with the Rh system; GAMMA anty HBs 200 medications for use in passive prophylaxis hepatitis B virus; and BCG 10 tuberculosis vaccines. It also provides Distreptaza, a gynecology and proctology reagent used in medical laboratories, in case of poisoning with pesticides and biochemical and chemical-analytical tests; LAKCID, which is a lactobacillus probiotic drug; and pseudocholinoesteraza, which is a laboratory reagent. In addition, the company engages in the contract production of injection drugs, lyophilisates of active substances in sterile sealed vials, active substances and drugs based on surface and submerged biological culture, and suppository forms of drugs. The company was formerly known as BIOMED-LUBLIN Wytwórnia Surowic i Szczepionek S.A. and changed its name to Synthaverse S.A. in July 2023. Synthaverse S.A. was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Lublin, Poland.

name: Silvair, Inc.
summary: Silvair, Inc. builds and provides software solutions for the Internet of Things in the European Union and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Lighting Control, Smart Lighting Services, and Smart Building Management. It focuses on developing a technology for lighting manufacturers and providers of intelligent building management systems. Its products include lighting firmware enables wireless communication with other devices using the Bluetooth Mesh technology; and digital tools for commissioning, configuration and management of smart lighting networks. The company also provides lighting infrastructure diagnostics; emergency lighting system test automation; energy consumption monitoring; and remote control and configuration of the lighting installation. The company was formerly known as Seed Labs, Inc. Silvair, Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: Seco/Warwick S.A.
summary: Seco/Warwick S.A. is a global producer and vendor of advanced heat treatment systems and related industrial equipment, serving customers across the European Union, Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, the United States, Asia, and other international markets. Its operations are structured into five key divisions: Vacuum Furnaces, Aluminium Heat Treatment Lines, Atmosphere Furnaces, Melting Furnaces, and a dedicated Aftersales support segment. The company offers specialized controlled atmosphere brazing furnaces and comprehensive aluminum heat treatment solutions, which are vital for diverse sectors such as automotive, engineering, energy, aerospace, marine, chemical, defense, and electronics. Furthermore, Seco/Warwick delivers thermal heat treatment furnace systems integral to a wide array of applications, including aerospace, automotive, manufacturing of bars and bearings, commercial heat treatment, defense, electrical steels, energy production, extrusion dies, machinery, saw and blade production, springs, steel coils, titanium processing, transmission and gears, and tube and pipe fabrication. Another core offering includes vacuum heat treatment furnaces, critical for sectors like aerospace, automotive, defense, medical, metallurgical, nuclear, and utility, alongside vacuum metallurgical equipment essential for aerospace, energy, defense, powder metallurgy, medical, automotive, and nuclear applications. Beyond equipment sales, the company provides comprehensive after-sales support, encompassing spare parts, repair services, routine maintenance, and expert technical assistance. Established in 1991, Seco/Warwick S.A. is headquartered in Swiebodzin, Poland.

name: Tarczynski S.A.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Trzebnica, Poland, Tarczynski S.A. is a company established in 1989 that specializes in the comprehensive processing, production, distribution, and sale of various meat products throughout the country. The company's extensive portfolio features popular items such as kabanos sausages, frankfurters, and traditional sausages, alongside specialized offerings like protein snacks, meat chips, ham, fillets, and a dedicated line of products for children. Marketed under the well-known TARCZYNSKI brand, these goods are distributed to a broad customer base through retail stores, wholesale partners, and extensive commercial networks.

name: T-Bull S.A.
summary: T-Bull S.A. engages in the design, manufacture, and distribution of games for mobile devices in Poland. The company's games include Tank Battle Heroes, Idle Racing GO, Top Speed, Moto Rider GO, Traffic Xtreme 3D, Best Sniper, Racing Xtreme, Top Boat, Road Racing, and Top Bike. It provides its games through various platforms. The company is based in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Ten Square Games S.A.
summary: Operating on a global scale, Ten Square Games S.A. specializes in the full lifecycle of digital entertainment, encompassing the development, production, distribution, licensing, and continuous support for computer software, as well as games across PC, console, online, and mobile platforms. The company additionally offers its own online environments for computer games. Its collection of free-to-play titles is made available through social media platforms, an extensive network of partner sites, and major digital marketplaces including Google Play, the App Store, Huawei's platform, and the Microsoft Store. Founded in 2011, Ten Square Games S.A. is headquartered in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: TenderHut S.A.
summary: Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Bialystok, Poland, TenderHut S.A. delivers a wide array of IT solutions. The company's operations are divided into distinct segments: Software Development & Cybersec, Digital Design & Marketing, Lab Systems, and Venture Building. TenderHut specializes in creating, adapting, and deploying various IT systems, encompassing web portals, mobile applications, and bespoke software, alongside offering IT outsourcing services. Furthermore, it provides specialized legal advice, consulting, and financing services to software houses, startups, and other enterprises within the IT and high-tech sectors, including comprehensive cybersecurity provisions.

name: Talex S.A.
summary: Talex S.A. is an IT service provider specializing in system integration, hardware deployment, and IT project execution. Its primary focus areas include integrating information and communication technology (ICT) systems, IT outsourcing, and crafting bespoke software solutions. For ICT integration, the company delivers comprehensive services, spanning from initial analysis and consultation to project design and management. This involves developing and implementing integration protocols, configuring and optimizing systems across various platforms like Intel/RISC, UNIX, i5/OS, Windows, and Linux, as well as providing staff training. Their integration offerings also cover consolidation, virtualization, and robust backup and recovery solutions. Additionally, Talex provides information security services, such as preventing cyber intrusions into ICT networks and establishing private virtual networks. The company's network integration capabilities encompass technologies like DWDM, IP telephony, structured cabling, and network surveillance. Beyond integration, Talex manages the complete lifecycle of IT hardware and software, including installation, relocation, modification, and decommissioning, alongside infrastructure replacement. They also offer IT infrastructure management, technical support, contact center operations, and analytical system support, in addition to distributing and servicing computer hardware. Talex further extends its portfolio with data center services, encompassing colocation, hosting, and cloud computing. These are complemented by disaster recovery, data backup, and monitoring services, alongside strategic business continuity planning. In the realm of software development, the company creates custom applications, builds specialized solutions for the banking sector, develops modules to enhance existing applications, tailors applications to client-specific requirements, and writes code for integration processes. Serving a diverse clientele, Talex S.A. partners with financial institutions, governmental entities, major industrial corporations, banks, and both large and medium-sized businesses. Established in 1998, the company operates from its headquarters in Poznan, Poland.

name: Tatry mountain resorts, a.s.
summary: Tatry mountain resorts, a.s., together with its subsidiaries, provides tourism services in Slovakia. It operates through seven segments: Mountains Resorts, Leisure Parks, Golf, Dining, Sports Services and Stores, Hotels, and Real Estate. The Mountains Resorts segment owns or leases, and operates mountain resorts in the High and Low Tatras, in the Czech Republic, and in the Polish Beskid Mountains, as well as in Austria with a total of 137 kilometers of ski trails. The Leisure Parks segment operates Aquapark Tatralandia and Legendia- Silesian Amusement Park in Poland. The Golf segment leases and operates two golf resorts in the Czech Republic. The Dining segment's facilities include restaurants, bars, après ski bars, and fast-food joints on and off the slopes of the mountain resorts, in the leisure parks, and in the golf resorts. The Sports Services and Stores segment operates sport services and stores under the Tatry Motion, Szczyrk Motion, and Ješted Motion brands that comprise specialized stores with ski and snowboard goods, ski schools, and sports equipment rentals; and leisure parks stores that sell souvenirs and specialized summer and sports merchandise. The Hotels segment owns or leases, and operates a portfolio of hotels in the company's resorts with the capacity of approximately 2,300 beds. The Real Estate segment engages in the development, construction, and sale of apartments and other infrastructures. The company was formerly known as Jasná Nízke Tatry, a.s. and changed its name to Tatry mountain resorts, a.s. in June 2009. Tatry mountain resorts, a.s. was founded in 1992 and is based in Liptovský Mikuláš, Slovakia.

name: TOYA S.a.
summary: Established in 1990 and based in Wroclaw, Poland, TOYA S.A. operates as a leading manufacturer and international supplier of an extensive range of hand and power tools. The company's vast product portfolio caters to a multitude of professional trades and domestic needs. Its hand tool offerings encompass a comprehensive selection including various wrenches, socket sets, torque tools, screwdrivers, pliers, striking tools like hammers and chisels, clamping devices, and specialized automotive equipment. Furthermore, TOYA S.A. provides a full spectrum of tools for electrical work, cutting, hydraulics, fastening, construction, precise measurement, pneumatic applications, power generation, gardening, and essential health and safety articles. In the power tool category, the company delivers a robust assortment featuring impact drills, rotary hammers, cordless devices, grinders, polishers, an array of saws (jig and circular), planers, decorative tools, heat and soldering guns, paint and mortar mixers, and stationary workshop machinery. Their offerings extend to submersible pumps, vacuum cleaners, and electric pressure washers. Beyond these, the inventory includes welding equipment, security items such as safes and padlocks, and practical tool storage solutions like bags, boxes, and trolleys. Notably, TOYA S.A. also diversifies its product catalog to include bathroom fixtures and accessories. This segment features items such as faucets, shower systems, hoses, heads, pop-up wastes, handles, panels, rails, scales, toilet seats, and various connection hoses. The company markets its diverse merchandise through a distinguished collection of brands, namely YATO, FALA, FLO, POWER UP, STHOR, VOREL, LUND, and TOYA GIFTS.

name: Torpol S.A.
summary: Torpol S.A. engages in construction of railway infrastructure in Poland. The company offers railway infrastructure services in the construction and modernization of railway stations, tracks, and lines; implements track works; constructs overhead catenary system, power supply, and train traffic and control systems; and road and civil engineering structures. It also provides oil and gas infrastructure, including design and construction services for installation of the oil and gas, chemical and petrochemical, energy, and hydrogen industries. In addition, the company offers urban infrastructure and machinery and equipment. Torpol S.A. was founded in 1991 and is based in Poznan, Poland.

name: Tower Investments S.A.
summary: Tower Investments S.A., a Polish real estate developer headquartered in Warsaw, was established in 2005. The company specializes in creating retail properties, including shopping malls and retail parks operating under the SHOPIN brand, alongside developing versatile multi-purpose buildings that integrate both residential and commercial functions.

name: TAURON Polska Energia S.A.
summary: Tauron Polska Energia S.A. is a Polish energy holding company involved in the generation, distribution, and sale of electricity and heat. The company operates coal-fired power plants, renewable energy sources, and distribution networks, and it is headquartered in Katowice, Poland.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Triton Development S.A.
summary: Based in Warsaw, Poland, Triton Development S.A. specializes in the construction of residential properties across the country. Their offerings span from apartments within multi-unit buildings to individual single-family homes and semi-detached dwellings. This enterprise was established in 1992.

name: Trakcja
summary: Founded in Warsaw, Poland, in 2002, Trakcja S.A. is a prominent player in the infrastructure and energy construction sectors, operating across Poland and internationally. The company's diverse activities are structured into key segments: Civil Engineering in Poland, Construction, Engineering, and Concession Arrangements in the Baltic States, and other operations. Trakcja specializes in the construction and modernization of railway infrastructure, including the provision of catenary services, alongside developing energy networks like power lines, transformer stations, and traction substations. Its civil engineering expertise extends to building various structures such as bridges (including railway bridges), bypass roads, and underground pedestrian passages, as well as undertaking modifications to railway tunnels and bridges. Beyond physical construction, the company offers a full spectrum of design services, from technical and feasibility studies to conceptual, building, implementation, assembly, and as-built designs, tender preparation, cost estimation, and specialized analyses for railway transport technology. Furthermore, Trakcja provides environmental engineering solutions, including external sanitary sewer systems, wastewater treatment plants, pumping stations, separators, and watercourse regulation. The company also constructs residential, industrial, and general-purpose buildings, acting both as a general contractor and developer. Its offerings are complemented by rail transport services, equipment and specialized machinery rental, and the manufacturing of construction materials and components. This manufacturing arm produces items such as switchgears, various structural supports (C-channels, H-bars, gate constructions, girder fittings), section insulators, asphalt concrete (including polymer-modified varieties), bituminous emulsion, concrete, and concrete products. Additionally, Trakcja engages in the excavation and processing of building materials.

name: Trans Polonia S.A.
summary: Trans Polonia S.A. and its affiliated companies offer comprehensive transportation and logistics solutions throughout Europe, with a primary focus on the petrochemical sector. The company is responsible for conveying a diverse array of products, including liquid fuels like petrol, diesel, and liquefied petroleum gas, to both service stations and other petrochemical businesses. Their operations also encompass the transport of liquid chemicals, various bitumen products such as standard road, modified, and industrial asphalt, as well as cement and liquid goods for the food industry. Founded in 2008, Trans Polonia S.A. maintains its headquarters in Tczew, Poland.

name: Termo-Rex S.A.
summary: Founded in 1997 and based in Jaworzno, Poland, Termo-Rex S.A. delivers comprehensive heat treatment solutions to clients both domestically and internationally. The company specializes in critical thermal processes such as preheating for welding and stress relief annealing for steel components, serving key industries including power generation, chemical, petrochemical, shipbuilding, and mining. Beyond on-site operations, Termo-Rex provides mobile heat treatment services and furnace-based thermal processing. Furthermore, they are involved in the manufacturing and leasing of specialized heat treatment and welding apparatus, including accessories like resistance heating mats, power distributors, various cables, and welding machines for pins and thermocouples. Their offerings also encompass the sale of electrical products and expert services in electrical systems, intercoms, alarm installations, and smart home technology. Additionally, Termo-Rex extracts and distributes microspheres.

name: Tesgas S.A.
summary: Tesgas S.A., founded in 2000 and based in Dopiewo, Poland, is a specialized company offering end-to-end solutions for the gas industry within Poland. The firm excels in designing, constructing, and operating a diverse range of gas infrastructure, playing a significant role in both natural gas transmission and distribution. Its extensive construction and modernization services encompass high, medium, and low-pressure gas networks, gas stations, boiler rooms, and installations crucial for natural gas and crude oil extraction. Tesgas also builds modern LNG, LPG, and CNG fueling stations, develops micro-generation systems, and manufactures pressure vessels. Beyond construction, the company manages the operation of medium and high-pressure gas stations and pipelines, alongside other critical gas facilities such as LNG systems, industrial gas applications, and gas boilers. A distinct area of expertise is its comprehensive natural gas odorization services using THT (tetrahydrothiophene) – a colorless agent that makes otherwise odorless natural gas detectable. This includes THT distribution, delivery, filling and adjusting odorizing installations for hermetic sealing, and the rectification of minor THT leaks. Tesgas provides detailed design services for various gas infrastructure projects, including high, medium, and low-pressure gas networks, gas stations at different pressure levels, and specialized installations for oil and gas extraction sites. Its client portfolio is broad, serving gas network proprietors, companies building reduction and metering stations, and contractors for gas mines, storage facilities, pipelines, and LNG terminals.

name: Text S.A.
summary: Text S.A. is a global developer and distributor of communication software solutions tailored for businesses. Their product lineup features LiveChat, enabling real-time interactions between website visitors and site owners; ChatBot, which allows companies to build AI-driven conversational agents for automating customer service and corporate communications; KnowledgeBase, a platform for creating centralized information repositories for employees and clients; and HelpDesk, an application designed to streamline team-based customer support via email. Founded in Wroclaw, Poland, in 2002, the company was previously known as LiveChat Software S.A. before adopting the name Text S.A. in September 2023.

name: UniCredit S.p.A.
summary: UniCredit S.p.A. is an Italian global banking and financial services company headquartered in Milan. It offers a wide range of services including retail banking, corporate and investment banking, and wealth management. UniCredit operates in multiple countries across Europe.

name: Ultimate Games S.A.
summary: Ultimate Games S.A. engages in the production and distribution of games for various platforms worldwide. It provides computer and mobile games, as well as games for consoles through various distribution platforms. The company is based in Warsaw, Poland.

name: ULMA Construccion Polska S.A.
summary: ULMA Construccion Polska S.A. is an active enterprise within the global and Polish construction landscape. The company organizes its operations into two main divisions: the provision of construction site services and the distribution of building supplies. It offers a diverse portfolio of scaffolding systems, encompassing both frame and ringlock designs, for either rental or direct purchase. Furthermore, ULMA Construccion Polska S.A. specializes in an extensive array of formwork solutions, suitable for walls, columns, slabs, and tunnels, in addition to providing climbing, timber, beam, plywood, bridge, and shoring systems. Beyond equipment, the company furnishes general construction services, alongside logistical support, engineering expertise, on-site assistance, assembly, and repair capabilities. Through its building materials segment, it supplies various construction components, foundational raw materials, and concrete accessories. Established in 1961, the firm, initially named BAUMA S.A. before rebranding in November 2006, maintains its headquarters in Brwinów, Poland, and functions as a subsidiary of ULMA C y E, S. Coop.

name: Unibep S.a.
summary: UNIBEP S.A., headquartered in Bielsk Podlaski, Poland, operates as a construction enterprise with a presence across Poland and on the international stage. The company's diverse portfolio includes the development of residential properties, public sector facilities, industrial structures, and civil engineering projects like roads and bridges. Additionally, their expertise extends to constructing sports venues, modular buildings, hotels, office complexes, and various retail and service establishments.

name: Unimot S.A.
summary: As an autonomous fuel import enterprise, Unimot S.A. is deeply involved in the wholesale and retail provision of various fuels throughout Poland. Their extensive portfolio comprises diesel, biofuels, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and electrical power. The company ensures product delivery through its own LNG regasification facilities, a bottling plant, and transshipment hubs, supplemented by road transport via trucks and tanks. Additionally, Unimot manages a network of AVIA-branded franchise service stations. Both private individuals and commercial entities form the core of its customer base. The organization, founded in 1992, is headquartered in Zawadzkie, Poland.

name: Urteste S.A.
summary: Urteste S.A. focuses on the investigation and development of diagnostic solutions designed to detect various forms of cancer. Their portfolio includes testing methods for a wide range of malignancies affecting organs such as the pancreas, prostate, kidneys, colon, liver, biliary system, stomach, lungs, esophagus, ovaries, endometrium, blood, breasts, and the nervous system. This enterprise, based in Gdansk, Poland, commenced its operations in 2021.

name: VIGO Photonics S.A.
summary: VIGO Photonics S.A. manufactures and sells semiconductor materials, and devices for photonic and microelectronic applications worldwide. It offers epi-wafers; infrared detectors comprising photoconductive, multi-channel, photovoltaic, and superlattice detectors; and infrared detection modules. The company’s products are used in defense and security, environmental protection, healthcare, transport, and research and development industries. VIGO Photonics S.A. was formerly known as VIGO System S.A. and changed its name to VIGO Photonics S.A. in August 2022. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Ozarów Mazowiecki, Poland.

name: Gielda Praw Majatkowych Vindexus Spolka Akcyjna
summary: Gielda Praw Majatkowych Vindexus Spolka Akcyjna operates within Poland's debt management sector, offering specialized financial solutions. The company's primary services encompass the administration of debt for securitization funds, alongside comprehensive debt recovery operations. This Warsaw, Poland-based firm was established in 1995.

name: Votum S.A.
summary: Votum S.A. specializes in offering support for securing compensation across Central and Eastern Europe. The firm primarily assists individual clients who have sustained injuries in road accidents, guiding them through each phase of the compensation claims procedure to ensure they obtain their rightful financial settlements. Established in 2005, the company's main office is situated in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: Volkswagen AG
summary: Volkswagen AG manufactures and sells automobiles primarily in Europe, North America, South America, and the Asia-Pacific. The company operates in four segments: Passenger Cars and Light Commercial Vehicles, Commercial Vehicles, Power Engineering, and Financial Services. The Passenger Cars and Light Commercial Vehicles segment develops vehicles and engines, and light commercial vehicles; and produces and sells passenger cars and related parts. The Commercial Vehicles segment develops, produces, and sells trucks and buses; and offers parts and related services. The Power Engineering segment offers large-bore diesel engines, turbomachinery, special gear units, and propulsion components. The Financial Services segment provides dealer and customer financing, leasing, banking and insurance, fleet management, and mobility services. The company also offers motorcycles. It provides its products under the Volkswagen Passenger Cars, Audi, ŠKODA, SEAT, Bentley, Porsche, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Scania, MAN, Lamborghini, Ducati, and Bugatti brands. Volkswagen AG was incorporated in 1937 and is based in Wolfsburg, Germany. Volkswagen AG operates as a subsidiary of Porsche Automobil Holding SE.

name: Voxel S.A.
summary: Voxel S.A. operates a network of diagnostic imaging laboratories. Its diagnostic imaging services include magnetic resonance imaging scans, computed tomography scans, positron emission tomography, and single photon emission computed tomography. The company also provides services in the field of diagnostic imaging, teleradiology, and outsourcing; and information systems for hospitals and diagnostic centers. In addition, it deals with the implementation of projects related to the outfitting of diagnostic laboratories. The company operates through a network of 33 specialized laboratories in 21 cities in Poland. Voxel S.A. was founded in 2005 and is based in Kraków, Poland.

name: Vercom S.A.
summary: Vercom S.A. delivers Communication Platform as a Service (CPaaS) solutions, equipping businesses to foster and enhance their relationships with customers through diverse communication channels. These channels encompass email, SMS, push notifications, and instant messaging. The company was founded in 2005, is headquartered in Poznan, Poland, and operates as a subsidiary of R22 S.A.

name: VRG S.A.
summary: VRG S.A. designs, manufactures, and distributes jewelry and fashion collections for women and men in Poland and internationally. The company offers various men's fashion collections, such as classical and avant-garde jackets, well-cut trousers, suits, modern knitwear, coats and jackets, and other accessories under the Vistula, Vistula RED, Lantier, Vesari, Wólczanka, Intermoda, and BYTOM brands; gold and silver jewelry, diamonds, natural stones, gift items, and watches under the W.KRUK brand name; men's shirts under the Wólczanka brand; and clothing for women under the Deni Cler Milano brand name. It operates 567 stores, including 145 Vistula brand stores, 140 W.KRUK brand stores, 132 Wólczanka brand stores, 120 BYTOM brand stores, and 30 Deni Cler Milano brand stores. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Krakow, Poland.

name: Vivid Games S.A.
summary: Vivid Games S.A., a European developer and producer of mobile video games, was established in 2006. This company, based in Bydgoszcz, Poland, is notably recognized for its popular Real Boxing game series.

name: Wasko S.A.
summary: Wasko S.A. designs, implements, and integrats software, information systems, and advanced industrial automation. It offers gas and fire detection, intelligent monitoring, perimeter security, and traffic dispatch support systems; and industrial facility management, notifications and issues automation, photovoltaic farm management, gas-collector, energy storage, gas planning and procurement process support, automation of business task and process, reverse vending machines, business process management, electronic document management, and business process automation services. The company also provides tunnel simulators, tunnel operator trainer, intelligent transport system, and protection of crossroads and inner parking lots; railway automatic depot management systems locomotive and railway wagon fleet, and linear investment management; police work and uniformed support, and emergency medical; and traffic dispatch support system services. It offers WASKO BSS and WASKO OSS, a platform that supports telecommunication operators and service provider; NEDAPS TELCO, an orchestration of the telecommunications environment; NEDAPS SEC, a cybersecurity platform for IT environment protection; NEDAPS SEC – AI Assistant, an AI assistant for IT security; NEDAPS SEC – Automation Center, an automated cybersecurity management and control IT risk; OpenEye eADMIN that manages IT infrastructure; KOBAT-SAD, a telecommunications traffic analysis system; KOBAT-Kolektor, a data mediation and collection for settlements; and mtde, a mass storage emulator. The company also provides information, and integration of information systems; telecommunication networks, investment support, and radiocommunication infrastructure; OT security, IT cybersecurity, and IT audit; packback cloud, data center, and virtualization of environments; and outsourcing IT, print optimization, field service, service desk, and commercial advice. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Gliwice, Poland.

name: Wikana S.A.
summary: Wikana S.A., operating with its subsidiaries, predominantly focuses on real estate development activities within Poland. The company's business model encompasses three distinct divisions: Property Development, Real Estate Leasing, and Renewable Energy Generation. Through its development arm, Wikana S.A. undertakes the construction and sale of residential units, commercial spaces, and various parking solutions, including subterranean facilities. Additionally, it provides property management and administrative services alongside the leasing of commercial and residential properties. The firm is also engaged in producing electricity, heat, and other commodities sourced from renewable energies. Founded in 1994, the company was formerly known as Masters S.A. until its rebranding to Wikana S.A. in 2009, and it is based in Lublin, Poland.

name: Wielton S.A.
summary: WIELTON S.A. is a Polish manufacturer of semi-trailers, trailers, and bodies for the transport industry. The company offers a wide range of transport solutions for various industries, including agriculture, construction, and logistics. WIELTON S.A. is headquartered in Wieluń, Poland.

name: Wirtualna Polska Holding S.A.
summary: Wirtualna Polska Holding S.A., through its subsidiaries, engages in the media, advertising, and e-commerce businesses in Poland. It operates in two segments, Online and TV. The company operates praca.money.pl that provides job offers, guides, a salary calculator, and sample documents for job candidates, as well as content marketing, and targeted video and display campaigns; Vibez, which features thematic cycles related to ecology, sex education, the fight against discrimination, and mental health, as well as a various lifestyle topics; Polygamia.pl, a gaming website; WP Poczta and o2 poczta that offers e-mail services; Telewizja WP, a TV station; WP Pilot, an online television; and OpenFM, an Internet radio. It also offers a range of advertising products, such as modern display advertising, including online video advertising, email advertising, mobile device advertising, and efficiency model based advertising; and operates tourism portals, comprising of Wakacje.pl, nocowanie.pl, Mytravel.pl, and PARKLOT.PL. In addition, the company operates fashion search engines, consisting of domodi.pl and allani.pl; Homebook.pl, a platform for interior design professionals and enthusiasts; Extradom.pl that sells house design plans online; direct.money.pl, totalmoney.pl, and Finansowy supermarket, which offer financial services; and superauto.pl for purchasing and financing of cars. Further, the company operates WP.pl, o2.pl, pudelek.pl, money.pl, abcZdrowie.pl, and eholiday.pl portals. Wirtualna Polska Holding S.A. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland.

name: Wittchen S.A.
summary: Wittchen S.A. manufactures and sells leather goods for men and women in Poland and Europe. The company offers messenger, shoulder, cross body, shopper, tote, hobo, waist, clutch, evening, and laptop bags, as well as backpacks; leather goods, such as wallets, cases, briefcases, business card holders, document holders, and organizers; and luggage products, including suitcases, cosmetic cases, travel bags, and travel accessories. It also provides clothing products comprising jackets, coats, gilets, and fur products; shoes consisting of sandals and flip flops, sneakers, and moccasins; ballerina, court, stiletto, and wedding shoes; ankle, Chelsea, knee high, combat, and cowboy boots, as well as sports shoes; and accessories, such as scarves, neckerchiefs, shawls, gloves, belts, umbrellas, socks, hats, keychains, masks, ties, and suspenders. It operates through a network of sales showrooms and retail stores, as well as an online store. Wittchen S.A. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Nowy Dwór Mazowiecki, Poland. Wittchen S.A. is a subsidiary of Simei Investments Ltd.

name: Wawel S.A.
summary: Wawel S.A. produces and sells cocoa, chocolate, and confectionary products. The company offers a range of chocolates, as well as bars, chocos and fruities, fresh and fruity jellies, candies in chocolate, tofflairs, cream fudges, caramels, choco mints, wafers without sugar, fruits in chocolate, and cocoa products. It sells its products under the Kasztanki, Malaga, Tiki Taki, Michalki z Wawelu, Mieszanka Krakowska, Fresh & Fruity, Krówka, Tofflairs, Milkizz, Qulinaria, Bez Dodatku Cukru, Trufle z Wawelu, Pastylka mietowa, Sliwki w czekoladzie, Danusia, and Karmelki recznie produkowane brand names. The company sells its products to retail and discount chains in Poland. Wawel S.A. also exports its products. The company was founded in 1898 and is based in Kraków, Poland. Wawel S.A. is a subsidiary of Hosta International AG.

name: Warimpex Finanz- und Beteiligungs AG
summary: Warimpex Finanz- und Beteiligungs AG operates as a real estate development and investment company in Central and Eastern Europe. The company operates through Hotels, Investment Properties, and Development and Services segments. It develops, owns, and operates hotel properties; and develops real estate projects, such as office buildings and shopping centres. The company invests in and develops projects in the Czech Republic, Poland, Hungary, Russia, Germany, Austria, and France. As of December 31, 2020, it owned and operated four hotels with 1,000 rooms; and eight commercial and office buildings with a total floor area of approximately 104,600 square meters. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Vienna, Austria.

name: Xplus S.A.
summary: Xplus S.A. offers IT software solutions in Poland and internationally. It offers Executive Automats- Testing, a test automation tool for Microsoft Dynamics AX/365 FSCM; Executive Automats - Security Setup that creates custom security roles for Microsoft Dynamics 365 FSCM; Executive Explorer, a business process performance advisor for Microsoft Dynamics AX/365 FSCM; Data Protection Suite, a tool for data anonymization; Polish Localizations; a localization toolkit for Poland; and Bankflow that allows user to transfer data directly to electronic banking systems and automate many banking-related processes. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Warsaw, Poland. Xplus S.A. operates as a subsidiary of FCBSL 1 k.s.

name: XTB SA
summary: XTB S.A., along with its affiliated entities, offers extensive brokerage solutions for a diverse range of financial products, including currency derivatives, commodities, market indices, stocks, and bonds. Its geographical footprint covers Central and Eastern Europe, Western Europe, and Latin America. The company structures its operations into two main divisions: Retail Operations, serving individual traders, and Institutional Activity, for corporate clients. Both segments access XTB's offerings through proprietary trading platforms like xStation 5 and xStation mobile, in addition to the popular MetaTrader 4. Beyond direct brokerage, XTB provides investment advisory services, facilitates derivatives trading and intermediation, and supplies trading infrastructure for other businesses to offer financial instrument trading under their own branding. Established in 2002 as X-Trade Brokers Dom Maklerski S.A., the firm is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, and functions as a subsidiary of XXZW Investment Group S.A.

name: XTPL S.a.
summary: XTPL S.A. operates in the nanotechnology market in Poland and internationally. The company develops and commercializes precise printing technology platform of nanomaterials.
