It also offers delta printing system laboratory printers; Nanoinks and other consumables; and research services related to printing on client-supplied substrates. The company sells its products through distributors. XTPL S.A. was founded in 2015 and is based in Wroclaw, Poland.

name: yarrl S.A.
summary: Operating out of Kraków, Poland, yarrl S.A. was founded in 2004 and serves the Polish market across the information technology (IT) and telecommunications industries. Formerly known as Unima 2000 Systemy Teleinformatyczne S.A. until its rebranding in December 2023, the company delivers a broad spectrum of services. Its core offerings include the deployment of call and contact center systems, as well as the seamless integration of diverse communication channels and physical locations. yarrl provides sophisticated voice-based communication solutions, such as interactive voice support, PDS, advanced speech analytics, and voice biometrics. Leveraging artificial intelligence, it also develops chatbots and voicebots, alongside facilitating modern communication avenues like social media, mobile applications, video calls, and unified communication platforms. A significant area of focus is cybersecurity, where yarrl implements robust systems like IBM QRadar, NGFW, and UTM devices and software, in addition to offering comprehensive IT security and personal data protection services. Beyond digital infrastructure, the company specializes in integral building management systems, including fire safety, audiovisual setups, and structured cabling. Its extensive safety and security portfolio encompasses fire alarm, sound broadcasting, sound warning, CCTV video monitoring, SSWiN burglary and assault signaling, and AC access control systems, all designed to safeguard people, property, and structural networks. Furthermore, yarrl S.A. extends its expertise to construction investment and real estate management, service management, and conference and marketing services. It utilizes advanced analytical capabilities and artificial intelligence for predictive failure prediction, big data analysis, reporting, speech recognition, and voice authentication. The company also provides a range of low voltage systems and installations, such as radio communication, paging, central clock systems, and building automation.

name: Zabka Group SA
summary: Zabka Group S.A. operates as an ultimate convenience ecosystem in Poland. The company operates convenience retail stores and Zabka Nano Stores, an autonomous store. It also provides digital offering solutions, including Maczfit, a direct-to-consumer (D2C) meal solution; Dietly, an online D2C meal solutions marketplace.; and eGrocery and e-commerce services under the Zappka, delio and Zabka Jush brands. In addition, the company franchises retail stores; and engages in the IT consultancy related activities, real estate construction, warehousing and storage of goods, rental and management of own or leased real estate, and sale of merchandise. Further, it is involved in the retail sale of tobacco products in specialised stores; production and distribution of ready meals; software related activities connected with catering platform; transport of goods; distribution of FMCG products; and other activities supporting financial services. It sells its products through physical convenience stores and online. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Luxembourg, Luxembourg.

name: Zalando SE
summary: Zalando SE operates as an online fashion and lifestyle retailer. It offers a range of products, including shoes, apparel, accessories, and beauty products for women, men, and children, as well as free delivery and returns services. The company also sells its products through its Zalando Lounge; and brick-and-mortar stores in Berlin, Frankfurt, Cologne, Leipzig, Hamburg, Hanover, Münster, Stuttgart, Mannheim, and Ulm. It serves in Austria, Belgium, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Luxemburg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom. Zalando SE was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany.

name: Grupa Azoty S.A.
summary: Zaklady Azotowe Pulawy S.A. operates internationally, producing and supplying a wide array of fertilizers and chemical goods. Its fertilizer offerings feature ammonium nitrate (marketed as PULAN), the granular Pulan Macro, and urea-ammonium nitrate solutions known as UAN. The company also provides PULSAR brand ammonium sulphate, UAN+S (a urea-ammonium nitrate solution enhanced with sulphur), PULASKA (a nitrogen fertilizer solution containing sulphur), and urea-ammonium sulfate under the PULGRAN S name. In the chemical sector, their products range from COOLANT dry ice, hydrogen peroxide, anhydrous ammonia, compressed hydrogen, liquefied carbon dioxide, and nitric acid – all essential for various industrial chemical processes. They also manufacture caprolactam for industrial solid and liquid formulations, melamine used in synthetic resin production, and LIKAM, an ammonia water solution employed across diverse industries including power generation, tanning, agriculture, rubber, dye, organic, and glass, and as a pH control agent. Furthermore, the firm supplies NOXy, a urea water solution for the automotive industry, and PULNOx, a reducing agent crucial for vehicle emissions control systems. Complementing these are packaging and foil products, including flat open sacks, big bag contributions, colored foils, flat foil belts, FSS foil tape with side folds, garbage bags, garden foils, LDPE, and stretch protective films. Founded in 1960 and based in Pulawy, Poland, Zaklady Azotowe Pulawy S.A. functions as a subsidiary of Grupa Azoty S.A.

name: Ze Pak S.A.
summary: ZESPÓL ELEKTROWNI PATNÓW-ADAMÓW-KONIN S.A. (ZE PAK) is a Polish enterprise primarily engaged in the generation and distribution of electricity and heat. Its power generation strategy incorporates conventional energy sources, alongside the combustion and co-combustion of biomass and coal, and the operation of lignite-fired power plants. In addition to its core energy business, the company extends its operations into construction and installation, maintenance, various service provisions, manufacturing, and commercial endeavors. Established in 1958, ZE PAK's corporate headquarters are situated in Konin, Poland. It operates as a subsidiary of Argumenol Investment Company Limited.

name: Zamet S.A.
summary: Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Piotrków Trybunalski, Poland, Zamet S.A. operates as an international manufacturer and supplier specializing in industrial steel structures, various machinery, and equipment. The company's diverse portfolio addresses several critical industries, including the energy sector, for which it produces offshore equipment essential for subsea petroleum extraction and drilling platforms. For the mining industry, Zamet delivers a comprehensive range of solutions, from machinery for deep-coal mines like stackers, bucket-wheel excavators, wagon tipplers, and vertical conveying equipment, to devices for processing mineral raw materials, along with providing spare parts and upgrade services. Zamet also offers an array of material handling and lifting solutions, encompassing cranes, overhead cranes, winches, reclaimer stackers, shiploaders, shipunloaders, grab unloaders, semi-portal scrapers, and complete loading and unloading systems. In the metallurgical domain, the company supplies machinery, equipment, and entire technological lines for steel and non-ferrous metal processing facilities. Additionally, Zamet designs, produces, installs, commissions, services, and modernizes hydraulic presses, particularly for the food industry, and undertakes the fabrication and installation of large-scale welded and bolted steel structures. Beyond manufacturing, Zamet S.A. is active in civil engineering, contributing to the construction of roads, bridges, sports arenas, and various industrial and public buildings. The company operates as a subsidiary of Equity III TDJ Estate Sp. z o.o. sp. Komandytowo-Akcyjna.

name: Zaklad Budowy Maszyn ZREMB - Chojnice Spolka Akcyjna
summary: Zaklad Budowy Maszyn ZREMB - Chojnice Spolka Akcyjna, a Polish firm based in Chojnice and a subsidiary of MSX Resources SA, specializes in the production and sale of an extensive array of containers and steel fabrications. The company provides numerous container types, including robust offshore units for shipping and drilling platforms; basket containers for conveying equipment to these platforms; mini-mud freight containers for delivering supplies and provisions to platform personnel; and borekaks containers for the disposal of drilling waste. Furthermore, they manufacture specialized containers for uses such as mobile workshops, compression stations, and generators, alongside military-specific containers and platforms, and units designed for radioactive waste. In the realm of steel structures, ZREMB offers steel roof systems, frameworks for glazed exteriors, bespoke buildings and industrial facilities, and various other custom steel constructions. Their steel roof structures and facades are exported globally to countries including Germany, various Arabic nations, Turkey, Italy, Spain, the United States, Ireland, and Great Britain.

name: ZUE S.A.
summary: ZUE S.A. is a Polish enterprise dedicated to the construction and upkeep of public transportation infrastructure, with its operations divided into Construction, Design, and Sales segments. The company specializes in creating and modernizing urban transport systems, including tram lines, trolleybus networks, traction power substations, street lighting, cable infrastructure, traffic signaling, and associated roadworks and buildings. Additionally, ZUE S.A. undertakes substantial civil engineering projects involving reinforced concrete, such as viaducts, bridges, underpasses, retaining walls, and sound barriers. In the railway sector, their expertise covers the construction and enhancement of tracks, traction systems, signaling and control apparatus, telecommunications, power substations, distribution lines, and station facilities. Beyond large-scale projects, ZUE S.A. manufactures and supplies specialized equipment like infrared systems, tram switch controllers (including the WS90E model), and heating mechanisms for switches. They also provide a comprehensive range of track components and materials, such as various types of rails (for railways, tramways, cranes, and narrow-gauge lines), different kinds of sleepers (steel, timber, pre-stressed concrete), track crossovers, and aggregates, leveraging diverse construction technologies. Founded in 2002, ZUE S.A. is headquartered in Kraków, Poland.

name: Zaklady Urzadzen Kotlowych "Staporków" Spólka Akcyjna
summary: Zaklady Urzadzen Kotlowych "Staporków" Spólka Akcyjna operates as a prime contractor, undertaking projects within the industrial, thermal, and professional energy sectors. The company provides a comprehensive array of air purification technologies, featuring sophisticated two-stage dust removal systems like multi-cyclone units and extensive cyclone battery setups. They also offer filtrobicyclones, specifically engineered to clear exhaust gas particulates primarily from coal-fired grate boilers, and supply specialized bag filters for energy generation plants. Moreover, ZUK implements advanced systems for flue gas purification through desulfurization and denitrification processes, alongside modernizing existing dust-extraction installations. Their product portfolio additionally encompasses various material handling systems, including different types of scraper conveyors (such as those for slag removal), screw conveyors, belt conveyors, suspended scraper conveyors, and specialized energy slag removers for the commercial power industry. ZUK manufactures diverse mechanical grates, comprising heavy-duty, lighter, and stepped grate stokers, as well as grates designed for the co-combustion of coal and biomass. The firm also fabricates a broad range of steel structures, including absorbers, storage silos, and various support frameworks, extending to panel and large-scale formwork systems for the construction industry. Furthermore, ZUK is adept at the construction and fabrication of heat exchangers, industrial reactors, scrubbers, and other absorbers. Their expertise covers building scraper conveyors, a variety of machines and devices, and architectural and industrial elements like spiral staircases, service platforms, safety barriers, ladders, moulders, reducers, and steel compensators. They also develop equipment for transporting bulk materials and provide structural supports for technological process lines and piping networks. Founded in 1738, Zaklady Urzadzen Kotlowych "Staporków" Spólka Akcyjna is based in Staporków, Poland.
